1.name: Class Features
1.value: You can create volatile alchemical Bombs using the statistics shown in the Bomb sidebar.

*As an Alchemist, you can use Alchemist's Supplies to effectively make as many Bombs as you need for the adventuring day at no cost. If you prefer to track your inventory of Bombs manually, you can create a number of Bombs equal to 10 + twice your Alchemist level when you finish a Short or Long Rest. After 24 hours, an unused Bomb becomes inert.*

1.name: Bomb Mastery
1.value: You have proficiency with Bombs and you can use the __Explode__.

1.name: Priming Bombs
1.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can prime a Bomb to increase its potency. Make one attack using a Bomb or use the Bomb's __Explode__ property; you can't make any other attacks using this Attack action. Add your Intelligence modifier to the damage roll.
When you prime your Bomb and deal damage with it, its damage increases by 1d10 when you reach Alchemist levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

1.name: Alchemist Save DC
1.value: Some of your Alchemist features require your target to make a saving throw. The save DC equals 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and Proficiency Bonus. You can use this saving throw for your Bombs instead of the DC specified in the __Explode__ property.

You can spend 10 minutes and expend any number of Reagents to brew potions, which can be done during a Short Rest. You can have a total number of potions at one time up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). These potions retain potency until you finish a Long Rest, after which they become inert.

When you brew potions, you can also distill potions you have already brewed, destroying them and recovering the Reagents expended to brew them, up to a maximum of the number of Reagents listed on the Alchemist Features table. You can expend these Reagents immediately to brew new potions.
The number of Reagents and the Alchemist level required to brew a potion are given on the Potions table.

You have a collection of powerful reagents that you use to brew potions and empower your Bombs. You have 2 Reagents. You regain one expended Reagent when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended Reagents when you finish a Long Rest. You gain additional Reagents when you reach certain Alchemist levels, as shown in the Reagents column of the Alchemist Features table.

1.name: Empowered Bomb
1.value: When you deal damage with a Bomb, you can expend a number of Reagents up to your Proficiency Bonus and add 1d10 to the Bomb's damage roll for each expended Reagents. Additionally, if you use the Bomb's __Explode__ property, you can increase the radius of the explosion by 5 feet. You can do so once for each expended Reagents. For example, if you expend 2 Reagents, you can choose for the Sphere to be a 5, 10 or 15-foot radius.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: Your research has uncovered new formulations for your Bombs that you can apply just before throwing them. Choose three Bomb Formulae from the "Bomb Formulae Options" section later in this class's description.

2.name: Replacing and Gaining Formulae
2.value: When you reach certain Alchemist levels, you learn additional formulae of your choice, as shown in the Bomb Formulae column of the Alchemist Features table. Additionally, whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your Bomb Formulae with another formula of your choice.
If another Alchemist feature gives you a Bomb Formula, it doesn't count against your number of formulae.

2.name: Applying Bomb Formulae
2.value: Once per turn when you prime a Bomb, you can apply a Bomb Formula to it, granting it special effects and potentially changing its damage dice.
When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain an additional number of expended Reagents up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain an Alchemist subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Alchemist levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Alchemist level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: In the course of your research, you have made a number of discoveries regarding the nature of alchemy. You gain one discovery of your choice from the "Discovery Options" section later in this class's description

Whenever you gain an Alchemist level, you can replace one of your discoveries with another one for which you qualify. When you gain certain Alchemist levels, you gain more discoveries of your choice, as shown in the Discoveries column of the Alchemist Features table. You can't pick the same discovery more than once.
Your Potion Brewing feature gains new potions for you to brew.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a feature from your Alchemist Subclass.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.
You don't benefit from this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

9.name: Class Features
9.value: Your Potion Brewing feature gains new potions for you to brew.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a feature from your Alchemist Subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: You automatically succeed on saving throws against your own Bombs and never take damage from them.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

13.name: Class Features
13.value: Your Potion Brewing feature gains new potions for you to brew.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a feature from your Alchemist Subclass.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: You can mix two potions together and drink them as a Bonus Action, gaining the effects of both. You suffer no unexpected effects from mixing potions.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: Your Potion Brewing feature gains new potions for you to brew.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: When you finish a Long Rest, you can replace any of your Bomb Formulae with other formulae of your choice, and you can replace one of your discoveries with another one for which you qualify.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: You can utilize the most devastating Bomb Formula imaginable. By replacing your Bomb's explosive contents with your Philosopher's Stone, you can change it into a Nuclear Bomb. You must use the Bomb's Explosive property. This Bomb deals **10d10 + 100** Force damage instead of its normal Fire damage, and its explosion is a Sphere with a radius of 1 mile. A creature within 60 feet of the center of the Sphere gains no benefit from Evasion or similar features.
This Bomb completely destroys your Philosopher's Stone.
You gain the crowning achievement of alchemy: a Philosopher's Stone, a dynamo of alchemical energy in a fist-sized, glowing jewel.

20.name: Constructing a New Philosopher's Stone
20.value: If your Philosopher's Stone is destroyed, you can construct a new one using Alchemist's Supplies, materials worth 1,000+ GP, and 7 days of work. You can only have one Philosopher's Stone at a time.

20.name: Philosopher's Stone Benefits
20.value: As long as you possess the stone, you gain the following benefits:

20.name: Regenerating Reagents
20.value: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended Reagents until you have 6 if you have 5 or fewer.

20.name: Quick Brewing
20.value: You can brew potions as a Utilize action, instead of over the course of 10 minutes.

20.name: Longevity
20.value: For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year.

3.name: Amorist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Brew Love Potions and Charm Your Foes*

The study of mind-affecting alchemy is a delicate one, practiced only by a small number of Alchemists, known as Amorists. Often called "love doctors" by their clientele, Amorists specialize in the brewing of potions that produce strong emotional responses in their drinkers. While love potions are by far their most popular product, Amorists can also craft pungent pheromone bombs that can even soften the hearts of terrible monsters.

__Charmer (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain proficiency in the *Deception* and *Persuasion* skills. Additionally, when you make a Charisma check using these skills, you can make it as an Intelligence check.
When you brew potions, you can create a Philter of Love for 1 Reagents.

__Pheromone Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: By adding a potent pheromone to your Bomb, you can change it into a Pheromone Bomb. This Bomb deals no damage. When you use the Bomb's __Explode__ property, each creature within the explosion makes a Wisdom saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A target hit by this Bomb or that fails its saving throw against it has the Charmed condition until the start of your next turn or until it takes damage.

6.name: Amorist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: You can take the Influence action as a Bonus Action.

10.name: Amorist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: You wear a mind-altering perfume that endears others to you. When an enemy within 5 feet of you makes an attack roll against you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Alchemist save DC or either choose a new target or lose the attack. A creature that takes damage from you is immune to this feature for 1 hour.

14.name: Amorist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: When you use your Pheromone Bomb, you can expend 1-4 Reagents to improve it. Choose a number of benefits equal to the number of Reagents expended.

14.name: Dreamy Haze
14.value: Choose one creature that has the Bomb's Charmed condition. While Charmed, that creature falls into a dreamy state in which it regards every creature it sees as the condition's charmer.

14.name: Extended Charm
14.value: Choose one creature that has the Bomb's Charmed condition. The Charmed condition lasts for 1 minute for it or until it takes damage.

14.name: Ignore Immunity
14.value: Your Pheromone Bomb ignores Immunity to the Charmed condition.

14.name: Toxic Love
14.value: A target hit by your Pheromone Bomb or that fails its saving throw against it takes Poison damage equal to 4d8 plus your Intelligence modifier. A creature takes half as much damage on a successful save. This damage doesn't end the Bomb's Charmed condition.

3.name: Apothecary (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Heal the Sick and Wounded*

Many practically minded Alchemists assume the role of the Apothecary, for adventuring parties always need a healer and Clerics are often in short supply. During their downtime, such Alchemists have a marketable skill to depend upon for income and can do an indisputable amount of good with their knowledge. Apothecaries constantly study potions and herbology, preferring to learn how to mend the body, rather than destroy it.

__Physician's Studies (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain proficiency in the *Medicine* skill. Additionally, you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

__Painkiller Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You can mix your Bomb's contents with analgesic oil, changing it into a Painkiller Bomb. This Bomb deals no damage, but instead causes the target or each creature within the Sphere of the Bomb's __Explode__ property to gain Temporary Hit Points. These Temporary Hit Points equal your Alchemist level.

When you grant Temporary Hit Points using this Bomb, you can also expend Reagents to use Empowered Bomb. Instead of increasing the Bomb's damage, you increase the number of Temporary Hit Points by 1d10 for each expended Reagents.
You can use this formula a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once) and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Apothecary (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: When a creature regains Hit Points as a result of drinking one of your potions, it can instead replace up to half of the die rolled with the highest possible number for each die.

10.name: Apothecary (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: Whenever you drink a potion that has the effect of restoring your Hit Points (even if you already have all of your Hit Points), you have Advantage on saving throws until the end of your next turn.

14.name: Apothecary (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Your medicines are potent enough to rouse the dead. By using a Magic action to mix diamond dust worth 1,000 GP+ into a Potion of Superior Healing or a Potion of Supreme Healing, you create a Potion of Resurrection. This potion doesn't become inert after 24 hours.

3.name: Ionizer (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Manipulate Energy to Defeat Your Foes*

Ionizers specialize in the transfer of energy. In the most benign applications, they design heatsinks and cooling systems to improve cutting edge technology. However, they also deal in destructive ends, designing lasers, energy shields, and especially blasters. With a few thermodynamic tricks, they command plasma in all its forms.
__Bonus Proficiencies (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain proficiency in the *Technology* skill.

__Plasma Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: By replacing your Bomb's explosive contents with an ion-fluxer, you can change it into a Plasma Bomb which adheres to a target it directly hits. This Bomb deals Radiant damage instead of Fire damage. If you use the Bomb's Explosive property, all of its damage dice are d6s; otherwise, all of its damage dice are d12s.

6.name: Ionizer (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You've learned an alchemical trick to channel heat from one object to another. As a Bonus Action, you can expend 1 Reagent to use Overheat and Supercool.

6.name: Overheat
6.value: You direct heat toward an enemy or a weapon you can see within 30 feet of you. If you choose a creature, it takes **2d6** Fire damage. If you choose a weapon, the weapon overheats. An Overheated weapon can't be used again to make an attack until the end of your next turn.

6.name: Supercool
6.value: You direct heat away from a weapon you can see within 30 feet of you, supercooling it. This weapon deals an extra **2d6** Cold damage on the next attack it makes before the end of your next turn.

10.name: Ionizer (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you are hit by a ranged attack that deals Force, Lightning, Necrotic, or Radiant damage, roll a d6. On a roll of 6, the attack misses you, regardless of its roll.

14.name: Ionizer (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: You create a fist-sized device that can absorb, store, and redirect small amounts of energy. When you use your Electromagnetic Shield feature, regardless of your roll, your discharge device gains 1 charge, to a maximum of 10. Charges last for 24 hours. As a Bonus Action, you can expend any number of stored charges to force a target within 60 feet of you to make a Dexterity saving throw against your Alchemist save DC. A creature takes **1d10** Force damage for each charge expended on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

3.name: Mad Bomber (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Blow Things Up*

While many "Mad Bombers" aren't actually mad, it takes a special kind of crazy to devote one's life to studying explosives. Most Alchemists who specialize in this field are incorrigible pyromaniacs who take great pleasure in burning, blasting, and blowing things up. Mad Bombers are always working to improve their bombs' effectiveness.
__Blasting Specialty (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: Your Bombs deal double damage to objects and structures.

__Black Powder Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: By adding a charge of black powder to your Bomb, you can change it into an Black Powder Bomb. All of this Bomb's damage dice are d12s. If a target has Resistance to Fire damage, it loses that Resistance for this damage roll. If it has Immunity to Fire damage, it instead has Resistance for this damage roll.
You can use this formula a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once) and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Mad Bomber (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: When you prime a Bomb, you can set a duration for its detonation, which can be any number of rounds (any increment of 6 seconds) up to 10 minutes. The Bomb detonates using the Bomb's __Explode__ property at the end of your turn after this duration. If a creature is in the area of more than one Bomb's explosion simultaneously, the creature is only affected by one Bomb of your choice.

10.name: Mad Bomber (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: Choose one damage type from among Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

14.name: Mad Bomber (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Whenever you expend a number of Reagents equal to your Proficiency Bonus to empower a Bomb, you gain 2 additional Reagents which you can immediately expend to further empower the Bomb beyond the normal maximum of Reagents.

3.name: Mutagenist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Mutate Yourself to Adapt to Any Situation*

The study of alchemy is fundamentally the study of transformation. All Alchemists transmute mundane materials into magical substances—potions, elixirs, and bombs—yet some take it one step further. You have discovered the secrets of the mutagen, the keystone of transmutation, which allows you to transform your very body, gaining supernatural strength or speed, sprouting additional limbs or claws, or thickening your skin into a stony aegis.
__Bonus Proficiencies (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain proficiency in the *Technology* skill.

__Mutagens (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You can take a Bonus Action to inject yourself with a potent transmutative potion known as a Mutagen. You gain one of the following benefits of your choice for 1 minute, or until you take a Bonus Action to inject yourself with a different Mutagen.

3.name: Strength
3.value: Your Strength score increases by 3, to a maximum of 23. Additionally, you sprout claws, fangs, spines, horns, or a different natural weapon of your choice. You can use this natural weapon to make Unarmed Strikes. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal damage equal to 1d8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage. The damage of this strike is Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, as appropriate for the natural weapon.

3.name: Dexterity
3.value: Your Dexterity score increases by 3, to a maximum of 23. Additionally, your Speed increases by 10 feet.

3.name: Constitution
3.value: Your Constitution score increases by 3, to a maximum of 23. You gain Temporary Hit Points instead of increasing your Hit Point maximum or current Hit Points. If your Constitution modifier increases by 1, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your level. If the modifier increases by 2, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level. These Temporary Hit Points last for the duration of the ability score increase.

6.name: Mutagenist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: You can take a Bonus Action and expend 1 Reagents to inject an ally within 5 feet of you with a Mutagen of your choice. A creature can only be under the effect of one Mutagen at a time. Once you have injected another creature with a Mutagen, you can't do so again until the original Mutagen ends.

10.name: Mutagenist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: Whenever you inject yourself with a Mutagen, you can also gain one of the following mutations of your choice.

10.name: Hyperelastic
10.value: Your flesh takes on a rubbery quality, allowing you to bend and stretch with ease. Your reach is 5 feet greater than normal. Additionally, you have Advantage on checks you make to end the Grappled condition or to escape from nonmagical restraints.

10.name: Mucilaginous
10.value: Your skin secretes a thick, extremely sticky substance that helps you adhere to objects. You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You also have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Polybrachia
10.value: You grow a pair of additional arms. These arms are fully functional and can be used to hold weapons and shields (allowing you to wield two Two-Handed weapons, or four one-handed weapons), perform Somatic components of spells, and perform other actions, though the arms themselves don't grant you any additional actions.

14.name: Mutagenist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Choose Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. The chosen ability score increases by 2, and your maximum for this score increases to 22. When a Mutagen is applied to that ability score, its maximum increases to 25. You can change this ability score increase when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Ooze Rancher (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Brew Bottled Ooze Minions*

Unsurprisingly, Oozes, jellies, and slimes are a fascinating subject for Alchemists who wish to figure out how inanimate chemicals can form together and rise up in a moving, hungry mass. The answer to this question may very well be at the heart of alchemy itself. Alchemists who choose to research slimes in depth are called Ooze Ranchers, for they breed and keep numerous slimes upon which to experiment.
__Ooze Resilience (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: Your experience with Oozes grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Acid Resistance
3.value: You have Resistance to Acid damage.

3.name: Ooze Empathy
3.value: Additionally, whenever an Ooze tries to attack you, it makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Alchemist save DC. On a failed save, the attack automatically misses you. On a successful save, the Ooze is immune to this feature for the next 24 hours.

__Slime Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: By mixing your Bomb's explosive contents with the remnants of an Ooze, you can change it into a Slime Bomb. This Bomb deals no damage, but instead causes the target or each creature within the Sphere of the Bomb's __Explode__ property to become coated in a viscous, green slime. A creature coated in slime can't take Bonus Actions or the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action. This slime lasts for 1 minute or until it or another creature takes the Utilize action to remove the slime.

6.name: Ooze Rancher (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: Whenever you brew potions, you can spend 2 Reagents to create a Bottled Ooze, which contains a __Gray Ooze__. This item retains potency until you finish a Long Rest, after which it becomes inert.

An Ooze produced by your Bottled Oozes uses your Intelligence modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus for its attack rolls. If the Ooze forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your Alchemist save DC.

6.name: Improved Bottled Oozes
6.value: At higher Alchemist levels, you can distill more powerful slimes into Bottled Oozes that you create, as shown on the following table. An Ooze by your Bottled Ooze can't take the Split Reaction.

10.name: Ooze Rancher (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: Whenever you are targeted by an attack while an allied Ooze is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to command it to move in the way of the attack, causing the attack to target it instead.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Ooze Rancher (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Whenever you create a Bottled Ooze, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage. The Ooze has Immunity to that damage. Whenever it is subjected to that damage type, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

3.name: Pigmentist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Splash Paint Everywhere to Support Your Allies*

One of the lesser-known duties of Alchemists is synthesizing new and increasingly vibrant pigments from mundane and magical materials—in many cases, creating new colors from whole cloth. Alchemists that specialize in this field are called Pigmentists. An artful and imaginative lot, they seek to brighten the world with their newly-invented hues, or failing that, simply splatter it with marvelous combinations of paint.

__Painter (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain proficiency with Painter's Supplies and gain a bonus to checks using it equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1). Additionally, you can make a gallon of paint whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.

__Paint Bombs (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain the Paint Bomb formula, which doesn't count against your total number of formulae known. If you already have it, gain another formula of your choice. For you, the Bomb is improved in the following ways.

3.name: Extended Duration
3.value: Creatures remain coated in paint until the end of your next turn, instead of the start of your next turn.

3.name: Magical Pigments
3.value: When you throw a Paint Bomb, choose its color from the Magical Pigment table. Each color corresponds to a damage type. Whenever a creature coated in paint takes damage of the corresponding type, it takes an extra **1d6** damage of that type.

6.name: Pigmentist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: You mix your paint with conjuration magic. Once on each of your turns, you can use 10 feet of your movement to enter any area of wet paint within 5 feet of you, emerging from another area of wet paint of the same color within 60 feet of you. Both areas of paint must be at least the same size as you and must have been coated within the last minute.

10.name: Pigmentist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: Whenever you brew a potion, you can add a pigment from the Magical Pigments table. When a creature drinks this potion, they also gain the benefits of a Potion of Resistance of the corresponding damage type for 1 minute.

14.name: Pigmentist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Your Paint Bombs are improved in the following ways:

14.name: Rainbow Blast
14.value: You can add up to three colors from the Magical Pigments table when you throw a Paint Bomb.

14.name: Selective Splatter
14.value: When you use the __Explode__ property of your Paint Bomb, you can choose for each creature within the area to automatically succeed or fail (your choice) on its saving throw against the Bomb.

3.name: Resonator (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Use Acoustics to Shape the Battlefield*

The explosive force of an Alchemist's Bomb isn't just fire—it is a wave that can be shaped and focused. Alchemists who realize this and pursue the science of waves are deemed Resonators for their oft-revisited subject, resonant frequencies. Perhaps such frequencies are at the center of all alchemical pursuits, for with the right frequencies, a Resonator can warp explosions, concuss dragons, and vibrate steel to pieces.

__Playback Device (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You construct a clockwork device for recording and playing back audio. You can record anything you have heard within the last minute using this device and can store up to 8 hours of audio. Played back audio sounds identical to when it was recorded, but you can't use this device to replicate sounds loudly enough to deafen or deal damage. Additionally, you can playback audio up to three times as loud, allowing you to use the device as a megaphone. If you lose your Playback Device, you can build a new one using materials worth 100+ GP over the course of a Short or Long Rest.

__Conical Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: By attaching a waveguide to the exterior of your Bomb, you can change it into a Conical Bomb. This Bomb deals Thunder damage instead of Fire damage. When you use the Bomb's __Explode__ property, the explosion is a 10-foot Cone originating from the Bomb's point of impact, extending in a direction you choose. Each creature within the Cone makes a Constitution saving throw, instead of Dexterity. You can extend the cone by 5 feet by expending Reagents as normal.

6.name: Resonator (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: You have discovered that every material has a resonant frequency, a specific tone that compromises its structural integrity. As a Magic action, you can choose one type of solid material, such as wood, glass, metal, or stone, and begin playing the material's resonant frequency through your Playback Device. You can stop playing a resonant frequency on your turn (no action required).

When you take this action and at the start of each of your turns while playing the frequency, objects made of the specified material within 15 feet of you that aren't being worn or carried take Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier. Constructs or Elementals made predominantly of a single material, such as metal or stone, and components of objects, such as the metal lock of a door, can also be damaged by a resonant frequency.

10.name: Resonator (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: As a Bonus Action, you can throw a concussive explosive at your feet. Each Large or smaller creature of your choice within 10 feet of you can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.

14.name: Resonator (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: When you prime a Bomb and use its __Explode__ property, you can spend 4 Reagents to create a reverb explosion. If the Bomb deals damage, all if its damage dice decrease by 1 step (d12s → d10s → d8s → d6s → d4s, to a minimum of d4s). At the start of your next turn, the explosion occurs again with the same area and damage, but its damage dice are decreased by a further 1 step.

3.name: Venomsmith (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Cripple Your Foes with Deadly Poisons*

For every Alchemist that devotes their life to healing the sick, another hears a darker calling. Commonly called poisoners or Venomsmiths, these Alchemists are masters in the art of crafting deadly and debilitating poisons. Whether employed by an assassin's guild or performing assassinations themselves, a Venomsmith's presence is usually accompanied by untimely death.

__Poisoner (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain the Alchemy of Poison discovery and can ignore the prerequisite of Alchemist level 5 for brewing poisons. This discovery doesn't count against your number of discoveries known, and you can't later replace this discovery with a different one.

__Laughing Gas Bombs (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You gain the Laughing Gas Bomb formula, which doesn't count against your total number of formulae known. If you already have it, gain another formula of your choice. For you, the Bomb is improved in the following ways.

3.name: Improved Damage
3.value: All of this Bomb's damage dice are d10s.

3.name: Side-Splitter
3.value: A creature that rolls a 1 on the d20 for its saving throw against the __Explode__ property of this Bomb has the Prone condition and its Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn.

6.name: Venomsmith (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: You have a specially-designed needle ring for poisoning others. You can use a Bonus Action to deal 1 Piercing damage to a creature within 5 feet of you, subjecting the creature to contact and injury poisons on the ring. You have Advantage on Dexterity (*Sleight of Hand* and *Stealth*) checks made to conceal and use this ring.

10.name: Venomsmith (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: By administering small doses of poisons and toxins to yourself, you have Immunity to Poison damage and the Poisoned condition.

14.name: Venomsmith (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to unleash a spray of poisonous vapor. The attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Alchemist save DC or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While it has the condition, the creature takes **1d10** Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

3.name: Xenoalchemist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
3.value: *Harvest Monsters and Attach Grafts*

A small number of renegade Alchemists elect to experiment on themselves, modifying their anatomy or even outright attaching new body parts. These experimenters are often considered unethical and dangerous, even by other Alchemists, and those that practice them are branded Xenoalchemists for their efforts. As Xenoalchemists progress in their studies, they invariably stumble upon the dangerous practice of alchemical necromancy, which allows them to imbue life upon amalgamations of body parts.

__Xenobiology (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: You also gain proficiency in one of these skills of your choice: *Arcana*, *Nature*, or *Medicine*. Additionally, you have Advantage on all ability checks you make to identify or research monsters.
__Mad Scientist (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: Your experiments in xenoalchemy grant you the following benefits.

3.name: Two Grafts
3.value: You gain two Common or Uncommon monstrous grafts of your choice. Beast's Hide and Climbing Apparatus are recommended. Monstrous grafts are detailed at the end of the class description.

3.name: Painless Attachment
3.value: You don't lose Hit Dice from installing or removing grafts, and it takes you no time to recover after the attachment of a new graft.

3.name: Intelligent Grafts
3.value: You can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attacks and damage of Unarmed Strikes that are improved by a graft, such as Bestial Weapons. If a graft forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your Alchemist save DC.

__Sleep Bomb [Formula] (VALDAALCHEMIST)__: By adding a tranquilizer to your Bomb, you can change it into a Sleep Bomb. This Bomb deals no damage. When you use the Bomb's __Explode__ property, each creature within the explosion makes a Wisdom saving throw, instead of Dexterity. A target hit by this Bomb or that fails its saving throw against it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The condition ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the Bomb's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this Bomb. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw against the Bomb is Immune to its conditions for 24 hours.
You can use this formula a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once) and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Xenoalchemist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
6.value: You can take the Study action to examine a creature as a Bonus Action. You learn the target's creature type and make a DC 15 Intelligence check using a skill from the Examine Specimen table, corresponding to the target's creature type. If you succeed, you learn one of the following pieces of information of your choice about the target: its AC, Immunities, Resistances, and whether it is *Bloodied*.
Whether you succeed or fail, you can't use this feature again to target that creature or another creature of its specific kind (such as humans or unicorns) until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

table.title: Examine Specimen
rows: Aberrations, Constructs, Elementals, Fey, and Monstrosities

10.name: Xenoalchemist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
10.value: You've augmented your body with reanimated organs that persist after your death. If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to a number of Hit Points equal to your Alchemist level.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Xenoalchemist (VALDAALCHEMIST) Features
14.value: Your research into necromancy has culminated in golem stitched together from discarded body parts. This golem uses the __Alchemy Golem__ stat block.

14.name: Creating or Replacing the Golem
14.value: You can make a golem using 3 Humanoid corpses in a process that requires 8 hours of work, which can be done during a Long Rest. If you already have a golem from this feature, the old one dies when the new one is completed.

14.name: Golem in Combat
14.value: The golem is under your control and is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it takes its turn immediately before or after your turn each round (your choice). You can take a Bonus Action to mentally command the golem if it is within 500 feet of you. If you issue no commands, the golem takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm.

14.name: Golem Grafts
14.value: You can attach up to three monstrous grafts to the golem.

14.name: Restoring the Golem
14.value: If the golem has died within the last hour, you can take a Magic action to touch it and expend 1 Reagents. The golem returns to life with a number of Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Intelligence modifier.

1.name: Class Features
1.value: You have survived the Hunter's Bane, a dangerous ritual that alters your blood and allows you to use it to channel your life essence to perform magic known as hemocraft.
When one of your blood curses or blood hunter features requires a saving throw, the DC is equal to 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

1.name: Hemocraft die
1.value: You have a hemocraft die, which is a d6. The die increases in size at Blood Hunter level 5, 11 and 17. Your Blood Hunter features and blood curses use the hemocraft die in various ways.

1.name: Blood Curses
1.value: You learn 2 blood curses from the Blood Curse Options list. You learn an additional blood curse at Blood Hunter level 6, 10, 14 and 18. Each time you learn a new blood curse, you can also choose one of the blood curses you know and replace it with another blood curse. Your subclass also grants you a special blood curse at a later level.

1.name: Number of Uses
1.value: You can use this feature to invoke your blood curses twice, choosing which effect to use from those you know. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You gain an additional use when you reach Blood Hunter level 6 (3 uses), 13 (4 uses), and 17 (5 uses).

1.name: Amplify
1.value: Blood curses can consume life essence to produce stronger effects. When you use your Hemocraft to invoke a blood curse, you can amplify it and lose a number of hit points equal to one roll of your hemocraft die, and apply the amplify effect onto the target of your blood curse. The first time you amplify a blood curse after finishing a Short or Long Rest, you gain the amount of hit points lost as temporary hit points.
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Shortswords and Light Crossbows.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties of Whips and Handaxes.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: You learn a rite that allows you to draw elemental power from your own blood, enhancing your weapons' attacks. Choose one Crimson Rite from the list below. You choose another crimson rite at Blood Hunter level 7 and 14. Whenever you gain a Crimson Rite, you can replace one of your Crimson Rite options with another.
As a bonus action, you can activate a crimson rite you know onto any number of weapons you are holding. When you do so, you lose hit points equal to one roll of your hemocraft die.

While the rite is activated and you wield the weapon, the weapon's attacks deal extra damage equal to your hemocraft die. The damage type is determined by the rite you choose to activate. Each weapon can only have one rite active, and the rite lasts until the end of a Short or Long Rest, if you choose to activate a different rite on a weapon with the rite active, or if you dismiss the rite.

2.name: Rite of the Flame
2.value: The extra damage dealt by your rite is Fire damage.

2.name: Rite of the Frozen
2.value: The extra damage dealt by your rite is Cold damage.

2.name: Rite of the Storm
2.value: The extra damage dealt by your rite is Lightning damage.

2.name: Rite of the Dead
2.value: The extra damage dealt by your rite is Necrotic damage. (Prerequisite: 14th level)

2.name: Rite of the Oracle
2.value: The extra damage dealt by your rite is Psychic damage. (Prerequisite: 14th level)

2.name: Rite of the Roar
2.value: The extra damage dealt by your rite is Thunder damage. (Prerequisite: 14th level)
You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below.

2.name: Mutagenic Warrior
2.value: You learn two mutagen formulae from the Order of the Mutant subclass. You can concoct a single mutagen from the formulae you know with your Alchemist's Supplies when you finish a Long Rest, which become inert when you finish a Long Rest.
You can consume the mutagen as a Bonus Action, which lasts until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain a Blood Hunter subclass of your choice. The Order of the Ghostslayer, Order of the Lycan, Order of the Mutant and Order of the Profane Soul are detailed after this class's description. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Blood Hunter level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Blood Hunter levels 8, 12, and 16.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: When you damage a creature with a weapon which has an active crimson rite, you can sear a brand of blood onto it. You always know the direction to the branded creature as long as it's on the same plane as you. Further, each time the branded creature deals damage to you or a creature you can see within 10 feet of you, the branded creature takes psychic damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

Your brand lasts until you dismiss it or until you use this feature to apply a brand to another creature. Your brand can be dispelled with __dispel magic__, and is treated as a spell with a level equal to half your blood hunter level (maximum 9th level). When the branded creature dies while on the same plane as you, you can benefit from one of the following effects of your choice:
You can use this feature twice, You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Breathe the Soul
6.value: You regain one expended use of your Hemocraft.

6.name: Consume the Flesh
6.value: You regain hit points equal to two rolls of your Hemocraft die plus your Intelligence modifier.

6.name: Drink the Blood
6.value: You end any one condition or magical effect that is currently affecting you.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: You gain a feature from your Blood Hunter Subclass.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Blood Hunter levels 12, and 16.

9.name: Class Features
9.value: You have the __Identify__ spell prepared. You can cast this spell as a Bonus Action twice, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast this spell as a Bonus Action by expending a use of your Hemocraft. When you cast this on a creature, you also learn any Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities it has, as well as its creature type.

You can choose to amplify this spell as if it was a blood curse. When you do so, you can target a location you are in instead of an object or creature, and identify if the place is consecrated or desecrated, such as from the __Hallow__ spell. Additionally, you may experience a brief vision of the past concerning the creature, location, or object. This vision is either some sinister or tragic event the target was involved in, if the target has such a history.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: Your speed increases by 10 feet, and you have a bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1).

11.name: Class Features
11.value: You gain a feature from your Blood Hunter Subclass.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Blood Hunter level 16.

13.name: Class Features
13.value: The psychic damage from your Brand of Castigation increases to twice your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 2) and the branded creature now suffers the damage from the brand if it deals damage to you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you.
Additionally, you can choose one of the following effects, which apply to a branded creature:

13.name: Corruption
13.value: Whenever the branded creature would regain hit points in any way other than taking a Short or Long Rest, it takes 2d6 necrotic damage.

13.name: Tethering
13.value: The branded creature can't take the Dash action, and if it attempts to teleport or to leave its current plane by any means, it takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the attempt to teleport or leave the plane fails.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: Your will resists manipulation. You are immune to being charmed or frightened.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: You gain a feature from your Blood Hunter Subclass.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: Your searing brand and blood curses work as one. Once per brand, when you invoke a blood curse on a creature branded by your Brand of Castigation, you can amplify the blood curse without losing hit points. You still gain the temporary hit points you would've gained from losing hit points when you amplify a blood curse this way.
Additionally, when you amplify a blood curse, its range is doubled.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: You gain a feature from your Blood Hunter Subclass.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. __Boon of Truesight__ is recommended.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: Your mastery of blood magic reaches its height, mitigating your sacrifice and empowering your expertise. Whenever a blood hunter feature requires you to roll a hemocraft die, you can roll the die twice and use either roll.
Additionally, you regain all expended uses of your Brand of Castigation when you finish a Short Rest.

3.name: Ghostslayer (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
3.value: Ghostslayers are among the oldest of blood hunter orders. They study death and life in order to understand the unholy magic of undeath. Ghostslayers walk the divide to slay those that reside in that divide.

__Rite Of The Dawn (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You learn the Rite of the Dawn as part of your Crimson Rite feature. When you activate the Rite of the Dawn, the extra damage dealt by your rite is radiant damage. Additionally, while that rite is active on your weapon, you gain the following benefits:

entries: Your weapon sheds Bright Light out to a range of 20 feet.
You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
When you hit an Undead creature with a weapon for which the Rite of the Dawn is active, you roll an additional hemocraft die when determining the extra damage from the rite.

3.value: __Curse Specialist (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You can invoke two blood curses with a single Bonus Action or Reaction. Each blood curse still consumes a separate use of your Hemocraft feature.

7.name: Ghostslayer (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
7.value: At the start of your turn, you can step into the veil between the planes. For 1 minute, you can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, as well as see and affect creatures and objects on the Ethereal Plane. You take 1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside an object. If you are inside an object when this feature ends, you are immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and you take force damage equal to twice the number of feet you moved.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain another use when you reach Blood Hunter level 15.

11.name: Ghostslayer (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
11.value: Whenever you hit a branded creature with a weapon for which you have an active crimson rite, you roll an additional hemocraft die when determining the extra damage from the rite. Additionally, if a branded creature has the Incorporeal Movement trait or a similar feature, it can't move through creatures or objects while branded.

15.name: Ghostslayer (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
15.value: You can expend one use of your Hemocraft to invoke a special blood curse as a Bonus Action. Choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you that is Charmed, Frightened, or possessed. The target creature is no longer Charmed, Frightened, or possessed.

15.name: Amplify
15.value: The creature that Charmed, Frightened, or possessed the target of your curse suffers 3d6 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

18.name: Ghostslayer (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
18.value: You learn to protect your fading life by reabsorbing the energy you feed to your weapons. If you have one or more crimson rites active and you are reduced to 0 hit points but don't die outright, you can choose to have all your active crimson rites end and drop to 1 hit point instead.

3.name: Lycan (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
3.value: Lycanthropes are feared around the world, and the Lycans understand this more than anyone. Wielding the blood of the beasts, they strike fear in their foes and rend them without restraint.

__Hybrid Transformation (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You have the curse of lycanthropy in your veins, and you control it to the best of your ability. As a Bonus Action, you can transform into a hybrid form for up to 1 hour. You can speak, use equipment, and wear armor while in this form, and can revert to your normal form as a Bonus Action. You automatically revert to your normal form if you fall unconscious or die.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. While you are transformed, you gain the following features:

3.name: Feral Might
3.value: You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and you have a +1 bonus to melee damage rolls. This bonus increases by 1 when you reach Blood Hunter level 11 (+2) and 18 (+3).

3.name: Resilient Hide
3.value: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage not made with silvered weapons. Additionally, while you are not wearing heavy armor, you have a +1 bonus to AC.

3.name: Predatory Strikes
3.value: You can apply your Crimson Rite feature to your Unarmed Strikes, which you treat as a weapon. You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes, which deal 1d6 bludgeoning or slashing damage (your choice). This damage increases to 1d8 at Blood Hunter level 11. When you use the Attack action to make an Unarmed Strike, you can make one additional Unarmed Strike as part of that action.

3.name: Bloodlust
3.value: If you start your turn Bloodied, you must succeed on a DC 8 Wisdom saving throw or move directly toward the nearest creature and use the Attack action against that creature. If you're concentrating on a spell or are under an effect that prevents you from concentrating (such as the barbarian's Rage feature), you automatically fail this saving throw.

If you have your Extra Attack feature, you can choose whether to use it for this frenzied attack. If more than one creature is equally near to you, roll randomly to determine your target. Once your attack is resolved, you regain control of yourself.

7.name: Lycan (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
7.value: The lycanthropy in you strengthens your body, granting you the following benefits.

7.name: Enhanced Musculature
7.value: Your speed is increased by 10 feet, and you add 10 feet to your long jump distance and 3 feet to your high jump distance.

7.name: Improved Predatory Strikes
7.value: While in your hybrid form, you have a +1 bonus to attack rolls made with your unarmed strike. This bonus increases by 1 when you reach Blood Hunter level 11 (+2) and 18 (+3).

11.name: Lycan (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
11.value: You continue to progress deeper into the curse's effects, granting you the following benefits.

11.name: Hybrid Control
11.value: You can use your Hybrid Transformation feature twice, instead of once, between rests.

11.name: Lycan Regeneration
11.value: At the start of each of your turns when you are Bloodied and have at least 1 hit point, you gain hit points equal to 1 + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). If you are in hybrid form, you gain these hit points before you must make the saving throw for your Bloodlust.

15.name: Lycan (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
15.value: Your Brand of Castigation can now bind a foe to your hunter's ferocity. While in your hybrid form, you have advantage on attack rolls against a creature branded by you.

You can expend one use of your Hemocraft to invoke a special blood curse as a Magic Action. You unleash a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature in a 30-foot Emanation from you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened of you until the end of your next turn. If a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is Stunned while Frightened in this way. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to this blood curse for the next 24 hours.
You can choose any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by the howl.

15.name: Amplify
15.value: You instead invoke this blood curse as a Bonus Action.

18.name: Lycan (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
18.value: You can use your Hybrid Transformation feature an unlimited number of times, and your hybrid form lasts until you revert to your normal form, fall unconscious, or die.
Additionally, you have advantage on the saving throw for your Bloodlust.

3.name: Martyr (ORDEROFTHEMARTYR) Features
3.value: Martyrs never break the skin when drawing upon their powers. Instead, they inflict psychic pain upon themselves, or take the pain felt by others, in order to turn this suffering into power. This has led to the tell-tale sign of these hunters being the tears that stream down their faces when they draw forth their blood magic.

__Martyrdom (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You have learned to draw the power of blood magic through emotional pain rather than physical wounds. Whenever you roll your Hemocraft Die to determine damage, whether to yourself or to another creature, you deal Psychic damage instead of Necrotic damage. Damage dealt to yourself by your Hemocraft Die cannot be reduced in any way.

Additionally, whenever you roll your Hemocraft Die to take damage in order to activate your Crimson Rite, you can choose to roll your Hemocraft Die twice and take the higher result. When you do so, you also roll your Hemocraft Die twice and choose the higher result every time you deal the extra damage associated with your chosen Rite.

__Pain Adept (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: Your particular experience with pain renders suffering of the body trivial. You gain Resistance to Necrotic damage and the Defense Fighting Style Feat. Additionally, when you roll a Hit Die to recover Hit Points, you also roll your Hemocraft Die and add it to the total Hit Points you heal. At level 10, you no longer roll your Hemocraft Die and instead add the highest possible result of the roll to the total Hit Points you heal.

7.name: Martyr (ORDEROFTHEMARTYR) Features
7.value: You are able to siphon the pain someone felt at the moment of their death, gaining it as your own strength. Whenever a creature within 30 feet of you dies, you can use your Reaction to roll the dead creature's Hit Die and gain the number rolled as Temporary Hit Points.

11.name: Martyr (ORDEROFTHEMARTYR) Features
11.value: Your particular school of hemocraft allows you to channel the pain of others into yourself to empower your hemomancy. When a creature branded by your Brand of Castigation deals damage to a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to take half of the damage that creature would have taken (rounded down). As part of this same Reaction, you can choose between the following effects, which take place immediately after you take this damage:

entries: You inflict Psychic damage on the branded creature equal to one roll of your Hemocraft Die plus your Hemocraft Modifier.
You activate an ability that requires you to roll your Hemocraft Die and take the damage rolled, without taking any additional damage.

15.name: Martyr (ORDEROFTHEMARTYR) Features
15.value: You can expend one use of your Hemocraft to invoke a special blood curse. As a Bonus Action, Select a number of creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see equal to Hemocraft Modifier. Those creatures have Resistance to Necrotic damage until the end of your next turn.

15.name: Amplify
15.value: The creatures that have gained Resistance to Necrotic damage through this Blood Curse gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage you took when amplifying this Blood Curse. These creatures keep their Resistance until they lose all of the Temporary Hit Points granted by this Blood Curse.

18.name: Martyr (ORDEROFTHEMARTYR) Features
18.value: You become the epitome of martyrdom. When you reach 0 Hit Points, choose one of the following:

entries: You immediately become stable. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Hemocraft Modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

You rise again for a number of turns equal to your Hemocraft Modifier. You remain at 0 Hit Points, you cannot benefit from any healing, and you are Immune to all damage types, including from your own Hemocraft Die. You can still use any abilities activated by rolling your Hemocraft Die but you treat the result of the roll as a 0 for the purposes of inflicting damage to yourself. While you are in this state you cannot take reactions and you can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. At the end of the last turn, you instantly die, and your corpse is under the effects of the spell Gentle Repose. After you use this ability, roll your Hemocraft Die; you can't use this ability again until you finish a number of Long Rests equal to the number rolled on your Hemocraft Die.

3.name: Mutant (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
3.value: Those of the Order of the Mutant have pushed the boundaries of self-experimentation. Warping their very bodies and minds, Mutants consume alchemical concoctions to adapt to any circumstance, whether it is the battlefield or the ballroom.
__Mutagencraft (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You learn to modify your mind and body using forbidden alchemical formulas known as mutagens.

3.name: Formulae
3.value: You learn 4 mutagen formulae from the Mutagen Options list. You learn one additional formulae at Blood Hunter level 7, 11, 15, and 18. When you learn a new mutagen formula, you can replace one formula you already know with a new mutagen formula.

3.name: Mutagens
3.value: You prepare mutagens using your Alchemist's Supplies for various situations. When you finish a Long Rest, you can concoct 3 mutagens from the formulae you know with your Alchemist's Supplies. You can concoct one additional mutagen after a Long Rest when you reach Blood Hunter Level 11 (concoct 4 mutagens) and 18 (concoct 5 mutagens). Each mutagen must be a different one, you can't concoct the same mutagen multiple times.

When you finish a Short Rest, you can concoct one mutagen from the formulae you know with your Alchemist's Supplies. This mutagen must not be one you have currently concocted, though it can be one you have already consumed.

3.name: Consuming Mutagens
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can consume a mutagen you have concocted, gaining the effects of the mutagen, which lasts until you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can have one mutagen affecting you at a time. You can have an additional mutagen affecting you at one time when you reach Blood Hunter level 7 (two mutagens) and 15 (three mutagens). When you consume another mutagen past your limit, you choose a mutagen to purge, and it no longer affects you.
Mutagens are concocted to your biology, and have no effect on other creatures. Mutagens you have concocted are unstable by nature, and become inert when you finish a Long Rest.

7.name: Mutant (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
7.value: Your body adapts to the venoms and toxins injected into your body. You gain Resistance to Poison damage and have advantage on saving throws made against being Poisoned.

11.name: Mutant (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
11.value: Your mutagenic hemocraft lets your Brand of Castigation reveal a foe's true nature. Any illusion or invisibility in effect on a creature when you brand it ends, and the creature can't benefit from invisibility or illusion effects while branded by you. If a creature branded by you is in an alternative form (such as through the __Polymorph__ spell, the Change Shape action, Shapechanger trait, the Wild Shape feature, and similar effects) or it attempts to alter its form, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or revert to its true form and be Stunned until the end of your next turn.

15.name: Mutant (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
15.value: You can expend one use of your Hemocraft to invoke a special blood curse. As a Bonus Action, you cause a creature within 30 feet of you to become Poisoned. The cursed creature can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the curse on itself on a success.

15.name: Amplify
15.value: The cursed creature takes 4d6 necrotic damage when you inflict this curse, and it takes this damage again each time it fails a Constitution saving throw to end the curse.

18.name: Mutant (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
18.value: Your body can produce mutagens at a whim. At the start of your turn, choose one mutagen currently affecting you. Its effects end, and you can immediately have a mutagen you know the formula for take effect in its place.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Profane Soul (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
3.value: The Profane Soul draws magic from many different creatures. They do this in many different ways; some form pacts, some siphon energies, and some bind their souls with them. Otherworldly threats require otherworldly power to deal with.

__Otherworldly Attunement (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You draw magic from certain kinds of creatures, which fuel your abilities. Choose a creature type from the following list. You gain a benefit related to that creature type. When you finish a Long Rest, you can choose to draw magic from a different creature type, and change your choice.

3.name: Abberration
3.value: When you cast a spell with a Pact Magic spell slot, or you score a critical hit with a weapon with an active Crimson Rite, you can cause creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you to become Charmed by you until the end of your next turn. A creature affected by this effect is immune to it for 1 hour.

3.name: Celestial
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Hemocraft and choose a creature within 60 feet of you. That creature regains a number of hit points equal to one roll of your hemocraft die plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

3.name: Elemental
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Hemocraft and gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet. This speed lasts a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

3.name: Fey
3.value: When you damage a creature with your Crimson Rite, that creature glows with faint light until the end of your next turn. For the duration, the creature gains no benefit from any cover or from being invisible.

3.name: Fiend
3.value: When you damage a creature with your Crimson Rite, you can reroll any 1 or 2 rolled as part of the attack's damage, and you must use the new roll.

3.name: Undead
3.value: When you cast a spell with a Pact Magic spell slot, or you score a critical hit with a weapon with an active Crimson Rite, you can cause creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you to become Frightened by you until the end of your next turn. A creature affected by this effect is immune to it for 1 hour.
__Pact Magic (BLOODHUNTER2024)__: You have learned to cast spells. See chapter 7 for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules as a Profane Soul.

3.name: Cantrips
3.value: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Warlock spell list. Eldritch Blast and Mind Sliver are recommended.
When you reach Blood Hunter level 10, you learn another Warlock cantrip of your choice.

3.name: Spell Slots
3.value: The Profane Soul Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended Pact Magic slots when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
3.value: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 spells from the Warlock spell list. Armor of Agathys and Hex are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Blood Hunter levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Profane Soul Spellcasting table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the Warlock spell list until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 7 Blood Hunter, your list of prepared spells can include four Warlock spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.

3.name: Changing your Prepared Spells
3.value: Whenever you gain a Blood Hunter level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Warlock spell for which you have spell slots.

3.name: Spellcasting Ability
3.value: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Warlock spells.

3.name: Spellcasting Focus
3.value: You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Warlock spells.

7.name: Profane Soul (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
7.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a casting of one of your Warlock cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

You prepare a spell related to the creature type you chose for your Otherworldly Attunement. When you change your choice, the spell you prepare wth this feature also changes. You can also cast the prepared spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

7.name: Aberration
7.value: You have the __Detect Thoughts__ spell prepared.

7.name: Celestial
7.value: You have the __Lesser Restoration__ spell prepared.

7.name: Elemental
7.value: You have the __Dragon's Breath__ spell prepared.

7.name: Fey
7.value: You have the __Blur__ spell prepared.

7.name: Fiend
7.value: You have the __Heat Metal__ spell prepared.

7.name: Undead
7.value: You have the __Blindness/Deafness__ spell prepared.

11.name: Profane Soul (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
11.value: Your Brand of Castigation feature digs dark arcane scars into your target, leaving them vulnerable to your magic. A creature branded by you has disadvantage on saving throws against your warlock spells.

Eldritch energies react to your rites, giving you unnatural resilience. You have Resistance to the damage type of your active Crimson Rite. If you have multiple Crimson Rites active, you have Resistance to the damage type of the latest rite you activated.

15.name: Profane Soul (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
15.value: You prepare another spell related to the creature type you chose for your Otherworldly Attunement. When you change your choice, the spell you prepare wth this feature also changes. You can also cast the prepared spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

15.name: Aberration
15.value: You have the __Haste__ spell prepared.

15.name: Celestial
15.value: You have the __Revivify__ spell prepared.

15.name: Elemental
15.value: You have the __Protection from Energy__ spell prepared.

15.name: Fey
15.value: You have the __Slow__ spell prepared.

15.name: Fiend
15.value: You have the __Fireball__ spell prepared.

15.name: Undead
15.value: You have the __Bestow Curse__ spell prepared.

18.name: Profane Soul (BLOODHUNTER2024) Features
18.value: You can expend on use of your Hemocraft to invoke a special blood curse. When a creature that isn't a construct or undead is reduced to 0 hit points within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to absorb their life energy and empower yourself. Until the end of your next turn, you make attacks with advantage and you have resistance to all damage.

18.name: Amplify
18.value: Additionally, you regain an expended Pact Magic spell slot. Once you've amplified this blood curse, you must finish a Long Rest before you can amplify it again.
