1.name: Class Features
1.value: You learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called Battle Dice.

1.name: Battle Dice
1.value: You have two Battle Dice, which are d6s. A Battle Die is expended when you use it. You regain all expended Battle Dice when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest. Your Battle Die changes and more Battle Dice become available as shown on the Battle Dice column of the Captain Features table.

1.name: Maneuvers
1.value: You can expend Battle Dice to perform maneuvers. Your maneuver options are detailed later in the class description.

1.name: Saving Throws
1.value: If a maneuver requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus.
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Lances and Longswords.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: You gain a loyal Cohort who carries your banner and follows your lead.

2.name: Initiating a Cohort
2.value: Choose your Cohort's stat block from those listed later in the class description. Following an 8-hour initiation period, which can be done during a Long Rest, that creature becomes your Cohort until you initiate a new Cohort to replace it. You can have only one Cohort at a time.

2.name: Cohort in Combat
2.value: Your Cohort is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. In combat, your Cohort takes its turn immediately before or after your turn each round (your choice). Your Cohort uses your Charisma for its attack and damage rolls.

2.name: Cohort Save DC
2.value: If your Cohort forces a creature to make a saving throw, the DC is 8 plus your Charisma modifier and your Proficiency bonus.

2.name: Features
2.value: Your Cohort improves and gains new features when you reach certain Captain levels, as shown on the Captain Features table.

2.name: Proficiencies
2.value: Your Cohort has proficiency in skills and saving throws listed in its statistics. Your Cohort uses your Proficiency Bonus instead of its own. Because Cohort statistics already include a +2 Proficiency Bonus, you need only adjust skill and saving throw proficiencies starting at level 5.
You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.
Whenever you gain a Captain level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain a Captain subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Captain levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Captain level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: Once on each of your turns, you can direct your Cohort or an ally within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you. The chosen creature can take a Reaction to move up to its Speed or make one attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike.
Your Cohort improves and gains a new feature.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a feature from your Captain Subclass.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: Whenever you or your Cohort score a Critical Hit or reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you regain an expended Battle Die.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

9.name: Class Features
9.value: Your Cohort improves and gains a new feature.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a feature from your Captain Subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: Once per turn when you take the Attack action and hit with a weapon, you can deal an extra **2d8** damage to the target if your Cohort has dealt damage to that target since the end of your last turn. The extra damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

13.name: Class Features
13.value: Your Cohort improves and gains a new feature.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a feature from your Captain Subclass.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: Whenever you or your Cohort score a Critical Hit, each ally you choose within 30 feet of you gains Heroic Inspiration.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: Your Cohort improves and gains a new feature.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: When you use a maneuver that targets an ally, you can target a second ally within range without expending an additional Battle Die.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: Immediately after another creature's turn, you can choose yourself or an ally within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you to take a Legendary Action. This action is one of the following: Attack (one attack only), Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Hide, Magic (cast one cantrip only), or Utilize. A creature can only take one Legendary Action each round. When a creature takes the Dash or Disengage action in this way, the benefits of that action last until the end of the creature's next turn.
You can use this feature to take three Legendary Actions and regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Adrenaline Junkie (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: ***Level 3: Adrenaline.** You can't use an Adrenaline Battle Die with the Rally maneuver.*
*Live Fast, Die Young*
Adrenaline Junkies live for the thrill, taking on increasingly death-defying stunts until they grow bored of it all or it kills them...
*When you gain a Vagabond level, you can switch your subclass to Adrenaline Junkie...*
Adrenaline (VALDAVAGABOND)
Stim Potion (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Brigand (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Take What You Need at Knifepoint*

Brigands encompass all manner of highwaymen, pirates, raiders, and dastardly folk. No tactic, no matter how heinous, is off the table for a band of Brigands, whether that means roadside ambushes or taking hostages at knifepoint. Ultimately, most Brigands are driven to their thievery through desperation; it is fitting that they leave others as few choices as were afforded to them.
Ambush [Maneuver] (VALDAVAGABOND)
Craven (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Daggermark (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Use Stealth and Subterfuge to Achieve Victory*

Captains that bear the Daggermark—a tattoo, scar, or insignia representing a blade—utilize stealth and clandestine tactics to defeat their foes. Though they prefer ambushes and assassinations, they may acquiesce to direct confrontation if they have an underhanded tactic up their sleeve to safeguard victory. These Captains might be leaders in a Thieves' Guild, career assassins, or bandit captains that mark their closest confidants with the Daggermark to induct them into their ranks.
__Covert Tactics (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Your experience in striking from the shadows grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Roguish Proficiencies
3.value: You gain proficiency with the *Sleight of Hand* and *Stealth* skills.

3.name: Charismatic Initiative
3.value: You gain a bonus to Initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

3.name: Quick Hide
3.value: You can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

__Effortless Dodge [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Battle Die to take the Disengage or Dodge action. You can't use this maneuver while wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

6.name: Daggermark (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, the next attack roll made by an ally against the target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

10.name: Daggermark (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition. Your Cohort also gains the benefits of this feature.

14.name: Daggermark (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack against you, you can take a Reaction to make one attack with a weapon against the attacker. Resolve your attack before the triggering attack.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

3.name: Demon Brand (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Harness the Demon Within You*

Captains bearing an abyssal Demon Brand have struck the darkest of pacts: binding their soul to a demonic entity that periodically takes hold of their body. On the battlefield, they forgo the companionship of a Cohort and rely on a flickering symbiosis between themselves and their demon. The demon and Captain are two halves of the same creature, sharing a single body and parts of one soul.

__Demon Cohort (VALDACAPTAIN)__: A demonic entity takes up residence within your body. The demon is jealously possessive—it becomes your Cohort and you can't gain a new one. Unlike other Cohorts, the demon isn't a separate entity and doesn't take its own turn. Instead, you transform into the demon using the following rules.

3.name: Shape-Shift
3.value: You can use a Bonus Action to shape-shift into the demon or return to your normal form. While shape-shifted, your game statistics are replaced by the __Demon Cohort's__ stat block, but you retain your Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, class features, and feats. You choose whether your equipment merges into the demon or is worn by it.

3.name: Temporary Hit Points
3.value: When you are shape-shifted into the demon, you have Temporary Hit Points equal to the demon's Hit Points, which last until you return to your normal form. When you lose Temporary Hit Points, the demon loses an equal number of Hit Points. If you no longer have Temporary Hit Points or the demon is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you return to your normal form and can't shape-shift into the demon until the demon regains any Hit Points.

3.name: Demon in Combat
3.value: Unlike other Cohorts, the demon doesn't take a separate turn in combat.

3.name: Restoring the Demon
3.value: The demon gains the benefits of taking a Short or Long Rest as normal. Spells and other effects that restore Hit Points can target you or the demon while you are shape-shifted. When the demon regains Hit Points, the number of Temporary Hit Points it grants you increases by an equal number. If the demon is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it regains 1 Hit Point after 1 minute, allowing you to shape-shift into it again.

__Abyssal Arcana (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Your demonic connection grants you the ability to expend Battle Dice to cast the following spells without a spell slot. When you cast a spell using this feature, its duration is 1 minute if it were normally longer.

3.name: 1 Battle Die:
3.value: __Detect Magic__, __Disguise Self__, __Expeditious Retreat__, __Silent Image__

3.name: 2 Battle Dice:
3.value: __Alter Self__, __Darkness__, __Darkvision__, __Detect Thoughts__

3.name: 3 Battle Dice:
3.value: __Dispel Magic__, __Nondetection__, __Tongues__

6.name: Demon Brand (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: You have Blindsight with a range of 30 feet while shape-shifted and in your normal form.

10.name: Demon Brand (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to shape- shift into the demon or return to your normal form. You have Resistance to the triggering damage.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

14.name: Demon Brand (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: At the start of each of your turns, the demon regains Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Charisma modifier if it is *Bloodied*.

3.name: Dragon Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Defeat Your Foes with an Arsenal of Maneuvers*

Captains under the Dragon Banner are a scourge upon the battlefield. Armed with an array of lethal maneuvers, these captains cut through lesser combatants with ease, turning the tides of battle on their own, if needed. The visage of the Dragon Banner inspires fear and loyalty in equal measure, for the carnage left in a dragon warrior's wake speaks volumes of their skill.
__Critical Focus (VALDACAPTAIN)__: You enter a flow state in combat, granting you the following benefits.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.value: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

3.name: Chain Critical
3.value: Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points or score a Critical Hit against an enemy, your Critical Hit range increases. After the first such attack, your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20; after the second, you score a Critical Hit on a roll of 17-20; after the third, you score a Critical Hit on a roll of 16-20. Your Critical Hit range resets after 1 minute or when you have the Incapacitated condition.

__Rampage [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points or score a Critical Hit with a melee attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die to move up to your Speed and make a melee attack (no action required). On a hit, you add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll.

6.name: Dragon Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: You can use your Bonus Action to regain all of your expended Battle Dice.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Dragon Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points or score a Critical Hit against an enemy, you can strike terror into nearby foes. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Maneuver save DC. On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the Frightened creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

14.name: Dragon Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or Unarmed Strike, you can expend two Battle Dice as a Bonus Action to attempt to execute the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. If you reduce the target to 0 Hit Points, this maneuver doesn't expend any Battle Dice.

3.name: Eagle Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Deliver Shots with Pinpoint Accuracy*

With sharp eyes and even sharper arrows, Captains of the Eagle Banner seek to master bows, slings, and ballistae alike. Such Captains are just as dangerous in close range as they are perched on the horizon, for they can accurately deliver an arrow or a crossbow bolt at point blank range.
__Eagle Eye [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Once per turn when you miss with a ranged attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.

__Close-Quarters Shooting (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with Ranged weapons. Your Cohort also gains the benefits of this feature.

6.name: Eagle Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: Your skill at scaling walls and gaining a perch above your foes grants you the following benefits.

6.name: Climb Speed
6.value: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

6.name: High Ground Shot
6.value: When you make a ranged attack roll from an elevation of 15 feet or more above the target, you have Advantage on the roll.

10.name: Eagle Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: When an enemy you can see hits a creature with a ranged attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Battle Die to attempt to intercept the attack. You must be holding a Ranged weapon and the creature must be within your weapon's range to use this maneuver. Subtract the Battle Die from the attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

14.name: Eagle Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: When you take the Attack action with a Ranged weapon, you can replace one of your attacks with a flurry of projectiles in one of the following ways.

14.name: Arrow Rain
14.value: Choose a point within your weapon's range. You launch several projectiles that rain down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each target in that Cylinder.

14.name: Scatter Shot
14.value: You launch several projectiles in a 20- foot Cone. Make a separate ranged attack roll against each target in that Cone.

3.name: Experiment X (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Weird Science and Magical Mutations*

In a secret laboratory, unscrupulous magical scientists meddle in the affairs of gods. Their subjects are tormented with arcane serums and invasive tests until their very genetics give way and unlock untold power.
You were one such experiment, now escaped. Though you might not recall the faces of your captors, you know what they did to you and that you'll never be the same.
Bloody Rampage (VALDAVAGABOND)
Mutations (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Feylost (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Master Your Magical Mood Swings*

The Feywild is a labyrinth of winding, magical paths, leading to delightful glades and nightmarish grottos alike. Mortals that wander there often become lost, vanishing for decades before returning without having aged a day. However, they return with infectious fey enchantments that sometimes overwhelm their minds and the minds of those nearby.
Fey Moods (VALDAVAGABOND)
Frenzied Strike [Maneuver] (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Gourmand (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: ***Level 10: Quick Snack.** At the start of each of your turns, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll it, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending one Battle Die (no action required).*
*Cook Monsters into Culinary Masterpieces*

Gourmands travel the land in search of the perfect flavor. To this end, they scrounge up rare ingredients from far-off continents, hunt monsters for unique proteins, and tinker with their recipes wherever they travel.
Fine Cuisine (VALDAVAGABOND)
Monster Meal (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Holy Icon (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Champion a Divine Cause*

Captains adorned with a Holy Icon are the champions of a god or ideology, embarking on minor quests and holy crusades in furtherance of their ideals. Though not imbued with grand divine powers, they command a suite of lesser miracles to heal and strengthen their allies for the long road ahead and a surety of purpose to propel them onward.
__Theological Studies (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Your faith and force of personality grant you the following benefits.

3.name: Charismatic Religion
3.value: You gain proficiency in the *Religion* skill. Additionally, you gain a bonus to Intelligence (*Religion*) checks equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

3.name: Cantrips
3.value: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

__Minor Miracle (VALDACAPTAIN)__: A creature targeted by your Rally maneuver regains Hit Points equal to two rolls of your Battle Die plus your Charisma modifier. Additionally, you can use the Rally maneuver to heal a creature that has 0 Hit Points.
At Captain level 10, a creature targeted by your Rally maneuver regains Hit Points equal to four rolls of your Battle Dice plus your Charisma modifier.

6.name: Holy Icon (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: Your fanaticism motivates your allies, granting the following benefits.

6.name: Strength of Spirit
6.value: When you use your Blitz feature to command an ally that has the Charmed or Frightened condition, it can reroll its save against the effect causing that condition, ending the condition on itself on a success.

6.name: Radiant Strike
6.value: When you use your Blitz feature to command an ally to make an attack, the attack deals an extra **1d6** Radiant damage on a hit.

10.name: Holy Icon (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: As a Magic action, you can create a 15-foot Emanation originating from you, which lasts for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. When you or an ally starts its turn in the Emanation, that creature gains one of the following benefits of its choice. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend two Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

10.name: Temporary Hit Points
10.value: The creature gains 2d8 Temporary Hit Points.

10.name: Resistance
10.value: The creature has Resistance to a damage type of its choice other than Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage until the start of its next turn.

10.name: End Condition
10.value: The creature ends one condition on itself: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

14.name: Holy Icon (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: You can cast the spell __Raise Dead__ without a spell slot. If you revive a creature that was your Cohort, you also cast the spell without Material components. The creature becomes your Cohort once again, without an 8-hour initiation period.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Houndmaster (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value:
***Level 3: Faithful Hound.** The Hound is your Cohort and uses the rules in the Cohort feature. The Hound uses your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls. The Hound also has the Martial Excellence trait.*
***Level 5: Martial Excellence.** The hound has a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases to +2 at Captain level 9, and +3 at Captain level 13.*
*Travel the Land with a Good Dog at Your Side*

Stretching ever onward, the road is grueling and unforgiving. But, as Houndmasters know, it need not be lonely. A single dog, mankind's most loyal companion, can make all the difference in the world. Houndmasters are never found without their dogs, who both serve as inseparable companions and fearsome defenders as the need arises.
Faithful Hound (VALDAVAGABOND)
Sick 'Em! [Maneuver] (VALDAVAGABOND)
Desperate Companion (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Jolly Roger (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Command Your Crew on the High Seas*

The skull and crossbones of the Jolly Roger need no introduction: it means thieves, brigands, treasure, and adventure on the high seas. Moreover, it means the strong backs of a crew working in unison, piloting a ship from horizon to horizon under the command of a fierce captain and their first mate.

__Skirmish [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: When you make an attack using a weapon, you can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to make an attack using the same weapon or a different one later on the same turn. One attack must be a melee attack roll and the other must be a ranged attack roll.
__Scallywag (VALDACAPTAIN)__: You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and your Cohort has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

6.name: Jolly Roger (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: Your elegant swordplay puts enemies where you want them. Whenever you hit a creature of Large size or smaller with a Melee weapon, you can force the target to move to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it, and you can move 5 feet. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

10.name: Jolly Roger (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a Melee weapon, you can use one of the following effects.

10.name: Flank
10.value: Your Cohort has Advantage on the next melee attack roll it makes against the target while you are within 5 feet of it before the end of your next turn.

10.name: Pocket Sand
10.value: The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of your next turn.

10.name: Trip
10.value: The target has the Prone condition if it is Large or smaller.

14.name: Jolly Roger (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: At your directive, your crew works in perfect unison. As a Bonus Action, you can issue a series of directives to allies within 30 feet of yourself that can see or hear you. Each ally has Advantage on the next D20 test it makes before the start of your next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Knight Errant (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Uphold Your Chivalrous Values*

Knights that have failed, forsaken, or betrayed their masters are known as Knights Errant. Though they no longer follow the dictates of a lord, these knights are usually reluctant to abandon their vows of ethics entirely. Many wander the lands seeking out honorable quests and worthy adversaries, for disgraced knights are knights nonetheless.
Chivalrous Oath (VALDAVAGABOND)
Knight's Challenge (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Lion Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Lead with Heroism and Zeal*

Captains who fly the Lion Banner are consummate leaders with forceful personalities and a penchant for heroics. Such Captains lead from the front, flying their banner high in battles where valor and luck turn the tide in their favor.
__Commanding Presence (VALDACAPTAIN)__: If you use your Born Leader maneuver and the check still fails, you don't expend the Battle Die to use the maneuver.

__Challenge [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to goad the target into attacking you. Add the Battle Die to the attack's damage roll. Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you while you are within 5 feet of the target.

6.name: Lion Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: You can use your Morale Boost maneuver when two or more creatures, including yourself, simultaneously fail a saving throw against the same effect, such as a dragon's breath weapon. Each creature that failed its saving throw gains the benefit of Morale Boost, and you only expend one Battle Die.

10.name: Lion Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: When a creature under the effect of your Challenge maneuver hits you with an attack, you can take a Reaction to gain Resistance to the attack's damage for that attack and make an attack against that creature using a weapon or Unarmed Strike as a part of the same Reaction.

14.name: Lion Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: When you use your Bolster or Rally maneuver, the target gains Heroic Inspiration if it doesn't already have it.

3.name: Plague Doctor (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Cure Sickness with Brutal Medical Practices*
As maladies sweep the countryside, plague doctors follow close behind. Wielding brutal medical instruments and techniques to balance the humors, plague doctors inspire hope and fear in equal measure.
Physician (VALDAVAGABOND)
Remedy [Maneuver] (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Pugilist (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Crush Foes with Your Fists*

Knuckles crack and a meaty fist rears back to crush bone. Pugilists are hand-to-hand brawlers with a tolerance for pain and a willingness to inflict it at a moment's notice. Unlike martial artists that emphasize speed and precision, Pugilists leverage brute force in their blows. Why strike several times when once will do?
Hand-to-Hand (VALDAVAGABOND)
Shrug Off [Maneuver] (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Rōnin (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Master the Sword to Survive in a Harsh World*
You were once an honorable blademaster without peer. But those days are long gone...
Infamy (VALDAVAGABOND)
Grudge (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Siegeball Jersey (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Cheer and Coach Your Team to Victory*

Siegeball is a beloved sport, and Captains adorned with a Siegeball Jersey live and breathe it. Such Captains view the entire world through sports metaphors and place themselves in the privileged position of the team captain or perhaps the coach. Foes are naturally the opposing team, the referees, or even a rowdy crowd. Quests are no different from a sports season, in which the team is destined to break records and bring home the cup. For Siegeball Captains, sportsmanship and rowdy competition go hand-in-hand. One can expect rousing speeches and inappropriate jeers meted out between downfield sprints and breathtaking tackles.
__Sports Fanatic (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Your absolute devotion to your sport of choice grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Charismatic Athletics
3.value: You gain proficiency in the *Athletics* skill. Additionally, you gain a bonus to Strength (*Athletics*) checks equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

3.name: Number One Fan
3.value: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to recall information about a sport, its teams, and its players.

__Team Inspiration [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: You can take a Bonus Action to and inspire another creature within 60 feet of yourself who can see or hear you. Give that creature one of your unexpended Battle Dice. A creature can have only one Battle Die from this maneuver at a time.

Once within the next minute when the creature fails a D20 Test, the creature can roll the Battle Die and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success. A Battle Die is expended when it's rolled.

6.name: Siegeball Jersey (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: When you use your Blitz feature, you can direct your Cohort or an ally within 60 feet of yourself to take a Reaction to use one of the following options.

6.name: Defensive Tackle
6.value: The chosen ally moves up to its Speed and uses the Grapple or Shove option of its Unarmed Strike.

6.name: Go Long
6.value: The chosen ally moves up to twice its Speed.

6.name: Take Cover
6.value: The chosen ally moves up to its Speed and takes the Hide action. It has Advantage on its Dexterity (*Stealth*) check.

10.name: Siegeball Jersey (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: When you make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, you can make a Constitution saving throw with Advantage instead.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

14.name: Siegeball Jersey (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to delay the Unconscious condition. You can immediately move up to twice your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and take an action and a Bonus Action. Taking damage causes Death Saving Throw failures as normal, and three Death Saving Throw failures can still kill you. Following this, you have the Unconscious condition if you still have 0 Hit Points.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Skull Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Command a Loyal Undead Cohort*

Captains who fly the Skull Banner are grim heralds of an Undead tide. Their Cohorts and followers are shambling corpses or ethereal ghosts, hellbent on consuming and corrupting the living. Necromancers by any other name, Captains of the Skull possess little of the arcane talent beyond what is necessary to command an Undead army; little else is needed to make them formidable adversaries.

__Undead Cohort (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Instead of initiating a Cohort, you can perform a ritual over the course of 8 hours, which can be done during a Long Rest, to animate an Undead Cohort. Choose its stat block: __Corporeal Undead__ or __Incorporeal Undead__. You also choose what kind of Undead it is, such as a zombie or ghost, appropriate for the stat block.

__Horrific Strike [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to terrify the target. Add the Battle Dice to the attack's damage roll. The target has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

6.name: Skull Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: As a Bonus Action, can cast __Animate Dead__ without a spell slot targeting the corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid that has died within the last minute. When you cast the spell in this way, the Undead counts as your Cohort for your Captain features and uses your Charisma for its attack and damage rolls. This Undead lasts for 10 minutes, after which it crumbles into dust.

10.name: Skull Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: Whenever you are targeted by an attack while an Undead you control is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to command it to dive in the way of the attack, causing the attack to target the Undead instead.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

14.name: Skull Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: As a Magic action, you can release a burst of negative energy in a 30-foot Emanation centered on a corpse you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature you choose within the Emanation makes a Constitution saving throw against your Maneuver save DC, taking **10d8** Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Undead you control within the Emanation gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half of the Necrotic damage dealt.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Star Wolf (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Lead a Squadron of Allies to Victory*

Whether they lead a company of Grax's Guys, a band of Coalition mercenaries, or a crew of space pirates, Captains who emblazon their ships with the Star Wolf's iconography seek fame and fortune amongst the stars. Their hallmarks are daring gunplay and swift starship maneuvers that always keep them a hair ahead of their foes.

__Dodge Roll [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: You can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to move up to 15 feet and reload any Ranged weapon you are holding. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks and is unaffected by Difficult Terrain.

__Grazing Shot [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: When you miss with a ranged attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die (no action required) to deal damage to that creature equal to a roll of the die plus your Dexterity modifier (minimum). This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier. You can only deal this damage once per turn.

__Squadron Leader (VALDACAPTAIN)__: When you are the Pilot of a ship you can take a Bonus Action to adopt a formation with up to 5 allied ships within 10,000 feet of yourself. Ships remain in this formation as long as they remain within 10,000 feet of you. Ships in a formation gain the following benefits.

3.name: Barrel Roll
3.value: Each ship in the formation has a +2 bonus to Armor Class.

3.name: Initiative
3.value: Each ship has Advantage on Initiative rolls.

3.name: Synchronized Movement
3.value: Whenever you take the Move and Fire or Evasive Manuevers action, each ship in the formation can take the same action (no action required).

6.name: Star Wolf (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You can take a Bonus Action to mark a target you can see within 60 feet of yourself with a holographic reticle. The target remains marked for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. While marked, the target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover and has a -2 penalty to AC.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

10.name: Star Wolf (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you roll Initiative, you can make an attack with a Ranged weapon against a target you can see within 60 feet of yourself. On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on attacks during the first round of combat.

14.name: Star Wolf (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: When you use your Blitz feature to command an ally to make an attack with a weapon, the ally deals an extra **2d8** damage to a creature marked by your Target Designation. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.

3.name: Star-Spangled Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Represent the Greatest Democracy in the Multiverse*

Captains that wave the Star-Spangled Banner represent the ideals of Justice, Freedom, and Democracy wherever they travel. These values reflect the promise of a mythical land in which all people are prosperous and equal, which may or may not exist somewhere in the multiverse. With a unique shield-fighting technique and a penchant for diving headlong into danger, such Captains are either reckless idealogues or selfless heroes, depending on the situation.
__Patriotism (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Your unwavering devotion to the Stars and Stripes gives you the following benefits.

3.name: Heroic Anthem
3.value: You can cast __Heroism__ without a spell slot. Once you use this benefit to cast this spell, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

3.name: Second Amendment
3.value: You gain the ability to use the mastery property of a third kind of weapon of your choice.
__Shield Fighter (VALDACAPTAIN)__: You can use a Shield as a weapon with the following traits. When you throw a Shield, it ricochets back to your hand following a hit or miss.

3.name: Weapon Category:
3.value: Martial Melee

3.name: Damage on a Hit:
3.value: 1d8 Bludgeoning plus the ability modifier used for the attack roll

3.name: Properties:
3.value: Finesse, Thrown (range 20/60 feet)

3.name: Mastery:
3.value: __Push__

__Bull Rush [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack roll, you can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to perform a Bull Rush. The target takes extra Bludgeoning damage equal to the roll of the Battle Die, and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and have the Prone condition.

6.name: Star-Spangled Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. You can't use Blitz and use this feature on the same turn.

10.name: Star-Spangled Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: You can cast the spell __Freedom of Movement__ on yourself and your Cohort without a spell slot.

14.name: Star-Spangled Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: As a Bonus Action action, you can transform into an embodiment of freedom: a red, white, and blue spirit resembling a bald eagle carrying an enormous sword or gun. You gain the following benefits for 1 minute. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend three Battle Dice (no action required) to restore your use of it.

14.name: Deft Maneuver
14.value: You gain a special additional Bonus Action that you can take once on each of your turns. You can take this special Bonus Action only to use a maneuver.

14.name: Flight
14.value: You have a Fly Speed of 30 feet, and can hover.

14.name: Liberty or Death
14.value: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you can expend one Battle Die to drop to a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled on the die plus your Charisma modifier.

3.name: Tower Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Fortify Yourself and Your Allies*

The fortified defenses of Captains who fly the Tower Banner are legendary. Their tactics emphasize fortification and survival, as well-protected soldiers cannot only win battles, but entire wars. Thinking long term is key to any defensive strategy, as Captains of the Tower know the answer is never how they shall counterattack, but when.

__Iron Wall [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Battle Die to fortify yourself. The next time you are hit by an attack within the next minute, roll the Battle Die and add the number rolled to your AC against this attack, potentially causing it to miss. This effect ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition. You must be wearing Heavy armor to use this maneuver.
__Siege Defense (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Well-versed in repelling attackers, you gain the following benefits.

3.name: Defensive Tactics
3.value: When you attack with a Melee weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the __Push__ or __Slow__ property for that attack.

3.name: Shooting from Cover
3.value: You gain a +2 bonus to ranged attack rolls while in Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover.

6.name: Tower Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: When a creature you can see hits an ally within 5 feet of you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to force the attack to target you instead. If the attack roll equals or exceeds your AC, the attack hits you instead; otherwise, it misses.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

10.name: Tower Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: Your determination allows you to shrug off effects that would otherwise harm you. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition. Your Cohort also gains the benefits of this feature.

14.name: Tower Banner (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you misses you with an attack roll, you can strike them with a Shield if you're carrying one (no action required), dealing **3d6** Bludgeoning damage to the attacker.

3.name: Troubadour (VALDAVAGABOND) Features
3.value: *Inspire Your Allies Wherever You Travel*

A lyre, a flute, or perhaps a set of bagpipes at their side, a Troubadour sets out on the open road, playing music wherever they go. While Troubadours often travel in musical troupes, they might also ply their trade alone, wandering between taverns and street corners in search of an audience, coin, and perhaps fame.
Folk Musician (VALDAVAGABOND)
Inspiring Tune [Maneuver] (VALDAVAGABOND)
Cross-Compatible Subclass: This subclass originates from the __Vagabond__ class
Note that cross-compatible subclasses might be stronger or weaker than other subclasses.
The GM decides if a subclass should be cross-compatible in your campaign.

3.name: Yellow Sign (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
3.value: *Enthrall Your Friends and Foes with Eldritch Madness*

The Yellow Sign is a twisting symbol of eldritch chaos, the signature of an otherworldly leviathan ready to consume all of reality. Captains bearing its distinctive mark upon their Shields and armor aren't commanders—they are cult leaders dedicated to incomprehensible alien masters. Their objectives are as secretive as they are disquieting, but undoubtedly demand indoctrination of more thralls to spread their master's sign and influence.

__Frenzied Strike [Maneuver] (VALDACAPTAIN)__: When you hit a creature with an attack using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to infect the target's mind. The creature has the Frenzied condition until the end of its next turn.

A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an Opportunity Attacks if any creature provokes one.
__Eldritch Herald (VALDACAPTAIN)__: Your eldritch master psychically nudges you toward its goals, granting you the following benefits.

3.name: Outer Knowledge
3.value: When you finish a Long Rest, you gain proficiency and Expertise in a skill chosen by the GM. The GM can change this skill when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Enthralled
3.value: You and your Cohort have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

6.name: Yellow Sign (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
6.value: You can take a Bonus Action to trace the Yellow Sign in the air and create a 10-foot Emanation of psychic energy centered on yourself for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. Once per turn, when a creature within the Emanation makes a D20 Test, you can roll 1d6 and subtract it from the roll (no action required).
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest unless you expend one Battle Die (no action required) to restore your use of it.

10.name: Yellow Sign (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
10.value: Your eldritch master's influence grows, granting you the following benefits.

10.name: Frenzied Ally
10.value: When a creature has the Frenzied condition of your Frenzied Strike, it regards you and your Cohort as allies while it has the condition.

10.name: Frenzied Blitz
10.value: When you use your Blitz feature, you can direct a creature that has the Frenzied condition, even if that creature isn't an ally.

10.name: Extended Frenzy
10.value: Whenever a creature that has the Frenzied condition of your Frenzied Strike ends its turn, it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Maneuver save DC. On a failed save, the Frenzied condition doesn't end for that creature. On a success, the condition ends for that creature.

14.name: Yellow Sign (VALDACAPTAIN) Features
14.value: While the Emanation of your Pallid Aura is active, you and your allies within the Emantion deal an extra **1d6** Psychic damage when hitting an enemy with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
