1.name: Class Features
1.value: You are assisted by an AI Companion, an intricate data construct which lives on your Datapad and possesses human-like levels of intelligence. It manifests physically as a geometric projection near you; otherwise, it is merely a voice in your ear, checking your reasoning and informing you of relevant information.

Choose one of the following skills: *Arcana*, *Data*, *History*, *Investigation*, *Nature*, *Religion*, or *Technology*. *Technology* is recommended. Whenever you make an Intelligence check with the chosen skill, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

Whenever you gain a Gadgeteer level, you can replace the skill you chose with a different one from the list. You can choose additional skills with this feature as you gain certain Gadgeteer levels, as shown on the AI Skills column of the Gadgeteer Features table.

You make a breakthrough innovation with a prototype of your own design. You gain one Alpha Prototype of your choice from the "Alpha Prototype Options" section later in the class description. Your prototype is considered Magical Technology.
Whenever you gain a Gadgeteer level, you can replace the prototype you chose with a different one.

Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Laser Swords and Repeaters. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: You have built or amassed a collection of cutting-edge devices. You gain three Gadgets of your choice from the "Gadget Options" section later in the class description. All Gadgets are considered Magical Technology.

2.name: Gaining Gadgets
2.value: Whenever you gain a Gadgeteer level, you can replace one of your Gadgets with another one for which you qualify. When you gain certain Gadgeteer levels, you gain more Gadgets of your choice, as shown in the Gadgets column of the Gadgeteer Features table. You can't pick the same Gadget more than once unless its description says otherwise.

2.name: Proprietary Design
2.value: Your Gadgets are powered by a personal power cell. No other creature can use them.

2.name: Replacing Lost Gadgets
2.value: If one of your Gadgets is consumed or lost, you can replace it with a new one when you finish a Long Rest.

2.name: Saving Throws
2.value: If a Gadget requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature using a weapon or Gadget, you can deal an extra 2 Lightning damage to the target. As you gain levels as a Gadgeteer, this extra damage increases, as shown in the Overcharge column on the Gadgeteer Features table.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain a Gadgeteer subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Gadgeteer levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Gadgeteer level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Gadgeteer levels 8, 12, and 16.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a feature from your Gadgeteer Subclass.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: When a Construct that you can see makes an attack roll against you, you can take a Reaction to activate your Buffer Protocol. The Construct has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, including against the triggering attack, until the end of the current turn.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a feature from your Gadgeteer Subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: You can take a Utilize action to tinker with a weapon whose mastery property you can, improving its damage. When you use it, the weapon deals an additional die of damage on a hit. If its damage dice are d10s or d12s, it deals an additional 1d8 instead. This weapon retains this benefit as long as you can use its mastery property.
At Gadgeteer level 17, this extra damage increases to two dice, or 2d8 for weapons with d10 or **d12** damage dice.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a feature from your Gadgeteer Subclass.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with activating your Bluescreen Protocol. Choose a Construct that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Gadget save DC or have the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute, even if it would normally have Immunity to that condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the condition on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: Your Mastery Mods extra damage increases to two dice, or 2d8 for weapons with d10 or **d12** damage dice.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: If you fail a saving throw against a spell, magic item, or Magical Technology and you don't have the Incapacitated condition, you can cause yourself to succeed instead.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: You can reconfigure your Gadgets on the fly. As a Magic action, you can replace one of your Gadgets with another one for which you qualify.

3.name: AI Futurist (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Advance Your Artificial Intelligence*

As a Futurist, you believe that artificial intelligence is the zenith of all invention. To engineer a perfect AI, one which is capable of inventing on its own merits, is to conquer limitless problems by proxy. After all, an advanced AI which doesn't degrade into a rogue intelligence could turn its vastly superior intellect to dramatically improving the world, innovating in ways organic minds couldn't imagine. Your experiments with neural networks and intelligence theory have steadily edged you closer to finding such an AI, and granted your AI companion newfound aptitude along the way.
__Advanced Subroutines (DARKMATTER24)__: When you roll Initiative, choose for your AI to run Adaptive Accuracy or Predictive Avoidance. You can command it to switch subroutines as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Adaptive Accuracy
3.value: When you miss a target with an attack, your AI evaluates the mistake and corrects for it. The next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

3.name: Predictive Avoidance
3.value: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, your AI predicts the next incoming strike. That attacker has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you this turn.
__Novel Intelligence (DARKMATTER24)__: Your AI's intellect has improved, granting you the following benefits.

3.name: Bonus Skill
3.value: You choose one additional skill from the list in your AI Companion to gain the benefits of that feature.

3.name: Translator
3.value: Your AI knows all languages.

6.name: AI Futurist (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: When you roll Initiative, your AI examines one creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. You learn one of the following pieces of information: the target's Armor Class, its Immunities, its Resistances, its Vulnerabilities, or any spells that currently affect the target.

10.name: AI Futurist (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When a creature you can see makes an attack against you with a weapon that is Magical Technology, such as a Laser Sword or blaster, you can take a Reaction to command your AI to disable that technology. The attacker must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw against your Gadget save DC or the weapon is disabled until the end of the current turn. The attacker must use a different weapon or an Unarmed Strike or lose the attack.

14.name: AI Futurist (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: When you make a D20 Test, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once) and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Cyber Surgeon (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Heal and Experiment on Your Allies*

Cyber Surgeons are at the cutting edge of medical science, using serums infused with nanomachines and experimental biochemistry to do the impossible. Their mandate is not to heal, however, but to learn—a fact that many of their patients discover only after becoming unwitting lab rats for a new drug.

__Skilled Surgeon (DARKMATTER24)__: You gain proficiency in the *Medicine* skill, if you didn't already have it. Additionally, you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

__Bio-Serum (DARKMATTER24)__: As a Bonus Action, you can inject yourself or one creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself with an advanced healing serum. The target regains Hit Points equal to your Gadgeteer level. Additionally, the creature can expend one of its Hit Point Dice and rolls that die. The creature regains additional Hit Points equal to the roll.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Cyber Surgeon (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: As a Magic action, you can drive a bolt into the torso of a creature within 5 feet of you that has died within the last minute and shock it back to life. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Gadgeteer level. This feature can't return to life a creature that lacks a heart, a creature that has died of old age, or a creature that is missing vital organs.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending two uses of your Bio-Serum (no action required).

10.name: Cyber Surgeon (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you use your Bio-Serum, you can give the target the effect of one of the following spells of your choice (no concentration required) in addition to the serum's normal effects: __Blur__, __Enhance Ability__, __Enlarge/Reduce__, __Invisibility__, __Spider Climb__. The effects of the spell end early for that creature if you use this feature on that creature again.

14.name: Cyber Surgeon (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: As a Magic action, you can activate a healing field in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you. You restore up to 100 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures within the Emanation. A creature that regains 1 or more Hit Points from this feature has Advantage on D20 Tests until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Drone Jockey (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Command a Swarm of Flying Drones*

Most Gadgeteers tinker with drones at some point in their career; after all, they're compact, useful projects, with a limited number of moving parts. However, only Drone Jockeys arm themselves with a fleet of programmed drones. By linking the drones' sensors and Construct cores, they create a cunning swarm intelligence, distributed over the network as a whole. This swarm can act almost autonomously, scouting the area and defending the jockey with mechanical efficiency.

__Drone Commander (DARKMATTER24)__: You have a special Drone Controller, which doesn't count against the number of magic items you can attune to. While using this controller, you gain the following benefits.

3.name: Swift Command
3.value: If you don't have the Incapacitated condition, you can use your Drone Controller on your turn to command your drone without taking a Bonus Action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Intelligent Blaster
3.value: You can use your Intelligence modifier for your drone's attack.

3.name: Omni-Drone
3.value: A drone connected to your Drone Controller counts as an Assault drone, a Medical drone, and a Shield drone.

3.name: Drone Replacements
3.value: If your drone is lost, you can create a replacement drone for no cost and connect it to the controller over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a Short or Long Rest.

6.name: Drone Jockey (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You have a second drone linked to your special Drone Controller. When you command your drone using the controller, you can command all of your drones connected to that controller at once, issuing the same commands or different ones.
When you reach Gadgeteer level 10, you gain a third drone linked to your controller.

10.name: Drone Jockey (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to interpose one of your drones between the attacker and yourself. The attack hits the drone instead of you.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

14.name: Drone Jockey (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: You've upgraded the drones connected to your special Drone Controller in the following ways.

14.name: Integrated Blaster
14.value: Your drones deal **2d6** Radiant damage on hit.

14.name: Revival Protocol
14.value: The drone restores 18 (4d8) Hit Points to a creature within 5 feet of it.

14.name: Shield Projector
14.value: Roll a d8 and add it to AC instead of a d6.

3.name: Hologrammer (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Create Dazzling Holographic Distractions*

Armed with a sophisticated projector, Hologrammers create vivid, photorealistic holograms to confound their foes. Most often, they are accompanied by a holographic decoy, following their every movement as if one crossed their eyes.

__Hologram Projector (DARKMATTER24)__: You have an advanced projector used to create lifelike holograms. The energy used to power this projector is represented by a pool of Hologram points equal to your Gadgeteer level. You regain all expended Hologram points when you finish a Long Rest.

While holding the projector, you can cast one of the spells on the Hologram Projector table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell and what Gadgeteer level you must be to cast it. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

__Illusory Decoy (DARKMATTER24)__: As a Bonus Action, you can create a holographic duplicate of yourself which follows your event movement and lasts for 10 minutes. When a creature hits you with an attack roll while your duplicate remains, roll a d6. If it rolls a 3 or higher, the duplicate is hit instead of you and the duplicate is destroyed.
Once you use this Bonus Action, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending 2 Hologram points (no action required).

6.name: Hologrammer (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You gain the Magic Item (Flashbang) and Magic Item (Invisibomb) Gadgets, which don't count against your number of Gadgets. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Flashbang or Invisibomb.

10.name: Hologrammer (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When your Illusory Decoy is destroyed, you can take a Reaction to expend 2 Hologram Points to deal **2d8** Radiant damage to the attacker and immediately create a new decoy.

14.name: Hologrammer (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: While *Concentrating* on __Hypnotic Pattern__, __Major Image__, __Mislead__, or __Silent Image__, you can replace one of your attacks with the illusion lashing out against a creature you can see within 30 feet of the spell's image. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Gadget save DC. On a failed save, it takes **3d6** plus half your Gadgeteer level (round down) Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

3.name: Jumper (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Leap Through Dimensional Portals*

Gadgeteers with an expertise in dimensional portals are known as Jumpers. Brandishing their signature portal devices, Jumpers can create and hop between portals in a blink of an eye. As their mastery over portal technology grows, they can enhance and manipulate their portals, teleporting themselves and others wherever they please.

__Slip Gate (DARKMATTER24)__: As a Bonus Action, you can activate a portal device to create two 5-foot diameter circular portals at locations you choose within 30 feet of yourself. The portals are two-dimensional glowing rings filled with mist that blocks sight. They float inches from the ground and are perpendicular to it. Anything that travels through the front of one portal is instantly transported to the other location, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the front of the portal. The portals dissipate after a creature travels through them, after 1 minute, or if you dismiss them on your turn (no action required).
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once) and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Jumper (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: As a Magic action, you can create a circular portal next to a Large or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed a Dexterity saving throw against your Gadget save DC or be pulled into the portal and be transported to a harmless demiplane for 1 minute. The portal then closes behind it. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat this saving throw, reappearing in the space if left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied on a success.

If the target succeeds its initial saving throw, the portal remains open until the end of your next turn. The portal floats inches from the ground and is perpendicular to it. A creature that is pushed into the portal is transported to the harmless demiplane as if it failed a saving throw.
Once you use this feature to create a portal, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

10.name: Jumper (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you or an ally goes through one of your Slip Gate portals, you can choose one of the following additional effects.

10.name: Persistent Gate
10.value: The portals don't dissipate after the creature travels through them.

10.name: Shield Gate
10.value: The creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Gadgeteer level plus your Intelligence modifier.

10.name: Tele-Frag
10.value: Immediately before the creature arrives at the destination, each creature within a 5-foot Emanation originating from the destination portal makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Gadget save DC, taking **4d6** Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

14.name: Jumper (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with attempting to teleport an enemy you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Gadget save DC or be teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet of yourself and have the Prone condition.

3.name: Mastermaker (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Perfect Your Body Through Cybernetic Grafts*

Nearly all Gadgeteers strive for perfection in their work, but Mastermakers take this goal to a logical extreme: using the technology at their disposal, they seek to engineer away their own biological defects. By grafting Gadgets and technology onto their bodies (and making liberal use of vect components), Mastermakers gradually become hybrids of living beings and machines. They are stronger, tougher, and more agile than their counterparts, but many would argue that their techniques are too extreme—too unnatural—no matter what the results.
__Advanced Construct Grafts (DARKMATTER24)__: You have improved your body with Construct grafts, granting you the following benefits.

3.name: Two Grafts
3.value: You gain two Common or Uncommon Construct grafts of your choice. Arm Cannon and Shield Module are recommended.

3.name: Quick Installation
3.value: You can take the Utilize action to install a Construct graft on your body.

3.name: Painless Attachment
3.value: You don't lose Hit Point Dice from installing or removing grafts, and it takes you no time to recover after the attachment of a new graft.

__Reconfigure (DARKMATTER24)__: You gain a +2 bonus to your Strength, Dexterity, Charisma, or Wisdom score, to a maximum of 20. When you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can change which ability score you choose for this bonus.

6.name: Mastermaker (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You gain special Android Skin and Voice Changer grafts, which don't take up External and Internal graft slots respectively. When you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can change the appearance of the Android Skin.

10.name: Mastermaker (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you are hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to ensure that one of your installed grafts absorbs the brunt of the damage. The damage dealt to you is reduced by an amount equal to your Gadgeteer level plus your Intelligence modifier. The chosen graft is temporarily damaged. You can't use that graft or remove it from its body slot until you repair it when you finish a Long Rest. You can't choose your special Android Skin or Voice Changer when using this feature.

14.name: Mastermaker (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: By installing a Construct core into your head, you gain the following benefits.

14.name: Heightened Intelligence
14.value: Your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.

14.name: Immunities
14.value: You have Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage and to the Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned conditions.

3.name: Quantum Mechanic (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Manipulate Quantum Dynamics with Gadgets*

Gadgeteers at the forefront of physics often become Quantum Mechanics, creating devices to explore and exploit the paradoxical nature of tiny, fundamental particles. Through this arsenal of quantum tools, they can change the trajectory of blaster bolts, tunnel through solid matter, and manipulate probability in their favor.

__Temporal Relativism (DARKMATTER24)__: You learn the __Moment to Think__ cantrip. Additionally, whenever you roll Initiative, you can cast __Delay__ without a spell slot. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

__Uncertainty Principle (DARKMATTER24)__: When you miss with an attack roll, you can reroll the attack and you must use the new roll. If this rerolled attack hits, the target takes damage as if you rolled a 1 on all of the damage dice.

6.name: Quantum Mechanic (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You can activate a quantum tunneling device as a Bonus Action. Until the end of your turn, you have Resistance to all damage and can move through occupied spaces as if they were Difficult Terrain. If you end your turn in such a space, you are shunted to the last unoccupied space you were in.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once) and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Quantum Mechanic (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to activate a Feline Waveform Collapser. Roll a d20. If the die rolls a 10 or higher, you take no damage.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. If you roll a 9 or lower on the d20, this use of the feature isn't expended.

14.name: Quantum Mechanic (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: As a Magic action, you can attempt to entangle yourself with a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Gadget save DC or be linked to you for 1 minute. While linked, you have Resistance to all damage. Each time you take damage, the linked creature takes the same amount of damage. The Entanglement ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition, if the linked creature dies, if the linked creature is ever more than 30 feet away from you, or if you dismiss it (no action required).
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

1.name: Class Features
1.value: You have learned to cast Rituals to overcome supernatural threats.

*The spells you add to your grimoire represent research into occult and supernatural threats, but you might find other spells during your adventures that you can add to your grimoire.*
***Copying a Spell into the Grimoire**: When you find a level 1+ Investigator spell, you can copy it into your grimoire if it's of an eligible level and if you have time to copy it. For each level of the spell, the transcription takes 2 hours and costs 50 GP.*
***Copying the Grimoire**: You can copy a spell from your grimoire into another book. This is like copying a new spell into your grimoire but faster, since you already know how to cast the spell. You need spend only 1 hour and 10 GP for each level of the copied spell.
If you lose your grimoire, you can recall from memory a number of spells equal to your Investigator level and use the same procedure to transcribe the spells into a new grimoire. Filling out the remainder of the new book requires you to find new spells to do so. For this reason, many Investigators keep a backup grimoire.*

1.name: Grimoire
1.value: Your Rituals are recorded in a grimoire, a Tiny object that weighs 3 pounds and contains 100 pages. You determine the grimoire's appearance and materials.
The grimoire starts with four level 1 Investigator spells of your choice. __Detect Magic__, __Heroism__, __Memorize__, and __Transient Bulwark__ are recommended.

Whenever you gain an Investigator level, you can add two Investigator spells of your choice to your grimoire. The Ritual Level column on the Investigator Feature table shows the maximum level of a spell you can add to your grimoire.

1.name: Ritual Casting
1.value: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your grimoire. You must read from the book to cast a spell in this way. You can't cast spells that are in your grimoire except as Rituals, unless you've learned them by other means.

1.name: Bonus Rituals
1.value: You can treat specific spells as if they have the Ritual tag, allowing you to add them to your grimoire and cast them as Rituals. These spells are marked in the Investigator Spells list.

1.name: Spellcasting Ability
1.value: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Investigator spells.
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Rapiers and Heavy Crossbows.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. *Arcana* and *Investigation* are recommended if you have proficiency in them.
At Investigator level 9, you gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
Once per turn when you deal damage with a weapon to a creature that is *Bloodied*, you can deal an extra **1d8** damage to the target. The damage is the same type as the damage dealt by the weapon.
This damage increases as you gain Investigator levels, as shown in the Finisher column of the Investigator Features table.

You can hastily perform any spell in your grimoire that has a casting time of an action or Bonus Action, casting the spell as a Bonus Action. You can cast it without Material components unless the components have a cost of 100+ GP specified by the spell.

You can use this feature three times. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain additional uses when you reach certain Investigator levels, as shown in the Rushed Incantation column of the Investigator Features table.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain a Investigator subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Investigator levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Investigator level or lower.

Your subclass grants you a number of supernatural trinkets to aid you in defeating supernatural threats and unraveling mysteries. You can use this feature twice, activating one of your trinket options each time you use it. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain additional uses when you reach certain Investigator levels, as shown in the Trinkets column of the Investigator Features table.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature with an attack using a weapon, you can target the creature where it is most vulnerable to gain the following benefits.

5.name: Damage Vulnerability
5.value: Choose one damage type dealt by the attack. The target has Vulnerability to the chosen damage type for this attack. Vulnerability from this feature doesn't double extra damage from spells (such as __Hunter's Mark__) or features from other classes (such as the Rogue's Sneak Attack). The Vulnerability doesn't apply to this attack if the target has Immunity to the chosen damage type.

5.name: Disrupt Resistance
5.value: If the target has Resistance to one or more damage types, it loses these Resistances until the start of your next turn, including against the damage of the triggering attack.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a feature from your Investigator Subclass.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: You keep a wide array of Holy Symbols and blessed items on your person, even if you aren't particularly pious. You can use the following trinkets (expending a use of your Trinkets to do so).

7.name: Amulet of Warding
7.value: As a Bonus Action, you place a divine ward on a creature of your choice within 60 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, the warded creature gains a bonus to AC and saving throws equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

7.name: Restorative Ankh
7.value: As a Bonus Action, a creature of your choice within 60 feet of you regains Hit Points equal to your Investigator level plus your Intelligence modifier.

7.name: Rune of Banishment
7.value: As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or be banished to a harmless location in the Ethereal Plane. While banished, the target has the Incapacitated condition and its Speed is 0. At the start of your next turn, the creature reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

9.name: Class Features
9.value: At Investigator level 9, you gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a feature from your Investigator Subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use your Finisher on a creature that isn't *Bloodied*, dealing only an extra **1d8** damage to the target.
At Investigator level 17, this damage increases to 2d8.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

13.name: Class Features
13.value: You learn a secret that unlocks potent arcane magic. You gain the ability to cast a level 7 spell, and discover additional secrets when you reach certain Investigator levels.

13.name: Level 7 Spell
13.value: You can cast one of the following spells without a spell slot and regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest: __Mirage Arcane__, __Plane Shift__, __Reverse Gravity__, __Sequester__, or __Teleport__.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a feature from your Investigator Subclass.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: At Investigator level 15, you can also cast one of the following spells without a spell slot and regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest: __Antimagic Field__, __Glibness__, __Maze__, or __Mind Blank__.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: At Investigator level 17, you can also cast one of the following spells without a spell slot and regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest: __Astral Projection__, __Gate__, or __Weird__.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: Choose 5 Investigator spells in your grimoire of levels 1-3 that have a casting time of an action or Bonus Action. You can use Rushed Incantation to cast the chosen spells without expending a use of the feature, and you don't need to read from your grimoire to cast them.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of those spells with another spell in your grimoire.

3.name: Antiquarian (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Wield a Museum's Worth of Powerful Arcane Trinkets*

Festooned with magical trinkets from every corner of the globe, Antiquarians have a tool for every occasion: silver arrowheads for lycanthropes, heartwood stakes for vampires, blessed relics for fiends, and so on. As they expand their collections from piles of trinkets to veritable museums, they become adept historians and arcanists, familiar with the stories of every magic item in their care, as well as how to use them in dire situations.
__Artifact Hoarder (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You gain one additional use of your Trinkets before a Long Rest.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Antiquarian (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: You've secured a handful of priceless relics with rare and delicate enchantments. Once you use one of the following relics, you can't use this feature again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

6.name: Antediluvian Dynamo
6.value: You can cast __Fireball__ or __Lightning Bolt__ without a spell slot or components.

6.name: Lich's Deathmask
6.value: You can cast __Counterspell__ or __Dispel Magic__ without a spell slot or components.

6.name: Mortal Coil
6.value: You can cast __Animate Dead__ or __Revivify__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast __Animate Dead__ using this relic, all previous Undead created using this relic crumble into dust.

10.name: Antiquarian (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: When you finish a Long Rest, you can magically produce a magic item. When you do so, all magic items previously created by this feature vanish. If a magic item you produce requires Attunement, you can attune yourself to it the instant you produce it. You can produce the following magic items: a Carpet of Flying, a Cloak of the Bat, a Flame Tongue, Gauntlets of Ogre Power, an Instant Fortress, a Ring of Regeneration, a Ring of Telekinesis, a Sun Blade, or a Wand of Wonder.

14.name: Antiquarian (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You've secured the crown jewel of your collection: a lich's soul jar, or "phylactery." Though the original owner's soul has been expelled from this accursed artifact, it retains many of its magical properties.

This magic item is always attuned to you and doesn't count against your total number of attuned magic items. It has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the soul jar, you can expend one or more charges to use the following abilities.

14.name: Temporary Hit Points
14.value: You can expend 1 charge as a Bonus Action to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Investigator level.

14.name: Trinket Recharge
14.value: You can expend 1 charge as a Bonus Action to regain one expended use of your Trinkets.

14.name: Undead Fortitude
14.value: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you can expend 2 charges to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

14.name: Draining Touch
14.value: As a Magic action, you can expend 3 charges to make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **8d8** Necrotic damage and you regain Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. If the spell attack misses, these charges aren't expended.

3.name: Archivist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Expand Your Rituals Through Ancient Lore*

Though most Investigators fill their grimoires with hard- won knowledge borne from encounters with supernatural threats, some prefer to do bookkeeping instead. Such Archivists seek to accumulate knowledge, more so than trinkets, by spending untold hours digging through disparate tomes of occult secrets and compiling them into encyclopedic texts. Through their research, Archivists become academic masters of the arcane and priceless reservoirs of obscure knowledge.

__Thesis (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You gain access to certain spells associated with your thesis. Choose one of the following subject areas for your thesis: Corpus, Mentis, Mortis, or Oculus. Consult the table below that corresponds to the chosen thesis; you add the listed spells for your Investigator level to your grimoire for free. The listed spells count as Investigator spells for you and you treat them if they have the Ritual tag.

Whenever you gain an Investigator level, you can replace your thesis with another one. The spells in your grimoire corresponding to your thesis are magically replaced with those of the new thesis for your Investigator level.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Archivist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can give one target of the spell Disadvantage on saves against the spell.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a use of your Rushed Incantation (no action required).

10.name: Archivist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: You can identify any arcane effect from memory. Whenever you see or hear a spell being cast or investigate a magical effect, you can identify the spell that was cast, the magic item responsible, or the creature that produced the effect without an ability check. This feature fails to identify spells, magic items, and creatures that are utterly unique or are otherwise not recorded in arcane texts.

14.name: Archivist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can effortlessly duplicate spells you see or hear, granting you the following benefits.

14.name: Ritual Recall
14.value: If you see or hear an Investigator spell being cast, you can thereafter copy it into your grimoire.

14.name: Spell Duplication
14.value: When you see or hear a spell of level 5 or lower being cast, you can fix the spell in your mind. Within the next minute, you can expend a use of your Rushed Incantation to cast the spell without a spell slot. Once you use this benefit to cast a spell, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Conspiracy Theorist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Unravel Far-Reaching, Incredulous Conspiracies*

The world is full of stuff that doesn't add up. A natural disaster strikes and they talk about theoretical weather patterns. People forget days at a time and they say some medical jargon about their brains. And nobody seems to notice the folks dressed in black who lurk behind every corner. It's one big coincidence after another. But when you ask the right questions and pull on the right threads, you start uncovering the biggest mysteries: the ones They don't want you to know about.

It's hard to tell who They even are, apart from the fact that They're massively influential and have deep pockets. They have agents everywhere, watching and waiting. What are their goals? What are they working so hard to keep secret? You can't be totally sure, but you have a few good theories.
__Paranoid Instincts (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Conspiracy Theorist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you take the Ready action, you have Advantage on D20 Tests you make for the Reaction. You can only use this feature when the trigger is in response to another creature's action or movement after the end of your turn.

10.name: Conspiracy Theorist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: When you finish a Short or Long Rest, choose one skill. You gain proficiency in that skill if you lacked it and Expertise with it. This proficiency and Expertise lasts until you use this feature to choose a different skill.

14.name: Conspiracy Theorist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: Your ability to avoid others grants you the following benefits.

14.name: Escape Plan
14.value: Whenever you take damage, you can take a Reaction to have the Invisible condition until the start of your next turn.

14.name: Nondetection
14.value: You can cast __Nondetection__ on yourself without a spell slot.

3.name: Containment Specialist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Contain and Conceal Anomalous Magic Artifacts*

Though the study of magic is diverse and wonderous, it contains mysteries better left unexplored. Such topics in magic are seldom studied, for their very existence poses an existential threat to the multiverse itself: chronomancy, protomancy, and quantumancy are among the few graced with names at all. When a sinister (or merely curious) arcanist pulls on one of these threads of knowledge, they open a Pandora's box of unpredictable effects. The results are usually catastrophic. Such dangerous arcana leaves lasting scars on people and objects, metaphysical reverberations of the terrible secrets at their source.

As their title implies, Containment Specialists are tasked with tracking, isolating, and containing exotic magic and its artifacts. Their job is hazardous and challenging, but is of critical importance to the multiverse at large. Containment Specialists often coordinate in clandestine groups to triangulate new threats and ensure isolated ones remain indefinitely contained. With some luck, these organizations can remain obscure footnotes for generations, further sheltering their secrets from curious eyes.

__Cover Story (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: When you fail a Charisma (*Deception*) check or a creature catches you in a lie, you can reattempt the check to reassure the listener with another quick lie. On a success, the listener believes you. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Containment Specialist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you use your Exploit Weakness and the target has the Magic Resistance trait, that trait doesn't function until the start of your next turn.

10.name: Containment Specialist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: With a blinding flash, you can overwrite the memories of those around you. You can cast __Modify Memory__ as an action targeting up to 3 creatures within range without a spell slot or components. You must modify the memories of each creature affected by the spell in the same way.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Containment Specialist (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can leverage a powerful quarantine procedure to keep others safe from dangerous artifacts. As a Magic action, you can create a pocket dimension that is an exact duplicate of your surroundings at the moment you use this feature—complete with duplicates of all the structures and nonmagical items therein—and transport creatures you choose within its area to the dimension. You decide the exact area of the duplicate dimension, as long as its total space fits within a 150-foot Cube.

While in the pocket dimension, you can only affect and be affected by other creatures in that dimension. You can't see creatures and objects outside the pocket dimension. Objects taken from the pocket dimension vanish upon leaving it.

If a creature leaves the bounds of the pocket dimension it appears in the corresponding space on the plane it left. If it appears in an occupied space, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes **4d6** Force damage.

The pocket dimension lasts for 10 minutes, and ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition, the pocket dimension contains no creatures, or you dismiss it (no action required). When the pocket dimension ends, all creatures and objects are returned to the plane they left in their corresponding locations.
Once you use this feature to create a pocket dimension, you can't do so until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Decommissioner (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Investigate and Hunt Down Rogue Constructs*

Blaster in hand and badge in pocket, your job is to hunt down renegade androids—especially the troublesome Version 13 units—that prowl through human megacities wearing perfect human facades. Your best tools are reliable detection, high firepower, and a knack for unpicking mysteries, which has made you a foremost expert in killing Constructs of all stripes. Whenever an N-Virus outbreak threatens a world, a few Decommissioners are pulled from their gumshoe duties to stem the tide and take down the most lethal units in the wave. And whenever a rogue AI gets its virtual hands on a superweapon, your Datapad starts to buzz.
__System Cracker (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Your experience breaking secure systems grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.value: You gain proficiency in *Data* and one of the following skills of your choice: *Insight*, *Investigation*, or Technology.

3.name: Quick Hack
3.value: You can attempt to hack a device as a Utilize action, rather than over the course of one minute.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Decommissioner (DARKMATTER24) Features
6.value: You can spend 10 minutes modifying a weapon with the Blaster property with aftermarket components to improve its stopping power. This blaster remains improved until you use this feature to modify a different blaster. The blaster's damage dice each increase by one step (d4 → d6 → d8 → d10 → d12, to a maximum of 1d12).

10.name: Decommissioner (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: You can take an action to hack a Construct within 5 feet of you. The Construct makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. A Construct with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save. If it fails, you can perform one of the following operations.

10.name: Learn Directives
10.value: You learn the explicit instructions given to a simple Construct, such as an automaton, or the surface thoughts of an advanced Construct, such as an artificial intelligence. You also learn if the Construct is infected with the N-Virus or if its programming is otherwise corrupted.

10.name: Override Directives
10.value: You can modify the explicit instructions given to a simple Construct, such as an automaton, causing it to abandon its current objective, become Indifferent to one or more creatures, or to pursue a simple directive of your choosing. The GM decides if a Construct is too sophisticated to override or if a directive is too complex for a Construct to follow.

10.name: Sleep Mode
10.value: The Construct drops into a low-power mode and gains the Unconscious condition for 1 minute, even if it would otherwise have Immunity to the Unconscious condition. This condition ends early on the Construct if it takes damage. Once you perform this operation on a Construct, you can't use it again on that Construct again for 24 hours.

14.name: Decommissioner (DARKMATTER24) Features
14.value: When you use your Finisher with a blaster against an enemy that is *Bloodied*, you may kill it instantly with a well-placed shot. If the enemy has fewer Hit Points than three times your Investigator level after taking damage, it drops to 0 Hit Points.

3.name: Detective (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Chase Down Clues and Crack the Mystery*

Prowling at the edge of darkness, Detectives chase down clues and pull on threads to unravel conspiracies that bring darkness into the world. Sometimes, this requires that you infiltrate a cult's secret meetings, other times it calls on you to reconstruct a person's last moments at a murder scene. No matter what the mystery, however, you know that there is always an explanation.
__Uncanny Hunch (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Whenever you make an Intelligence check or a Wisdom (*Insight*) check, you can gain a bonus to the check equal to your Investigator level.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Detective (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: As a Bonus Action, you can examine the movements of a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Until the start of your next turn, you can add 1d6 to attack rolls you make against the target, and the target subtracts 1d6 from all its attack rolls against you. Once you use this Bonus Action on a target, you can't use it on that target again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

10.name: Detective (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: Your sleuthing experience grants you the following benefits.

10.name: Enchantment Detection
10.value: You discern if a creature is cursed, possessed, or has the Charmed or Frightened conditions.

10.name: Illusion Detection
10.value: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to discern an illusion.

10.name: Lie Detection
10.value: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to determine if you hear a deliberate lie.

14.name: Detective (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can use your __Predictive Intuition__ on a target an unlimited number of times.

3.name: Exterminator (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Slay Vampires, Werewolves, and Other Terrible Creatures*

An Exterminator suffers no monster to live. Trained in the art of slaying Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead, you stand against evil where others falter, and draw your blade before others recognize a threat. Grand schemes and plots are less important than retribution against monsters which stalk the night, and your thirst for such retribution is unquenchable. There is always another werewolf to be slain, another vampire to be staked, another demon to be banished; people rarely thank you, but you find satisfaction enough in your work.
__Silvered Shield (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Your monster hunting experience grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Armor Training
3.value: You have training with Medium armor and Shields.

3.name: Intelligent Defense
3.value: While wearing Medium armor, you can add your Intelligence, instead of Dexterity, to your Armor Class.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Exterminator (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: As a Bonus Action, you can make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

10.name: Exterminator (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: Your monster-killing expertise grants you the following benefits.

10.name: Flexible Mastery
10.value: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the __Sap__ or __Vex__ property for that attack.

10.name: Supernatural Strikes
10.value: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

14.name: Exterminator (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can use your Exploit Weakness twice on your turn, but can't use it against the same target more than once.

3.name: Infernum (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Bargain with Fiends for Infernal Powers*

The Infernum are Investigators in league with Fiends, either willingly to pursue nefarious ends or unwillingly as the result of an infernal bargain. Each is given a set of enigmatic goals and a fiendish overseer (often an Imp), then left entirely to their own devices. Many search and scrounge for a solution to their fiendish bargain or opt for malicious compliance, delivering upon their infernal directives while undermining their broader schemes. Others, however, revel in their dark alliance, gleefully hoping to climb the fiendish ranks.

__Fiendish Familiar (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Your infernal masters have assigned a lesser fiend to supervise and assist you. You add __Find Familiar__ to your grimoire for free. You can use Rushed Incantation to cast the spell without expending a use of the feature, and you don't need to read from your grimoire to cast it. The spell is improved in the following ways when you cast it.

3.name: Fiendish Options
3.value: You can choose only the following options for your familiar: __Imp__, __Quasit__, or __Pseudodragon__. A pseudodragon summoned with this spell knows Common and is a Fiend.

3.name: Spiteful Distraction
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to disrupt an enemy within 5 feet of it. The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Infernum (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you finish a Long Rest, you can strike one of the following bargains with your infernal masters. You can also discuss new bargains with your GM. The bargain lasts until you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Blindsight and Blindness
6.value: You have Blindsight with a range of 30 feet. Beyond this range, you have the Blinded condition.

6.name: Damage and Actions
6.value: Once on each of your turns, you can choose to take Necrotic damage equal to twice your Investigator level to take an additional action. This action can only be used to take only the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize action.

6.name: Resistance and Vulnerability
6.value: Choose two of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic, and Thunder. You have Resistance to the chosen damage types. The GM chooses another type from the list; you have Vulnerability to that damage type.

10.name: Infernum (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: You add Geas to your grimoire for free. When you cast the spell using this feature, you can modify its casting to draft a binding contract. Instead of giving a verbal command, you write a legal contract that can contain up to 10 commands and conditions. You can include clauses that end the spell early or extend its duration to a maximum of 90 days. Instead of targeting a creature that you can see within range, the spell targets any creature that signs the contract within the duration.
A creature that willingly signs the contract as a Utilize action automatically fails its saving throw against the spell, whether or not the creature understands the nature of the contract.

14.name: Infernum (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can take a Magic action to shape-shift your __Fiendish Familiar__ into one of the following forms: __Barbed Devil__, __Incubus__, __Succubus__, or __Vrock__. It remains transformed for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required). While transformed, your familiar can attack.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Inquisitor (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Drive Out Fiends and Root out Heresy*

The church has long been the first line of defense against the tide of impending darkness. Yet, the clergy's stubborn devotion to righteousness impedes them where it counts: you must sometimes be willing to do evil to counter evil. That's where the inquisition comes in.

As a righteous Inquisitor, you are tasked with rooting out heresy, exorcising demons, and stamping out any sign of the occult, and you are offered clemency for any action you take in the defense of the greater good. You may investigate anyone or anything you deem to be in line with the forces of evil, for you alone are a holy blade in the dark, the arbiter of your church.
__Exorcist's Doctrines (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Your training as an inquisitor grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Consecrated Armor
3.value: You add __Consecrated Armor__ to your grimoire for free. When you cast it, your base AC becomes 13 plus your Dexterity modifier.

3.name: Dogma
3.value: Whenever you make an Intelligence (*Religion*) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Inquisitor (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can cause the target to take an extra **1d8** Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice).

10.name: Inquisitor (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: You can use your Holy Trinkets three times without expending a use of your Trinkets. You regain these uses when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Inquisitor (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: As a Bonus Action, you can emblazon a mark of condemnation upon a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be marked for 1 minute. While marked, the target takes **6d6** Radiant damage at the start of each of its turns, can't regain Hit Points, and can't have Advantage on D20 Tests. A marked target can repeat its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Once you mark a creature using this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a use of your Rushed Incantation (no action required).

3.name: Kid Sleuth (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Solve Mysteries with Your Talking Animal Sidekick*

Though Kid Sleuths are not all literally youths, they are all amateur detectives with a knack for solving tricky crimes. Assisted by their ubiquitous animal sidekicks, Kid Sleuths will happily dive into the details of a grim crime scene to emerge with a handful of clues and a lead on the bad guy. These sleuths generally prefer to run away from trouble, rather than engage head-on, since mysteries only get harder to solve with more dead bodies, but they are more than capable of defending themselves if backed into a corner.

__Animal Sidekick (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You gain a Kid Sleuth's constant companion: a talking animal sidekick. You add __Find Familiar__ to your grimoire for free. You can use Rushed Incantation to cast the spell without expending a use of the feature, and you don't need to read from your grimoire to cast it. The spell is improved in the following ways when you cast it.

3.name: Expanded Options
3.value: You can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: __Goat__, __Mastiff__, or __Weasel__.

3.name: Awakened
3.value: The animal gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know.

3.name: Skillful
3.value: Your familiar gains proficiency in any combination of two skills or tools of your choice. You can change this selection when you summon your familiar.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Kid Sleuth (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you use your Exploit Weakness, you can immediately move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Alternatively, you can choose one ally you can see within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you. The ally can take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

10.name: Kid Sleuth (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: When your familiar takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action, you gain the benefits of that action on your next turn. You must be Heavily Obscured or behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total cover, and you must be out of any enemy's line of sight to gain the benefits of the Hide action.

14.name: Kid Sleuth (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: Whenever an enemy within 30 feet of yourself makes an attack roll against one of your allies, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that roll.

3.name: Medium (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Foretell the Future and Commune with the Dead*

As conduits between the living and dead, Mediums offer an essential glimpse past the veil of mortality. Using their auguries, seances, and divinations, Mediums can retrieve morsels of information from the afterlife to settle debts between the living or dead, and to assist ongoing investigations. This information, however cryptic, can point an interested party toward clues or evidence that only the deceased are able to provide.

__Fortelling (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record the numbers rolled. You can replace any D20 Test made by you or a creature that you can see with one of these foretelling rolls. You must choose to do so before the roll, and you can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each foretelling roll can be used only once. When you finish a Long Rest, you lose any unused foretelling rolls.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Medium (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: Once per turn when you deal damage with a weapon, you can replace one of the damage dice with a foretelling roll.

10.name: Medium (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: As a Magic action, you can receive a hint from beyond. The GM gives a one-word hint pertaining to your best course of action, a fruitful line of inquiry, or some other useful direction.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a use of your Rushed Incantation (no action required).

14.name: Medium (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can take a Bonus Action to cast __True Seeing__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell with this feature, you have Advantage on the first attack you make on each of your turns for the duration of this spell.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Spy (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Infiltrate, Assassinate, and Lie with Aplomb*

Infiltration, disguise, and lying through their teeth: these are the principal skills of a Spy. A talented Spy rarely needs to draw a dagger to silence someone, for their honeyed words and agreeable disposition are all that is needed to draw out someone's secrets. Of course, when they do strike, it is decisive and without warning. Such skills are invaluable for governments and organizations of all types, used for stealing confidential information, sabotage, monitoring persons of interest, and everything in between.
__Bravado (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Your infectious confidence gives you a bonus to your Charisma (*Deception* and *Persuasion*) checks equal to our Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Spy (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you deal damage during the first round of combat, you can deal extra Force damage to the target if the target hasn't taken a turn yet or if you have Advantage on the attack roll against the target. The Force damage equals your Investigator level.

10.name: Spy (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: As a Magic action, you can assume the identity of a Humanoid or a corpse of a Humanoid that you touch that has been dead for no longer than 24 hours. An illusion causes your appearance to perfectly match the target, including clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings. If the target is a corpse, you resemble the Humanoid as it appeared in life. Additionally, the corpse, its blood, clothing, and other physical evidence of its death, become magically invisible for 8 hours.
To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (*Investigation*) check against your spell save DC.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a use of your Rushed Incantation (no action required).

14.name: Spy (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: You can cast __Glibness__ without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest. For the spell's duration, you can take the Influence action as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Time Operative (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
3.value: *Manipulate Time to Solve Mysteries*

Time Operatives are agents from the future bestowed with a series of cryptic goals and a well of chronomantic magic. Some operatives hail from far-off utopias or crumbling apocalypses, while others simply receive a message across space and time and dedicate themselves to its mission. To prevent paradoxes, these Time Operatives receive only the barest clues pertaining to their mission. They know only the gravity of the situation, and that it is inherent upon them to change the course of history.

__Borrowed Time (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: Once on each of your turns, you can take an additional action. This action can only be used to take only the Attack (one attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize action.
You can use this feature twice, and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
__Trinkets (VALDAINVESTIGATOR)__: You can use the following trinkets.

3.name: Biodynamic Quadcorder
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can direct this device at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's type and the Resistances it has, if any.

3.name: Electric Sheep Generator
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cast __Technical Difficulties__ without a spell slot or components. When you cast the spell using this trinket, you can attempt to target a Construct with it, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, even if it would otherwise be immune to the Stunned condition. A creature with a Challenge Rating greater than your Investigator level automatically succeeds on this save.

3.name: Interrogation Field
3.value: You can cast __Zone of Truth__ without a spell slot.

6.name: Time Operative (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
6.value: When you make a D20 Test and fail, you can take a Bonus Action to rewind time to the moment before the attempt. Reroll the D20 Test and you must use the new roll.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Time Operative (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
10.value: You can take the Magic action to cast your senses up to 24 hours back in time at your current location. You can see and hear this location as if you were there, but the past appears dreamlike and shadowy. While perceiving the past, you can look in any direction, but you can't move or speak. This glimpse into the past lasts for 10 minutes, but it ends early if you dismiss it (no action required).

14.name: Time Operative (VALDAINVESTIGATOR) Features
14.value: When you finish a Short Rest or reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you regain a use of your __Borrowed Time__.
