1.name: Class Features
1.value: A good fight is all you need. As combat rages around you, you can show remarkable bursts of strength and endurance. This is represented by Grit Points. You can use these points to enhance or fuel certain Ruffian features. You lose all Grit Points when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Your Ruffian level determines the number of points you can have, as shown in the Grit Points Maximum column of the Ruffian Features table.
When you use your Grit Damage Reduction and don't negate the damage entirely, you gain one Grit Point (up to your Grit Point Maximum).

1.name: Grit Damage Reduction
1.value: Your Grit makes you remarkably resilient. Once on your turn or before the start of your next turn when you take damage, you can reduce the damage taken by 1d8 + your Ruffian level (no action required). Starting at 5th level you can reduce damage twice for separate instances of damage, thrice at 10th level, four times at 15th level and five times at 20th level.

1.name: Quick Recovery
1.value: At the start of your turn, you can grant yourself temporary Hit Points equal to your [Proficiency Bonus](https://5e.tools/tables.html#proficiency%20bonus_xphb) for every Grit Point you have.
You show an impressing physique.

1.name: Intimidating Presence
1.value: You gain proficiency in *Intimidation* if you don't already have it, and you can add your strength modifier to all *Intimidation* checks you make.

1.name: Quick Reflexes
1.value: You have Advantage on all Opportunity Attacks you make.
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Longbows and Shortswords.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties of Scimitars and Longswords.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: The pain you endure grants you remarkable bursts of strength. When taking the Attack Action, you can expend two Grit to make an additional attack as part of that same Action. At 9th level you can expend four Grit to make two additional attacks. At 17th level you can expend six Grit Points to make three additional attacks.

Your presence alone can be unsettling to others. Whenever a creature moves within 5 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Charisma Saving Throw against your Daunting Presence Save DC. On a fail the creature becomes fixated on you until the end of its next turn. A creature that is fixated on you cannot willingly move away from you and you gain a Grit whenever a creature that is fixated on you damages a creature other than you.

Additionally, you can use your Bonus Action to force a creature within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you to make a Charisma Saving Throw against your Daunting Presence Save DC. On a fail, the creature becomes fixated on you until the end of its next turn.
*Daunting Presence Save DC*: Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus

3.name: Class Features
3.value: Your reputation and your physique encourage other creatures to cooperate with you more readily. You gain Advantage on all Charisma based Ability Checks you make against a creature that is fixated on you.

You gain a Ruffian subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Ruffian levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass' features that are of your Ruffian level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [Feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Ruffian levels 8, 12 and 16.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: You are always prepared for a brawl. Instead of losing all your Grit on a Short or Long Rest, you retain one third of your maximum, rounded up.
If you have fewer than that remaining, you regain Grit Points until you have one third of your maximum, rounded up.

You can abuse the fact that a foe is lowering their defense to attack. When you are hit by an Attack Roll and take damage from it, you can use your Reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against the creature that attacked you.
You can use your Barrage feature on this attack.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a feature from your Ruffian subclass.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: You are quick to adapt to physically challenging tasks. When you fail a Strength or Dexterity based Ability Check, you can expend one Grit to reroll the check with a bonus equal to your Constitution modifier.

You are extraordinarily difficult to pin down. Whenever you are forced to make an Ability Check or Saving Throw to end or avoid a Condition on yourself you can expend two Grit to end or avoid the Condition without making the Ability Check or Saving Throw.
If the Ability Check or Saving Throw requires an Action you can use this feature as a Bonus Action instead.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [Feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

9.name: Class Features
9.value: Your experience on the battlefield quickly tells you a creature's weaknesses and lets you exploit them. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Attack Roll you can choose to target its armor instead of doing damage. The creature makes a Constitution Saving Throw against the total rolled for your Attack Roll. On a failed save its Armor Class is reduced by your current Grit until the end of your next turn.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a feature from your Ruffian subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: You hit hard enough to knock a creature out. After hitting a creature with an Attack Roll and after rolling damage, you can expend six Grit to force the target to make a Constitution Saving Throw with a DC equal to 8 + your [Proficiency Bonus](https://5e.tools/tables.html#proficiency%20bonus_xphb) + the ability modifier used for the attack. On a failed save the creature becomes Unconscious for one minute, until someone else within 5 feet of it uses an Action to shake it awake or until it takes damage.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [Feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

13.name: Class Features
13.value: You know how to draw the attention of others to yourself. At the start of your first turn in combat you can use your Daunting Presence feature on all creatures of your choice within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a feature from your Ruffian subclass.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: You know how to make a final stand. When you drop to 0 Hit Points but don't die outright, you can expend eight Grit and Hit Point Dice equal to up to half your Ruffian level, rounded down (no Reaction required). Your Hit Points then change to the number rolled on the Hit Point Dice + your Ruffian level instead.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [Feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: Your battlecries strike fear into the hearts of your enemies. As a Bonus Action you can force all creatures of your choice within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you to make a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Daunting Presence Save DC. Creatures that are fixated on you make this Saving Throw with Disadvantage. On a failed save the creature's Movement Speed is reduced to 0 and it makes all Attack Rolls and Saving Throws with Disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: You gain a feature from your Ruffian subclass.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon Feat or another [Feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. __Boon of Fortitude__ or __Boon of Recovery__ are recommended.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: You will never give up. You can grant yourself the following at the start of your turn (no action required):

entries: You gain Resistance to all damage.
You remove all Conditions from yourself and become immune to all Conditions.
You gain Advantage on all Melee Attack Rolls you make.
Your movement cannot be restricted in any way.

20.value: These benefits last until the end of your next turn. Once you use this feature you cannot use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Bodyguard (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
3.value: As tempting as the prospect of wealth and power might be, there will always be those who seek to take it from you. Influential people therefore often employ bodyguards to ensure their protection. These ruffians do not follow military procedures other guards might hold sacred. For them, there is only one goal: to protect those they have either sworn to or are being paid to protect. To do so, they are not afraid of playing dirty. After all, honor does not pay for anything if the source of the payment died for it.

You will give your life to shield others from harm. When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an Attack Roll, you can expend a use of your Grit Damage Reduction feature to reduce the damage dealt to them. If the target still takes damage, you gain a Grit as if you had been hit by the attack.

The shield you carry can be both a defensive and an offensive tool. While carrying a Shield you can use your Bonus Action to attempt the Shove option of the Unarmed Strike rule with it to push a creature away or knock it Prone.
You can use this feature without a Shield; in this case the target has Advantage on its Saving Throw against the Shove.

6.name: Bodyguard (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
6.value: You know how to get your allies out of harm's way. Once on your turn you can expend half your Movement Speed to touch a willing creature and swap places with them. The target can immediately move up to half their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your half your Charisma modifier (rounded up, minimum of once). You regain one use of this feature when you finish a Short Rest and all of its uses when you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Bodyguard (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
10.value: You can shield a creature from harm. As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can expend four Grit to touch a creature. As long as the target remains within 5 feet of you, you grant it Three-Quarters Cover until the start of your next turn.

14.name: Bodyguard (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
14.value: You can draw attention away from those you have sworn to protect, but doing so leaves yourself open to attacks. At the end of your turn, all creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you that are fixated on you make a Intelligence Saving Throw against your Daunting Presence Save DC.

On a failed save, the creature must use its Action on its next turn to try dealing damage to you. Any Attack Rolls they make against you gain Advantage and you have Disadvantage on all Saving Throws against them.

18.name: Bodyguard (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
18.value: You are willing to sacrifice yourself for those you have sworn to protect. When a creature within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can use your Reaction to rush to their side. You can move up to your speed towards the target. If you make it within 5 feet of the target, they regain Hit Points equal to your current Grit times 10. You then lose the same amount of Hit Points.
If this features causes you to drop to 0 Hit Points and fall Unconscious, you immediately become stable.
Once you use this feature you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Brawler (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
3.value: While most Ruffians know how to wield a weapon, not all of them prefer doing so. Sometimes a good old right hook can get you places as well. Brawlers are often involved in bar and street fights. There is something honorable about meeting your foe eye to eye to determine the outcome of a fight with no weapons but just the pure strength of your arms. Brawlers are often employed by crime lords to intimidate rivals and to make sure that debts are paid. When the fist of a Brawler hits your jaw and you can hear an unsettling crack, you'll think twice about angering them again.
Your left and right hooks are feared everywhere.

3.name: Heavy Hitter
3.value: You can roll a 1d6 (d6) in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike and add your [Proficiency Bonus](https://5e.tools/tables.html#proficiency%20bonus_xphb) to the damage dealt.

3.name: Iron Grip
3.value: When you use the Grapple or Shove option of Unarmed Strike as an Opportunity Attack, the target has Disadvantage on the Saving Throw against it.
In addition, when you forcefully move a target that you have grappled, you can use your movement to follow it. This does not break the grapple.

3.name: Bonus Unarmed Strike
3.value: You can make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. You cannot use this feature if you are wielding a Shield.
When you aren't wearing Medium or Heavy armor or wielding a Shield, you gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of +1).

6.name: Brawler (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
6.value: Immediately after you make an Unarmed Strike, you can spend 2 Grit to take the Dodge Action. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a special reaction that you can take on every creature's turn except your turn. You can take this reaction only to make an Opportunity Attack, and you can't take it on the same turn that you take your normal reaction.
Whenever you take the Dodge Action, you can use your Counter feature when you are targeted by an Attack Roll while you are dodging, even if the attack misses or doesn't deal damage.
You hit like a truck. What's a truck? I don't know.

6.name: Forceful Blows
6.value: Whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

6.name: Punch Above Your Weight
6.value: You don't shy away from opponents bigger than you. The Grapple option of your Unarmed Strike no longer has a size restriction. When you grapple an opponent that is more than one size category larger than you, your speed is reduced to 0 instead of your opponent's, and your opponent can drag or carry you along as if they had grappled you instead.

10.name: Brawler (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
10.value: As a Bonus Action, you can force a creature within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you into a duel. The target makes an Charisma Saving Throw against your Daunting Presence Save DC. A creature that is fixated on you makes this Saving Throw with Disadvantage. On a failed save you and the target both get Disadvantage on all Attack Rolls against targets other than each other, and every other creature gains Advantage on Saving Throws against your spells and abilities.

The Duel lasts for one minute or until one of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points. If you reduce the target to 0 Hit Points you can choose to expend any available Hit Point Dice and heal for the amount rolled without adding your Constitution modifier.

14.name: Brawler (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
14.value: Your punches can leave a creature reeling. Once on a turn when you hit a creature with an Attack Roll, you can expend two Grit to lay extra weight into the punch.

The target makes a Constitution Saving Throw against a DC of 8 + your [Proficiency Bonus](https://5e.tools/tables.html#proficiency%20bonus_xphb) + the Ability Modifier used for the attack. On a failed save the creature's Movement Speed is halved, it cannot take Reactions and it can only use an Action or a Bonus Action (not both) on its turn until the start of your next turn.

18.name: Brawler (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
18.value: Your punches leave your opponent crippled. Whenever you hit with an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, the target's Movement Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This effect can stack.

3.name: Opportunist (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
3.value:
*This subclass is a **Work in Progress**. It is not finished and might change drastically in the future. Balance? What is "Balance"?*
*Slippery Mind and Slippery Body are essentially placeholder features right now. Slippery Mind I think does fit, but it is a straight copy from Rogue level 15.*
You know how to get things done, and you don't mind fighting dirty to get there. Life on the street has not only told you how to take a hit, but also how to strike one where it *really* hurts.

You know how to hit where it hurts, and you don't hesitate to do it. Once per turn, you can deal an extra **1d8** damage to a creature you hit with a melee attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll. The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.
The extra damage increases as you gain Ruffian levels, as shown in the Below the Belt column of the Ruffian Features table.

You are an expert at annoying and distracting your opponents. You can use the Help action as a Bonus Action. Instead of giving an ally Advantage against an opponent within 5 feet of you, you can choose to give the opponent Disadvantage on their next attack against a target other than you before the start of your next turn.

6.name: Opportunist (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
6.value: Whenever you use your Barrage feature to gain additional attacks, you can instead use it to empower your __Below the Belt__ feature.
Each Grit you spend increases the damage of your Below the Belt feature by 1d8.
You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. *Athletics* and *Intimidation* are recommended if you have proficiency in them.

10.name: Opportunist (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
10.value: You've added a few tricks to your __Below the Belt__. When you deal Below the Belt damage, you can add one of the following Twist the Knife effects. Each effect has a die cost, which is the number of Below the Belt damage dice you must forgo to add the effect. You remove the die before rolling, and the effect occurs immediately after the attack's damage is dealt. For example, if you add the Grapple effect, remove 1d8 from the Below the Belt's damage before rolling.

10.name: Distract (Cost: 1d8)
10.value: The target must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw or become Daunting Presence until the end of its next turn.

10.name: Grapple (Cost: 1d8)
10.value: In addition to the usual effects of your attack, you use the "Grapple" effect of the Unarmed Strike feature.

10.name: Shove (Cost: 1d8)
10.value: In addition to the usual effects of your attack, you use the "Shove" effect of the Unarmed Strike feature.

14.name: Opportunist (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
14.value: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma Saving Throws.

18.name: Opportunist (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
18.value: You cannot be critically hit. If an attacker rolls a 20 on an Attack Roll against you, the attacker rolls the attack's damage dice only once.

3.name: Sentry (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
3.value: Fighting the good (or bad) fight might lead to a lot of kinship. Some Ruffians form tight bonds with their companions, even if it is just the lust or need for money that brings them all together. These Sentrys are hell-bent on making sure that none of their allies get hurt, and their resilience and determination inspires those around them to never give up. Even–or perhaps especially–if the odds are against them.

Your perseverance in the face of pain encourages your allies to fight harder. Whenever you expend Grit, you may give Encouragement to a creature other than yourself within 60 feet that can see or hear you. The target gains a bonus equal to half your Charisma modifier (rounded up, minimum of 1) to either their Saving Throws, Armor Class, or Attack Rolls until the end of their next turn. The target chooses one of the effects when you activate this ability.
You can be knocked down 10 times, but stand up 11! When you make a Death Saving Throw, a total result of 19 or better counts as if you had rolled a natural 20.
Additionally, each time you make a Death Saving Throw–prior to rolling–you may expend any number of Grit to add this number to the roll.

6.name: Sentry (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
6.value: You hate seeing your friends get hurt. When a creature that you can see or hear is hit by an Attack Roll and takes damage, you can expend 3 Grit and your reaction to move up to your speed toward the attacker and use your Counter ability as if you had been the target of the attack.

10.name: Sentry (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
10.value: Allies benefitting from your __Inspiring Toughness__ feature now add your full Charisma modifier instead of half (minimum of 1).
Additionally, they may instead use the bonus to apply it to the save DC of spells or abilities they use or to their Death Saving Throws they make before the end of their next turn.

14.name: Sentry (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
14.value: Whenever you use your Grand Entrance feature you may grant __Inspiring Toughness__ to any number of allies within range of the effect.
Additionally, you may use your Grand Entrance feature again whenever you regain consciousness as the result of a Death Saving Throw.

18.name: Sentry (ALTERNERDTIVETHERUFFIANREVISED) Features
18.value: You can use your Last Stand feature once per Long Rest without expending any Grit.

Additionally, when an ally within 60 feet of you that you can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may use your Reaction to let them use your Last Stand feature. The target expends their own Hit Point Dice and adds your Ruffian level to determine the number of Hit Points gained. If they have no Hit Point Dice remaining, they cannot benefit from this feature.

1.name: Class Features
1.value: Through channelling the energy of the spiritual world, you are able to manipulate the area around you through limited magical powers. See chapter 7 of the PHB for rules on spellcasting. The information below details the spellcasting rules specific for the Spiritualist.

1.name: Cantrips
1.value: You know two Spiritualist Cantrips of your choice. __Haunting Whispers__ and __Thaumaturgy__ are recommended. Whenever you gain a Spiritualist level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Spiritualist Cantrips of your choice.

1.name: Spell Slots
1.value: The Spiritualist Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your Spiritualist spells of levels 1–5. The table also shows the level of those slots, all of which are the same level. You regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
For example, when you're a level 5 Spiritualist, you have two level 3 spell slots. To cast the level 1 spell __Inflict Wounds__, you must spend one of those slots, and you cast it as a level 3 spell.

1.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
1.value: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two level 1 Spiritualist spells. __Inflict Wounds__ and __Hex__ are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Spiritualist levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Spiritualist Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Spiritualist spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the table. The chosen spells must be of a level no higher than what's shown in the table's Slot Level column for your level. When you reach level 6, for example, you learn a new Spiritualist spell, which can be of levels 1–3.

If another Spiritualist feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Spiritualist spells for you.

1.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
1.value: Whenever you gain a Spiritualist level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Spiritualist spell of an eligible level.

1.name: Spellcasting Ability
1.value: *Choose One:* Charisma or Wisdom is the spellcasting ability used for your Spiritualist Spells.

1.name: Spellcasting Focus
1.value: You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Spiritualist Spells.

You can let a spirit possess you during a Séance. While possessed in this manner your willpower and magical prowess is increased. You can start a Séance using a Bonus Action, provided you are holding your Spiritualist Spellcasting Focus.

You can start a Séance the number of times shown for your Spiritualist level in the Séances column of the Spiritualist Features Table. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
While active, the Séance follows the rules below.

1.name: Damage Resistance
1.value: You have resistance to Necrotic and Poison damage.

1.name: Séance Damage
1.value: When you deal damage with a cantrip or spell of 1st level or higher, you deal extra damage. This extra damage is equal to the Séance Bonus shown for your Spiritualist level in the Spiritualist Features Table.

1.name: Séance Willpower
1.value: While holding a Séance you can add your Séance Bonus to checks made with Intelligence (history), Wisdom (insight and perception), and Charisma (deception, performance, and persuasion) Ability Checks.

1.name: Strengthened Willpower
1.value: You have advantage on Saving Throws against being Charmed, Frightened, or Possessed.

1.name: A Voice Not Your Own
1.value: While in a Séance you typically channel one returning spirit, whose voice and mannerisms you adopt.

1.name: Duration
1.value: The Séance lasts until the end of your next turn and ends early if you stop holding your Spiritualist Spellcasting Focus or have the Incapacitated condition. If your Séance is still active on your next turn, you can extend the Séance for another round by doing the following:

entries: Make an Attack Roll against an enemy, using your Cantrips or Spells.
Force an enemy to make a Saving Throw, using your Cantrips or Spells.
Take a Bonus Action to extend your Séance

1.value: Each time your Séance is extended, it lasts until the end of your next turn. You can maintain a Séance for up to 10 minutes.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: Your connection to the spiritual world has allowed you to tap into your intuitions as a medium. You gain two Medium Intuitions of your choice, such as Ghostly Weapons and Spiritual Training. Medium Intuitions are described in the "Medium Intution Options" section later in this class's description.

2.name: Prerequisites
2.value: If an intuition has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that intuition. For example, if an intuition requires you to be a level 5+ Spiritualist, you can select the intuition once you reach Spiritualist level 5.

2.name: Replacing and Gaining Intuitions
2.value: Whenever you gain a Spiritualist level, you can replace one of your intuitions with another one for which you qualify. You can't replace an intuition if it's a prerequisite for another intuition that you have.
When you reach Spiritualist level 5, 10, and 15, you gain two more Medium Intuitions.
You can't pick the same Intuition more than once, unless the description says otherwise.
You can perform a cleansing ritual for 1 minute. At the end of it, you expend 1 use of Séances to regain 1 expended Pact Magic spell slot.
You can use this feature a number of times, equal to your Spiritualist spellcasting ability modifier, regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain a Spiritualist subclass of your choice. The __Biokinetic Haunting__, __Cryokinetic Haunting__, __Electrokinetic Haunting__, __Pyrokinetic Haunting__, and __Telekinetic Haunting__ subclasses are detailed after the class's description. A subclass is a specialisation that grants you features at certain Spiritualist levels. For the rest of your career you gain each of the subclass's features that are of your Spiritualist level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify (as detailed in chapter 5 of the PHB). You gain this feature again at Spiritualist levels 8, 12, and 16.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a Spiritualist subclass feature from your Spiritualist subclass.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: Whenever a creature dies, the spiritual world briefly gets strengthened. Whenever you or an ally reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you can use your Reaction to empower your next spell. When casting that spell, you either get Advantage on the Attack Rolls or the targets get Disadvantage on the Saving Throw.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Spiritualist spellcasting modifier, regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
You cannot use this feature when you or an ally reduces an Undead or Construct to 0 Hit Points.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify (as detailed in chapter 5 of the PHB).

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a Spiritualist subclass feature from your Spiritualist subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: Your spiritual connection grants you the ability to use more advanced spells, known as Spiritual Insight. Choose one level 6 Spiritualist spell as this insight.
You can cast the insight spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

As shown in the Spiritualist Features Table, you gain another Spiritualist spell of your choice that can be cast this way when you reach level Spiritualist levels 13 (level 7 spell), 15 (level 8 spell), and 17 (level 9 spell). You regain all uses of your Spiritual Insights when you finish a Long Rest.
Whenever you gain a Spiritualist level you can replace one of your insight spells with another Spiritualist spell of the same level.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify (as detailed in chapter 5 of the PHB).

13.name: Class Features
13.value: You gain a level 7 Spiritualist spell of your choice.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a Spiritualist subclass feature from your Spiritualist subclass.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: You gain a level 8 Spiritualist spell of your choice.
You have spent so much time connecting with the spiritual world, that you have become less aware of the line between life and death. You gain Advantage on Death Saving Throws.
Additionally, you gain 30-foot Ethereal Sight, which allows you to see into the Ethereal Plane.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify (as detailed in chapter 5 of the PHB).

17.name: Class Features
17.value: You gain a level 9 Spiritualist spell of your choice.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: You have connected with the spiritual world so much that you can remove your own spirit from your body. Whenever you hold a Séance, your own spirit increases your spell's range by 60 feet.
Additionally, whenever you use a Bonus Action to start a Séance or maintain it, you may cast one additional cantrip.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an  gain an Epic Boon feat (see chapter 5 of the PHB) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. The __Boon of Dimensional Travel__ is recommended.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: Your Wisdom and Charisma scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

3.name: Biokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
3.value: *Control the Actions of Others*

Spiritualists who channel a spirit that lessens their grasp on that spiritualist, to possess others, belong to the Biokinetic Haunting group. These Spiritualists learn how to control their free roaming spirit, to control the actions of others.

__Biokinetic Spells (WOSPHA)__: Your connection to the spiritual world ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Spiritualist level specified in the Biokinetic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

table.title: Biokinetic Spells
rows: Charm Person, Command, Hold Person, Suggestion

3.value: __Controlling Séance (WOSPHA)__: The spirit that you channel has started to get bored of your body. As a result, it will try possessing the others around you. While holding a Séance you gain the following benefits:

3.name: Minor Possession
3.value: Once on your turn after casting a cantrip or spell of 1st level or higher, you can boost or hinder one of your targets. The target gets a bonus or penalty (your choice) to their D20 Test results. The bonus/penalty is equal to your Séance bonus. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

3.name: Damage Resistance
3.value: You gain resistance to Psychic damage.

6.name: Biokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
6.value: Your look can very easily charm another creature. When you cast a spell from your __Biokinetic Spells__, you don't require vocal, somatic, or material components. This spell also doesn't consume a spell slot.
You can use this feature once, regaining the use when you finish a Long Rest or by expending 2 Séance (no action required).

10.name: Biokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
10.value: When you cast __Dominate Beast__ or __Dominate Person__, you can use your Bonus Action to target one additional beast/humanoid.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your spellcasting modifier, regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Biokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
14.value: The spirit you channel has entered so many creatures, that it can now more easily do that.

14.name: Instant Possession
14.value: You learn the __Dominate Monster__ spell, which you can only cast in a specific manner: When you start your Séance you may cast Dominate Monster as part of the same Bonus action.
You can use this feature once, regaining the use when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Psychic Immunity
14.value: You become immune to psychic damage, while holding a Séance.

3.name: Cryokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
3.value: *Be a Chill Up Someone's Spine*

Spiritualists who channel spirits that lower the temperature around them more than others belong to the Cryokinetic Haunting group. These Spiritualists use the lowered temperature to harm and slow their enemies.

__Cryokinetic Spells (WOSPHA)__: Your connection to the spiritual world ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Spiritualist level specified in the Cryokinetic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

table.title: Cryokinetic Spells
rows: Armour of Agathys, Ice Blade, Ice Knife, Icey Floor

3.value: __Frigid Séance (WOSPHA)__: The spirit that you channel has a much stronger effect on the temperature than the others. As a result, you will be making the area around you colder. While holding a Séance you gain the following benefits:

3.name: Frigid Aura
3.value: All enemy creatures, who start their turn within 10 feet of you, will take cold damage. To determine this cold damage, roll a number of d4s, equal to your Séance Bonus.

3.name: Damage Resistance
3.value: You become resistant to Cold damage.

6.name: Cryokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
6.value: Your look is very cold, just seeing it may make you shiver. When you cast a spell from your __Cryokinetic Spells__, you don't require vocal, somatic, or material components. This spell also doesn't consume a spell slot.
You can use this feature once, regaining the use when you finish a Long Rest or by expending 2 Séance (no action required).

10.name: Cryokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
10.value: When you deal cold damage, using your __Frigid Séance__ feature, that creature can only move up to half their speed, until the start of their next turn.
Additionally, upon dealing __Frigid Séance__ damage you can take a Reaction to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

14.name: Cryokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
14.value: The cold aura has made you permanently cold. So cold it could completely freeze someone.

14.name: Freezing Touch
14.value: When someone, within 5 feet, hits you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to give them the Restrained condition. That creature is Restrained for 1 minute. At the start of each of their turns they may make a Constitution saving throw, against your spellcasting save DC, to end the effect early.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Spiritualist spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1), regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Ice Immunity
14.value: You gain immunity to cold damage, while you are holding a Séance.

3.name: Electrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
3.value: *Wield the Power to Alter Power*

Spiritualists who channel spirits that have a strong electric charge belong to the Electrokinetic Haunting group. These Spiritualists use the static electricity of the spirits to boost or hinder the reflexes of creatures.

__Electrokinetic Spells (WOSPHA)__: Your connection to the spiritual world ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Spiritualist level specified in the Electrokinetic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

table.title: Electrokinetic Spells
rows: Lightning Arc, Lightning Blade, Sparks, Witch Bolt

3.value: __Electrifying Séance (WOSPHA)__: The spirit you channel has a much stronger effect on the electrical charges around you. As a result, you can manipulate the static electricity around you. While holding a Séance you gain the following benefits:

3.name: Electrifying Reflexes
3.value: You may take the Dash or Disengage action as the Bonus Action to start or maintain the Séance.

3.name: Charged Body
3.value: You may add your Séance Bonus to Dexterity saving throws and saving throws you make against being Stunned or Paralysed.

3.name: Damage Resistance
3.value: You become resistant to Lightning damage.

6.name: Electrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
6.value: Your look is very electrifying, just seeing it may shock you. When you cast a spell from your __Electrokinetic Spells__, you don't require vocal, somatic, or material components. This spell also doesn't consume a spell slot.
You can use this feature once, regaining the use when you finish a Long Rest or by expending 2 Séance (no action required).

10.name: Electrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
10.value: Your field of energy spreads around much more, granting you the following benefits while holding a Séance:

10.name: Jolting Reflexes
10.value: All allies who start their turn within 15 feet of you may take the Dash and Disengage action as a Bonus Action on that turn.

10.name: Static Reflexes
10.value: All enemies who are within 15 feet of you get a penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws. The penalty is equal to the Séance bonus.

14.name: Electrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
14.value: The static electricity that surrounds you has made you more sensitive to your surroundings.

14.name: Electric Sense
14.value: You gain blindsight for 30 feet.

14.name: Charge Body
14.value: As a Bonus Action, while you can see a creature within 30 feet, you can make lightning arc across their body. That creature must succeed a Constitution saving throw, against your spellcasting saving throw, or all creatures have Advantage on attack rolls against them, until the start of your next turn. Creatures wearing metal armour have Disadvantage on this saving throw.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Spiritualist spellcasting modifier (minimum of 1), regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Electricity Immunity
14.value: You gain immunity to lightning damage while holding a Séance.

3.name: Pyrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
3.value: *Let Passion or Rage Visibly Burn*

Spiritualists who frequently experience fires burning brighter when holding a Séance, often consider themselves part of the Pyrokinetic Haunting group. These Spiritualists learn how to use the passion and rage of the spirit that they can channel, to make fires spontaneously appear.

__Pyrokinetic Spells (WOSPHA)__: Your connection to the spiritual world ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Spiritualist level specified in the Pyrokinetic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

table.title: Pyrokinetic Spells
rows: Burning Hands, Flame Blade, Heat Metal, Hellish Rebuke

3.value: __Scalding Séance (WOSPHA)__: The spirit that you channel has such a passionate or angry personality that it empowers your damage output. While holding a Séance you gain the following benefits:

3.name: Fire Touch
3.value: Once on your turn, you may add extra damage when you deal damage with a weapon attack or cantrip. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Séance Bonus and add them together. The extra damage is considered Fire damage.

3.name: Damage Resistance
3.value: You become resistant to Fire damage.

6.name: Pyrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
6.value: Your look can spontaneously start fires. When you cast a spell from your __Pyrokinetic Spells__, you don't require vocal, somatic, or material components. This spell also doesn't consume a spell slot.
You can use this feature once, regaining the use when you finish a Long Rest or by expending 2 Séance (no action required).

10.name: Pyrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
10.value: When you deal Fire damage, using your __Scalding Séance__ feature, you may deal half that damage to all creatures within 5 feet of one target.

14.name: Pyrokinetic (WOSPHA) Features
14.value: The fire burns so fiercely inside of you, it must be directly connected to the underworld.

14.name: Stronger Fire
14.value: You ignore Fire damage resistance and treat Fire damage immunity as a resistance.

14.name: Heat Immunity
14.value: You gain immunity to fire damage, while you are holding a Séance.

3.name: Telekinetic (WOSPHA) Features
3.value: *Make Distant Objects Move and Float*

Spiritualists who frequently experience objects being moved around during their Séances belong to the Telekinetic Haunting group. These spiritualists use poltergeists to move objects and creatures around.

__Telekinetic Spells (WOSPHA)__: Your connection to the spiritual world ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Spiritualist level specified in the Telekinetic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

table.title: Telekinetic Spells
rows: Knock, Levitate, Tenser's Floating Disk, Unseen Servant

3.value: __Levitating Séance (WOSPHA)__: The spirit you channel has such a passion for moving objects that you can use it to your advantage. While holding a Séance you gain the following benefits:

3.name: Poltergeist Activity
3.value: When you start your Séance tiny sized objects will start levitating around you. The number of objects you get is equal to your Séance Bonus.

As part of the Bonus Action to start or maintain the Séance, you may make a ranged spell attack against one target for each object, within 30 feet. On a hit the target takes **1d4** + your spellcasting modifier bludgeoning damage.

3.name: Damage Resistance
3.value: You become resistant to force damage.

6.name: Telekinetic (WOSPHA) Features
6.value: Your look can knock over objects. When you cast a spell from your __Telekinetic Spells__, you don't require vocal, somatic, or material components. This spell also doesn't consume a spell slot.
You can use this feature once, regaining the use when you finish a Long Rest or by expending 2 Séance (no action required).

10.name: Telekinetic (WOSPHA) Features
10.value: When you use your Bonus Action for a Poltergeist Activity, you can instead use more objects in the same attack, to get one of the effects listed below. You only deal damage as if you hit with one of the objects.

10.name: Knock Down (2 Objects)
10.value: A creature must succeed a Strength saving throw, against your spellcasting DC, or be knocked prone.

10.name: Forceful (2 Objects)
10.value: A creature must succeed a Strength saving throw, against your spellcasting DC, or be pushed 10 feet away or towards you.

10.name: Levitate (3 Objects)
10.value: A creature must succeed a Strength saving throw, against your spellcasting DC, or be moved 30 feet up into the air.

14.name: Telekinetic (WOSPHA) Features
14.value: The spirit loves moving things around so much that you become very proficient at moving objects.

14.name: Effortless Manipulation
14.value: When you cast one of your __Telekinetic Spells__, you may target one additional creature/object.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Spiritualist spellcasting modifier, regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

14.name: Spectral Reach
14.value: The range of your __Telekinetic Spells__, with a range of Touch or at least 5 feet, increases by 30 feet.

14.name: Force Immunity
14.value: You gain immunity to force damage, while holding a Séance.
