1.name: Class Features
1.value: Choose where you first learned the basics of magic.

*You can work with your GM to create an Arcane Initiation to suit your character's background. Choose two cantrips of your choice from any class's spell list; one cantrip should be suitable for combat, and the other for utility. Avoid choosing cantrips that are otherwise exclusive to another spellcaster. Also choose one skill.*
You have learned the simple, yet potent brand of spellcasting for which Warmages are known.

1.name: Cantrips
1.value: You know four Warmage cantrips of your choice. __Force Dart__, __Prestidigitation__, __Quickstep__, and __Shocking Grasp__ are recommended. Whenever you gain a Warmage level, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Warmage cantrip of your choice. You can't replace a cantrip that is a prerequisite for a Warmage trick, unless you replace the trick at the same time.
You learn additional Warmage cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Warmage Features table.
If another Warmage feature gives you cantrips, those cantrips don't count against your number of cantrips known, but otherwise count as Warmage cantrips for you.

1.name: Spellcasting Ability
1.value: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Warmage spells.

1.name: Spellcasting Focus
1.value: You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Warmage spells.
Once per turn when you cast a Warmage cantrip, you can improve the spell, gaining the following benefits.

1.name: Intelligence to Damage
1.value: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of the spell if you don't already add it.

1.name: Improved Cantrip Upgrade
1.value: Starting at Warmage level 5, you improve one damage roll of the spell, adding extra dice to the damage roll as shown on the Cantrip Bonus Dice column of the Warmage Features table.

2.name: Class Features
2.value: When you cast a Warmage cantrip at a creature and you miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on a saving throw against the cantrip, the target takes the cantrip's minimum amount of damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip. You can apply Warmage Edge to this damage (which also deals minimum damage), but you can't use this damage to trigger Warmage Tricks. For example, if you cast __Force Dart__ and miss, you can apply Warmage Edge to deal Force damage equal to 1 plus your Intelligence modifier.

You learn to use Warmage tricks, special techniques that alter the way you fight, move, and cast your spells. You learn two tricks of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites. Warmage Tricks are described in the "Warmage Trick Options" section later on in the class's description.

2.name: Prerequisites
2.value: If a trick has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that trick. For example, if a trick requires you to be a level 5+ Warmage, you can select the trick once you reach Warmage level 5.

2.name: Replacing and Gaining Tricks
2.value: Whenever you gain a Warmage level, you can replace one of your tricks with another one for which you qualify. When you gain certain Warmage levels, you gain more tricks of your choice, as shown in the Tricks column of the Warmage Features table. You can't pick the same trick more than once unless its description says otherwise.

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You gain a Warmage subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Warmage levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Warmage level or lower.

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: Once on each of your turns, when you deal damage with a Warmage cantrip, you can double the number of damage dice dealt by the spell, as if you scored a Critical Hit. If you use this feature to improve a spell that has already scored a Critical Hit, the cantrip deals triple the number of damage dice in total.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain an additional use when you reach Warmage level 11.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a bonus to saving throws against spells and other magical effects equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1). You don't gain this bonus to Intelligence saving throws.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: You gain a feature from your Warmage Subclass.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain a feature from your Warmage Subclass.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: You gain an additional use of Arcane Surge.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: When a creature casts a spell that forces you to make a saving throw to avoid damage, you can take a Reaction to attempt to redirect some of the spell's energy to a new target. If you succeed on your saving throw against the spell, choose another creature you can see within the spell's range or up to 30 feet away from you, whichever is closer, to make a saving throw against the spell, using your spell save DC. The chosen creature can be the original spellcaster. On a failed save, the creature suffers the effects of the spell as if you had cast the spell and it had been the original target or been within the area of the spell.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: You gain a feature from your Warmage Subclass.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the __Ability Score Improvement__ feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: You gain a feature from your Warmage Subclass.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: Whenever you roll Initiative and have no uses of Arcane Surge left, you regain one expended use of it.

3.name: Coalition Arcanist (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Conquer the Battlefield Through Tactical Superiority*

Warfare in the 'Verse is a perilous dance of arcana and technology that stretches across entire star systems. In this new theater of combat, none have adapted better than the Coalition and their squads of Warmage arcanists. Equipped with specially-designed blaster gauntlets, a coalition arcanist wields magic as others do a blaster: firing off spells automatically, in shotgun-style bursts, and in deadly beams that can level an entire company of foes.

__Blaster Gauntlet (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain a specialized Arcane Focus known as a Blaster Gauntlet. When you cast a Warmage cantrip that requires a ranged spell attack roll using this gauntlet as a focus, you can overheat the cantrip. The cantrip's damage dice increase by one step (d4 → d6 → d8 → d10 → d12, to a maximum of d12s) for this casting. The cantrip then overheats; you can't cast this cantrip again until the end of your next turn.

7.name: Coalition Arcanist (DARKMATTER24) Features
7.value: You have been fitted with a neural implant, granting you unparalleled battlefield awareness. You can take a Magic action to gain knowledge of the general lay of the land within a 1-mile Emanation originating from you. This knowledge only extends to surface-level or obvious features (natural or artificial) and doesn't detect creatures. Additionally, you have a +5 bonus to your Passive Wisdom (*Perception*) score.

10.name: Coalition Arcanist (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: You can requisition magic items from the Coalition's armory for short-term use. When you finish a Long Rest, choose one of the following magic items, which is teleported to you: a Concussion Grenade, Drive Wheel, Hoverboard, Jetpack, Nanobot Canister (Deconstructive or Reconstructive), Phase Suit, or Scout Scanner. If the magic item has a save DC, it uses your spell save DC. If it requires Attunement, it is attuned to you automatically. This item remains in your possession until you finish a Long Rest, at which time it is teleported back to the Coalition's armory.

15.name: Coalition Arcanist (DARKMATTER24) Features
15.value: Your tactical uplink synchronizes you with your allies, granting you a decisive tactical advantage. While you are within 120 feet of an ally, you know the exact location of any creature that your ally sees. Additionally, you can cast a Warmage cantrip targeting a creature that your ally can see. You launch the cantrip like a mortar, ricochet it off obstacles, or fire it through thin barriers to hit the target.

18.name: Coalition Arcanist (DARKMATTER24) Features
18.value: As a Magic action, you can mark a point you can see within 120 feet of yourself for destruction. At the start of your next turn, the Coalition delivers a magical bombardment in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each creature within the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking **10d10** Force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are reduced to ash.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Bishops (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Wield Greater Arcane Magic*

The House of Bishops adopts Warmages with arcane potential and teaches its members traditional spellcasting. Such Warmages might be mistaken for Wizards or Sorcerers, for they wield many of the same spells, but bishops prioritize excellence in their spellcasting over a wide repertoire of spells.
__Spellcasting (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain the ability to cast more potent spells.

3.name: Spell Slots
3.value: The Bishop Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
3.value: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose three level 1 spells from the Wizard spell list. __Burning Hands__, __Grease__, and __Shield__ are recommended. The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Warmage levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Bishop Spellcasting table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the Wizard spell list until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 7 Warmage, your list of prepared spells can include five Wizard spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.

3.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
3.value: Whenever you gain a Warmage level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Wizard spell for which you have spell slots.

3.name: Warmage Edge
3.value: You can use your Warmage Edge feature to improve the damage rolls of level 1+ Wizard spells as if they were cantrips. If you add Warmage Edge to the __Magic Missile__ spell, you improve the damage roll of only one dart.
__Arcane Study (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: *Arcana*, *History*, *Investigation*, *Medicine*, or *Religion*.

7.name: Bishops (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You always have the __Find Familiar__ spell prepared, which doesn't count against your number of prepared spells. When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: __Imp__, __Pseudodragon__, __Quasit__, or __Sprite__.

10.name: Bishops (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: Your Warmage and Wizard spells deal double damage to objects and structures. You have Advantage on spell attack rolls against targets that are 100 or more feet away from you.

15.name: Bishops (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: When you cast a spell with a spell slot that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

18.name: Bishops (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a number of spell slots with a combined level of 6+ to regain one expended use of your Arcane Surge.

3.name: Cards (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Push Your Luck With Hands of Cards*

Warmages who join the House of Cards approach combat the same way they do games of chance: with high stakes and calculated gambles. Each Warmage of this house wields a special deck of cards tied to the very threads of fate, through which they can empower their magic with deft flurries of hands. However, while these Warmages command incredible power, their magical surges are at the whims of the cards, and so they must make strategic, ingenious plays to master them.

__Bluff (VALDAWARMAGE)__: Your poker face carries you through practically any lie. You gain proficiency in the *Deception* skill and with the Gaming Kit (Playing Cards), if you don't already have it. Additionally, you gain a bonus to Charisma (*Deception*) checks equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

__Deck Of Fate (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain a deck of magical playing or tarot cards, called a Deck of Fate, through which you can enhance the power of your cantrips. Shuffle a standard 52-card playing card deck and draw a hand of five cards when you roll Initiative.

Whenever you target an enemy with a Warmage spell that deals damage, you can take a Bonus Action to play one or more cards from your hand to enhance the power of the spell. If the cards exactly match one of the results on the Hands table, the spell deals extra damage to one of its targets of your choice or grants you one additional effect, according to the result. If the cards don't match a result, they have no effect. Aces count as ones for results. Once you play a card, place it on the bottom of your deck and draw until you have five cards in your hand again.

table.title: Hands
rows: Any five sequential cards, regardless of suit.
Any five cards of the same suit, regardless of order.
Any three of the same rank.
Any two of the same rank.
You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Intelligence modifier.
Your Speed increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
You gain a +1 bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn.
You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws until the start of your next turn.

7.name: Cards (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: On your turn, you can choose any number of cards from your hand and place them on the bottom of your __Deck of Fate__ (no action required), losing 2 Hit Points per card you choose. You then draw until you have five cards in your hand again.

10.name: Cards (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: You can take a Bonus Action to gain one of the following effects, chosen by the GM.

10.name: Resistance
10.value: You gain Resistance to all damage until the end of your next turn.

10.name: Teleportation
10.value: You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you.

10.name: Demiplane
10.value: You vanish into a safe, endless demiplane. At the start of your next turn, you reappear in the space you left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

15.name: Cards (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: Once on each of your turns when you draw a card from your deck as part of your __Deck of Fate__ feature, you can declare a suit (Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, or Spades) and check the top card of your deck. If you guessed the suit correctly, you can take the Dash, Disengage, or Use an Object action as part of the Bonus Action used for the feature.

18.name: Cards (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: Whenever you would draw one or more cards from your deck, draw twice as many. Put half of the cards drawn on the bottom of your deck and the other cards in your hand.

3.name: Darts (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Make Bullseye Shots with Ranged Cantrips*

Every Warmage understands the importance of precision, but the House of Darts flaunts a competitive excellence when it comes to landing shots. Daggers, bolts of magic, and of course, darts are their weapons of choice, but they don't stop at mere bullseyes. A wire array of trick shots set these Warmages apart from their contemporaries, even if they lack the grand strategies or discipline of the more martial colleges.
__Magic Daggers (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You learn the __Magic Daggers__ cantrip.

__Trick Shot (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You can curve your projectiles in mid-air to hit tricky targets. Whenever you make a ranged attack roll with a Warmage cantrip or a weapon that has Thrown, you can add or subtract a d4 from the d20 roll (to a maximum of 20 or a minimum of 1). Increasing the d20 roll to a 20 doesn't score a Critical Hit. You can choose to use this feature after making the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

__Bullseye (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You can sink a shot exactly where you need to. Record the number rolled on the d20 whenever you make a ranged spell attack roll with a Warmage cantrip. Rolls that have Advantage and Disadvantage record the higher and lower d20 roll, respectively. If a d20 roll is increased or decreased using your __Trick Shot__ feature, use the new number. A recorded roll lasts for 1 minute. If you roll one of your recorded numbers again when making a spell attack roll with a Warmage cantrip, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice.

3.name: Extra Damage
3.value: You can deal an extra **1d10** Force damage to the target.

3.name: Recovery
3.value: You regain one expended use of your __Trick Shot__ feature.

3.name: Reroll
3.value: You can reroll the d20 and must use the new roll. Record this new d20 roll.

7.name: Darts (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You can cast __Magic Daggers__ to summon a pair of daggers to your open hands, helping you scale surfaces. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes.

10.name: Darts (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: As a Reaction when an attacker you can see within 60 feet makes an attack against you or an Ally you can see within 30 feet of yourself, you can make a ranged spell attack using __Magic Daggers__ to interrupt the attack. If the result of your roll is greater than the result of the attacker, you can reduce the attack roll targeting you by 5 (to a minimum result of 1).

15.name: Darts (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: You master the house's signature technique for recovering darts. Whenever you cast the __Magic Daggers__ cantrip, you can replace one of your spell attacks with throwing a special teleportation dagger to a point you can see within the spell's range. You can take a Bonus Action to teleport to the dagger as long as you are within 500 feet of it. The dagger disappears after 10 minutes or if you use this feature to teleport or throw another teleportation dagger.

18.name: Darts (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: If you have recorded ten or more unique numbers using your __Bullseye__ feature, you can take an action to clear all of your recorded numbers and throw a burst of darts. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **1d8** Force damage for each unique recorded number on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Dice (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Tempt Fate with Chaotic Die Rolls*

The House of Dice throws out the Warmage convention of meticulous, deliberate spellcasting in favor of wild, chaotic magic that presses the odds. Everything from their magical bursts to their enchanted sets of dice can fail horribly, so it's auspicious that they often keep their fingers on the scales of fate. These Warmages have mastered not only a repertoire of cantrips, but also techniques to manipulate fortune itself, allowing them to risk everything, and more than often come out on top.

__Bonus Proficiencies (VALDAWARMAGE)__: Your light fingers and unscrupulous tactics help you win the day. You gain proficiency in the *Sleight of Hand* skill and with the Gaming Set (Dice Set), if you don't already have it.

__Dice Of Fate (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain four Dice of Fate, which are d6s. Whenever you fail a D20 Test or make a damage roll, you can expend one Die of Fate and add it to the roll, potentially causing the D20 Test to succeed. Once you expend a Die of Fate, it goes to the GM, who can expend it to add it to a D20 Test or a damage roll made by an NPC or monster. When the GM expends a die, it passes back to you, and so on. When you finish a Long Rest, you regain all of your expended Dice of Fate, whether or not the GM has used them.
Beginning at level 7, you have an additional two Dice of Fate, and you can add two Dice of Fate at once to your damage rolls with Warmage cantrips.
__Chaos Roll (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You can expend two of your __Dice of Fate__ as a Magic action, rolling them on the table below to create a chaotic surge of energy.

rows: You cast Fireball centered on yourself.
Your AC is reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn.
Until the start of your next turn, each creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you can only speak in a babbling nonsense language and can't cast spells with a Verbal component.
A 5-foot-radius Sphere of butterflies, insects, or doves fills a location you choose within 60 feet of you. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn.
You gain 7 Temporary Hit Points, and you keep the Dice of Fate instead of giving them to the GM.
You have the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn, as per the Invisibility spell.
An object within 60 feet of you chosen by the GM explodes, dealing no damage to you or your Allies, and dealing 3d6 Fire damage to one creature caught in the blast.

You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Each creature within 5 feet of the destination must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take 2d6 Force damage.
Choose a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature takes 4d6 Necrotic damage and you regain Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken.
You cast Lightning Bolt and can add the Dice of Fate to the damage roll.

7.name: Dice (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You can subtly cheat your dice. Once on each of your turns when you roll a d6, you can flip the die upside down. Note that on a balanced d6, the top and bottom numbers add up to 7, so you can determine the bottom number by subtracting the top number from 7.

10.name: Dice (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: When you make an attack roll or ability check with Disadvantage on your turn, you can attempt to invert fate as a Bonus Action. Expend a __Dice of Fate__ and roll it. On a 5, you ignore Disadvantage on the roll. On a 6, you instead have Advantage on the roll.

15.name: Dice (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: You can channel the chaotic energy of your dice in an instant. As a Reaction when you take damage from a creature you can see, you can expend two __Dice of Fate__ to make a __Chaos Roll__.

18.name: Dice (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: When you roll Initiative, roll a d6. You steal that many __Dice of Fate__ back from the GM.

3.name: Go (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Dominate Your Foes Through Cunning Formations*

The renowned House of Go predates the other Warmage colleges by centuries. Unlike its successors, the strategies pioneered by the House of Go focus upon formations and cooperation, rather than individual excellence. Which isn't to suggest that Warmages of this college are anything other than brilliant strategists—they rival the House of Kings in this regard. Rather, the footsoldiers of the House of Go are greater than the sum of their parts, fluidly adopting motions to isolate and flank their foes.

__Formations (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You learn special tactics called Formations. You can use a Bonus Action to activate one of the following Formations, which lasts until you and your Allies are no longer in that formation, you have the Incapacitated condition, die, or activate a different formation.

3.name: Flank
3.value: You can use this formation when you and an Ally that doesn't have the Incapacitated condition are adjacent to an enemy and on opposite sides of it. You can determine this by tracing a 5-foot-wide Line from your space. If this line passes through the center of all three spaces, the enemy is flanked. You and your Ally have Advantage on attack rolls against the flanked creature.

3.name: Solo
3.value: You can use this formation when you have no Allies within 5 feet of you. While in this formation, if you target a creature with a cantrip, that creature can't make Opportunity Attacks against you for the rest of the turn or until you are no longer in this formation, whether or not you deal damage with the cantrip.

3.name: Wall
3.value: You can use this formation when you and two to six Allies that don't have the Incapacitated condition are within 5 feet of another Ally. Each creature in this formation (including you), gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

7.name: Go (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You can spend 10 minutes planning an encounter in exact detail. When you do so, you can share your plan with up to six Allies within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you. Each Ally that understands the plan can gain Advantage on an attack roll or ability check it makes within the next 10 minutes. If an Ally rolls Initiative during this time, it can't use this feature to gain Advantage after the end of the first round of combat.
Once you use this feature to make a plan, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Go (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: While you are in a formation, any Critical Hit against you or an Ally in your formation becomes a normal hit.

15.name: Go (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: Your formation moves as if your Allies were links in a chain. Whenever you move on your turn, any number of willing Allies in your formation can move the same distance.

18.name: Go (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: On your turn, when you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a Warmage cantrip, you can cast another cantrip as a Bonus Action. You can apply Warmage Edge to this cantrip, even if you have already used it on your turn.

3.name: Kings (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Lead Your Allies with Brilliant Stratagems*

Warmages who train in the House of Kings specialize in tactics and strategy, learning age-old maneuvers to gain an edge in combat. Natural-born leaders, Kings work best with a cadre of supporters to perform their tactics and overwhelm the enemy. Moreso than all other Warmages, those in the House of Kings treat life and death as a game of strategy to be understood and conquered.

__Martial Training (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor, Heavy armor, and Shields. You can ignore the Strength requirement for wearing Heavy armor and wielding weapons with Heavy.
__Battle Tactics (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called Battle Dice.

3.name: Battle Dice
3.value: You have two Battle Dice, which are d6s. A Battle Die is expended when you use it. You regain all expended Battle Dice when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest. Your Battle Die changes and more Battle Dice become available when you reach certain Warmage levels as shown on the Battle Dice table.

3.name: Maneuvers
3.value: You can expend Battle Dice to perform maneuvers. Your maneuver options are detailed at the end of the subclass description.

3.name: Saving Throws
3.value: If a maneuver requires a saving throw, the DC equals to your spell save DC.
__Maneuver Options (VALDAWARMAGE)__: The maneuvers are presented in alphabetical order.

7.name: Kings (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. Allies that can see you within 120 feet of you also gain this benefit.

10.name: Kings (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: Allies within 10 feet of you add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1) to their saving throws against spells and magical effects.

15.name: Kings (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend one Battle Die as a Bonus Action to direct an Ally within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you to strike. The Ally can take a Reaction to cast a cantrip or make one attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike. The Ally adds the Battle Die to the attack or cantrip's damage roll.

18.name: Kings (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: When you roll Initiative, choose a number of Allies up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one) within 60 feet of yourself that can see or hear you. Give each Ally a Battle Die without expending it.

Once within the next minute when the Ally fails a D20 Test, it can roll the Battle Die and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success. A Battle Die is expended when it's rolled.

3.name: Knights (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Wield Blades of Fire, Lightning, Frost, and Force*

The House of Knights has a long and storied tradition of melding swordplay with the Warmage's potent spellcasting. Unlike other warriors, however, Knights carry neither swords nor shields into combat, for they can forge both out of magical force at a moment's notice.

__Martial Training (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor, Heavy armor, and Shields. You can ignore the Strength requirement for wearing Heavy armor and wielding weapons with Heavy.
__Mystical Armament (VALDAWARMAGE)__: Your melding of swordplay and arcana grants you the following benefits.

3.name: Martial Cantrips
3.value: You learn the __Force Buckler__ and one of the following cantrips of your choice: __Arc Blade__, __Burning Blade__, __Frigid Blade__, or __True Strike__.

3.name: Manifest Weapon
3.value: As a Bonus Action, you can create a Simple or Martial Melee weapon made of magical force in your hand. This weapon counts as being worth 1 GP for the purposes of Material components. You can use this weapon as a Spellcasting Focus.

Whenever you attack with the manifested weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. The weapon deals Force damage or its normal damage type.
The weapon vanishes at the end of your turn if you aren't holding it.

7.name: Knights (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Whenever you gain a Warmage level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

10.name: Knights (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: You can raise a hardened magical barrier between you and your foes. As a Bonus Action, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Warmage level.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

15.name: Knights (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: You can spend up to 30 feet of movement to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. The destination can be a number of feet away from you equal to half the movement you spend.

18.name: Knights (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: You can summon a whirlwind of mystical weapons for a flurry of strikes. As a Magic action, you can make a melee spell attack against up to five creatures you can see within 30 feet of you. Make a separate attack roll for each target. On a hit, a target takes Force damage equal to 2d10 + your Intelligence modifier.

3.name: Lancers (DARKMATTER24) Features
3.value: *Deliver Cantrips Through Hand-to-Hand Arcana*

Warmages who join the House of Lancers are trained in fluid martial arts and meditative asceticism, melding the stoic discipline of monks with potent spellcasting. As such, they are unarmed elemental warriors, self-reliant and capable of feats unmatched by their peers. However, Lancers are notoriously neutral and abstain from the politics of the other Warmage houses. Lancers derive their name from an ancient precursor to the pawn, a piece remembered only in early variants of chess. It is a relic from a forgotten age, rife with symbolism.
__Unarmored Defense (VALDAWARMAGE)__: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Intelligence modifier.
__Hand-to-Hand Arcana (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You have been trained in the Lancers' unarmed combat technique, granting you the following benefits.

3.name: Bonus Unarmed Strike
3.value: You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Unarmed Strike Damage
3.value: You can roll a d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strikes. The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d8), 11 (d10), and 17 (d12).

3.name: Intelligent Strikes
3.value: You can use Intelligence instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. In addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.

3.name: Weaponized Fists
3.value: Your Unarmed Strike counts as a Melee weapon with a cost of 1 GP for the purposes of Material components.

__Shock Trooper (VALDAWARMAGE)__: Whenever you make a melee attack on your turn against a creature you can see, you can lunge up to 15 feet toward your target before making the attack. Doing so doesn't spend movement or provoke Opportunity Attacks. You can perform this movement even if it causes you to travel through the air, though you fall after making the attack.

7.name: Lancers (DARKMATTER24) Features
7.value: Your Lancer training has heightened your body and mind, granting the following benefits.

7.name: Force Damage
7.value: Whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

7.name: Ignore Difficult Terrain
7.value: Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement.

7.name: Mind Over Matter
7.value: Whenever you make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead of the normal modifier.

10.name: Lancers (DARKMATTER24) Features
10.value: When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.
You don't benefit from this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

15.name: Lancers (DARKMATTER24) Features
15.value: You can lunge up to 30 feet using your __Shock Trooper__ feature. This movement causes you to teleport through creatures and objects, blinking to the target in an instant. You can't teleport into an occupied space.

18.name: Lancers (DARKMATTER24) Features
18.value: You can cast spells with superhuman speed. As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Arcane Surge feature to cast three different cantrips that have a casting time of an action or a Bonus Action. You can't use your Arcane Surge feature on any of these cantrips.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Pawns (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Master Cantrips and Warmage Tricks*

By far the most prominent Warmage house is that of the Pawns. Warmages who join the House of Pawns learn to stretch their skill with cantrips to its limits. Pawns can master any cantrip or strategy, for they embody the adaptability to which all Warmages aspire.

__Promotion (VALDAWARMAGE)__: As a Pawn, you have trained as the quintessential Warmage. When you finish a Long Rest, choose one of the following benefits, which lasts until you use this feature to choose a different benefit.

3.name: Adaptive Magic
3.value: You learn one Warmage trick of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites and one Warmage cantrip of your choice. This trick doesn't count against your number of tricks known.

3.name: Martial Training
3.value: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields.

7.name: Pawns (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You can add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1) to Initiative rolls. Additionally, when you roll Initiative, you can move up to your Speed.

10.name: Pawns (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any saving throw you make that doesn't otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.

15.name: Pawns (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: Whenever you deal damage with a Warmage cantrip, you and up to two Allies within 5 feet of you have Resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn.

18.name: Pawns (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: Your magic always finds its way to your foes' most vulnerable spots. Once per turn when you roll damage for a Warmage cantrip, you can choose one damage die and treat it as having rolled its maximum value.

3.name: Rooks (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Practice Furtive Magic and Mystical Stealth*

The clandestine members of the House of Rooks make adept spies, assassins, and scouts, though they might just as easily pick up jobs run by rogues and brigands. In addition to their suite of cantrips, Rooks are light on their feet and know a few tricks to magically open doors in utter silence.

__Rook Strike (VALDAWARMAGE)__: When you make an attack roll or ability check, you can take a Bonus Action to gain Advantage on the roll. Alternatively, you can impose Disadvantage on a saving throw a creature makes against a Warmage cantrip you cast before the end of your turn.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

__Arcane Acrobat (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: *Acrobatics*, *Sleight of Hand*, or *Stealth*. Additionally, you gain a bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus of +1) to all Dexterity checks you make.

7.name: Rooks (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: You learn a suite of furtive magic practiced by Rooks. You can cast each of the following spells without using a spell slot or Verbal components: __Feather Fall__, __Invisibility__, __Knock__ (silent when you cast it using this feature), __Silence__, and __Spider Climb__.
Once you cast a spell using this feature, you can't cast it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can expend a use of Arcane Surge to regain your use of all of these spells (no action required).

10.name: Rooks (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: When you take damage from a creature you can see, you can take a Reaction to raise a defensive illusion that protects you from further harm. Attacks made against you have Disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

15.name: Rooks (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: If you move more than 5 feet on your turn, any subsequent movement you make doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

18.name: Rooks (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: You can cast the __Greater Invisibility__ spell targeting yourself only without a spell slot or spell components. While you have the Invisible condition, your Speed is doubled.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Roulette (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
3.value: *Spin the Wheel, Gambling on Your Lucky Numbers*

Like the Houses of Dice and Cards, Warmages of the House of Roulette are masters of the calculated gamble. Bearing a number of magical chips, they can push the odds when the need arises, pulling off longshot plays that other Warmages could only dream of.

__Spin The Wheel (VALDAWARMAGE)__: You gain a roulette ball infused with arcane energy and a number of chips. As a Bonus Action, you can conjure a roulette wheel of magical force and roll the ball. Choose one of the bets from the Roulette Bets table below, announce your guess, and roll a d100. You gain the listed benefit if your guess is correct.

3.name: Chips of Fate
3.value: You have four Chips of Fate, and regain all expended chips when you finish a Long Rest. You gain two more Chips of Fate at level 7 (6 chips), 10 (8 chips), and 15 (10 chips).

Whenever you place a bet on the roulette wheel, you can expend 1-4 of your chips to place additional bets equal to the number of chips expended. No matter how many chips you expend, you can only place two types of bets, such as Singles and Tens, per d100 roll. You can't place more than one Odd/Even or High/Low bets. You can gain two benefits at once if you win two bets on the same roll.

table.title: Roulette Bets
rows: Odd/Even. Guess whether the roll is even or odd.
You gain a +2 bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn.
High/Low. Guess whether the roll is above or below 50.
You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls you make until the start of your next turn.
Lanes. Guess which of the following spans the number falls within: 01-20, 21-40, 41-60 , 61-80, 81-00.
You can gain Advantage on a D20 Test you make before the end of your next turn.
Tens. Guess the 10s digit of the roll.
Once before the end of your next turn, you can add 10 to the damage roll of a Warmage cantrip you cast.
Single. Guess the exact number of the roll.
Until the start of your next turn, you have Resistance to all damage and treat any d20 roll you make as 20.

7.name: Roulette (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
7.value: Pick a Lucky Number from 1 to 100 If you roll that number on any d100 roll of your __Spin the Wheel__ feature, you gain the benefit of betting that number as a Single. You can change your Lucky Number whenever you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Roulette (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
10.value: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll against you, you can take a Reaction to conjure your roulette wheel between yourself and the attacker. You and the attacker each roll a d100. If your roll is equal or higher than that of the attacker, the attack misses, and you can't use this ability again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

15.name: Roulette (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
15.value: You can unleash the energy stored within a Chip of Fate to escape a tight spot. As a Bonus Action, you can expend a Chip of Fate to teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

18.name: Roulette (VALDAWARMAGE) Features
18.value: Whenever you roll Initiative, you regain 4 expended Chips of Fate. Additionally, whenever you expend one or more Chips of Fate to bet on a Single and win, you regain all of your expended Chips of Fate.

1.name: Class Features
1.value: You have the ability to bind Silk to your body in order to heal your wounds. As an Action, you can spend 5 Silk Spools to bind your wounds with Silk, regaining Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Weaver level. You may only Bind once per turn.

As a Bonus Action, you can bind to a weapon with which you have proficiency. That chosen weapon becomes your Needle. Only one weapon can function as your Needle at a time. Binding to another weapon will remove your bond to your current Needle.
While you are bound to a Needle, you gain the following abilities:

1.name: Eye of the Needle
1.value: You have a knack for striking an enemy's weak points. The first time you land an attack with your Needle on your turn, you deal an additional 1d4 damage of the weapon's damage type.

1.name: Perfect Parry
1.value: You can use your Needle defensively. When an enemy hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to make an attack roll using your Needle. If you tie or exceed enemy's attack roll, you negate the incoming attack, though you deal no damage in return. You cannot parry a Critical Hit with this feature.

Your connection to your ancestors allows you to generate and bind Silk. Your ability to gather and make use of this energy is represented by a number of Silk Spools. Your Weaver level determines the maximum number of Silk Spools you can have, as shown in the Weaver table.
You can spend these points to fuel various Silk Skills. You start knowing one such feature: Bind

1.name: Gaining Silk
1.value: You gain Silk by successfully striking a "hostile" creature with your Needle. (Whether a creature is "hostile" is determined by your DM.) Doing so restores 1 Silk Spool. Additionally, all of your Silk Spools are restored whenever your character level increases.

1.name: Optional: Ancient Wonders
1.value: Your DM may allow you to find silk stores, hot springs, or other ancient wonders throughout the world that can replenish your Silk stores.
If you are playing in a low-combat campaign, talk to your DM about ways for your character to consistently regain Silk outside of combat.

1.name: Silk Skills
1.value: As you gain levels in this class, you will learn Silk Skills. Intelligence is your Silk Skill ability due to the craftiness required to use it to its full potential. You use your Intelligence modifier whenever a feature refers to your Silk modifier. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for an Item or Silk feature you use and when making an attack roll with one.
*Silk Save DC*: Intelligence modifier + Proficiency Bonus
*Silk Attack modifier*: Intelligence modifier + Proficiency Bonus
*Silk Skills are considered to be spells in reference to other game mechanics. Additionally, the effects of Blue and Yellow Tools are suspended if you are raging or in an __antimagic field__.*

2.name: Class Features
2.value: You gain the following benefits if you aren't wearing Medium or Heavy Armor or using a Shield:

entries: Your movement speed increases by 5 feet. Additionally, you can use a Bonus Action to rush up to 10 feet in any direction without taking Opportunity Attacks
When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your Reaction to take no damage on a success rather than half damage.
You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength

3.name: Class Features
3.value: You have discovered a method of using silk to augment your abilities. Starting at 3rd level, you may use Silk Spools to cast powerful Silk Skills. Pick 3 abilities to unlock now. You learn an additional Silk Skill at 7th, 11th, and 15th level. You can swap known Silk Skills in your Crest when you take a Long Rest.

You have mastered the ability to craft Tools for offense and defense. You can now equip Tools as listed in the table for each respective Crest. You can swap your equipped Tools during a Long Rest, and all Tool uses are restored at the end of a Long Rest.

You have learned to focus your power through specialized crests. There are 7 Crests to choose from, with each one focusing on a unique fighting style: Hunter, Reaper, Wanderer, Beast, Witch, Architect, and Shaman.
*While these Crests function as traditional subclasses, they differ in that you can swap your Crest during a Long Rest.*

4.name: Class Features
4.value: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (chapter 5 of the PHB) or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Weaver levels 8, 12, and 16.

You learn how to produce Silk on your own. When you start your turn with fewer Silk Spools than Silk Hearts, you can add 1 Silk Spool to a maximum of 1 (no action required). You gain an additional Silk Heart at Weaver level 8 and 12. You can also see your maximum Silk Hearts in the Silk Heart column of the Weaver Features table.

5.name: Class Features
5.value: You have modified your clothing to improve your mobility. When you make a standing or running long jump, you can double the distance.

As a Reaction, you can gain the effects of the __feather fall__ spell, but only on yourself. You can choose to cancel these effects at any time (no action required) rather than waiting the full duration of the spell.
You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

6.name: Class Features
6.value: You gain a feature from your Weaver Crest.
You gain a permanent Yellow tool slot regardless of your current equipped Crest.

7.name: Class Features
7.value: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. You have advantage on (*Athletics*) checks made to climb a surface with few handholds.

8.name: Class Features
8.value: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (chapter 5 of the PHB) or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

You learn how to produce Silk on your own. When you start your turn with fewer Silk Spools than Silk Hearts, you can add 1 Silk Spool to a maximum of 1 (no action required). You can also see your maximum Silk Hearts in the Silk Heart column of the Weaver Features table.

9.name: Class Features
9.value: You can replace one of the attacks from the Attack action to spend 1 Silk Spool to latch onto an enemy or surface up to 15 feet away, pulling yourself towards them in the process. If you latch onto an enemy in this way, you can make a Needle attack. This attack deals an additional 1d6 damage and recovers Silk as normal.
When attacking a Huge or larger creature with this feature, you gain 2 Silk Spools instead.

You gain proficiency with a musical instrument and proficiency in (*Performance*) checks (or another skill of your choice if you already have proficiency in Performance). The instrument you choose counts as your Needolin for all related features.
While playing your Needolin, you can read the surface thoughts of others similar to the __Detect Thoughts__ spell. You can also spend 1 Silk Spool to cast the __Speak with Dead__ spell.

As a Magic Action on your turn, you can spend 1 Silk Spool to cast the __Hold Monster__ spell. However, you must continue playing the Needolin as a Magic action on subsequent turns to maintain Concentration on the spell. Your movement speed is 0 and you cannot take any Bonus Action or Reaction while playing the Needolin in this way.

10.name: Class Features
10.value: You gain resistance to Cold damage and a Fly Speed of 30 feet. You fall to the ground if you end your turn while in the air, although you can negate any fall damage by activating your Drifter's Cloak.
You gain a feature from your Weaver Crest.

11.name: Class Features
11.value: You gain a permanent Blue tool slot regardless of which crest you have equipped.

12.name: Class Features
12.value: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (chapter 5 of the PHB) or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

You learn how to produce Silk on your own. When you start your turn with fewer Silk Spools than Silk Hearts, you can add 1 Silk Spool to a maximum of 1 (no action required). You can also see your maximum Silk Hearts in the Silk Heart column of the Weaver Features table.

13.name: Class Features
13.value: You have learned a new use for your Needolin. You can spend 1 Silk Spool to cast the __Teleportation Circle__ spell to teleport to the location of your last Long Rest.

14.name: Class Features
14.value: You gain a feature from your Weaver Crest.

15.name: Class Features
15.value: You have mastered the Clawline. You can now latch on to enemies and surfaces up to 30 feet away. Your bonus damage from your Clawline increases to 2d6.

As an Action, you can spend 1 Silk to launch your Needle vertically up to 150 feet. If your Needle makes contact with a surface or enemy, you can pull yourself up to your Needle as a Bonus Action. You can bring a number of allies with you equal to your Intelligence modifier. You can retract your Needle at any time while using this feature.

16.name: Class Features
16.value: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (chapter 5 of the PHB) or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify.

17.name: Class Features
17.value: You have developed a new use for your Needolin. You can spend 1 Silk Spool and a minute to cast the __Dream__ spell.

18.name: Class Features
18.value: You have gained the means to resist dark forces. You now have advantage on Constitution saving throws; Fiends, Aberrations, and Undead have disadvantage on attacks against you; and you gain resistance to Necrotic damage.

19.name: Class Features
19.value: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another [feat](https://5e.tools/feats.html) of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Irresistable Offence is recommended.

20.name: Class Features
20.value: A benevolent being has taken up residence inside of you, empowering you with Silk. Whenever you take a Short or Long Rest, you regain all Silk Spools

3.name: Architect (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Use tools and gadgets to dominate*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**

__Architect's Bit (ABWEAVER)__: You can now use a Spear, Lance, Trident, or Pike as your Needle. These weapons also count as Finesse weapons for you. You can now use the respective Weapon Mastery for these weapons.

6.name: Architect (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: You've learned a unique way to Bind. As an Action, you can spend 5 Silk Spools to restore all uses of your equipped Red tools instead of healing. Once you use this ability, you must complete a Long Rest before using it again.

10.name: Architect (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack using a Spear, Lance, Trident, or Pike:
You can only gain 1 Silk Spool when using a Needle Art.

10.name: Drilling Strike
10.value: As an Action, you can lunge forward with your Needle and attack all enemies in a 15-foot line. Make a separate attack roll for each creature. You add your proficiency bonus to the damage of each attack.

14.name: Architect (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: You can use your Architect's Alchemy feature twice per Long Rest.
All of your Red Tools deal an additional die of damage (E.g. 2d4 > 3d4, 1d12 > 2d12)

3.name: Architect (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Architect Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Artisan (WEAVER)__: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools, such as Tinker's Tools.
__Craft Bind (WEAVER)__: You no longer have an ability to use Silk Skills; instead, you channel your Silk into crafting extra Red Tools and magically granting proficiency to your travel companions.

As an action, you can spend 9 Silk points to craft extra copies of your Red Tools. These copies can be given to other friendly humanoid creatures, and they can use the Red Tools in the same manner that you do. Additionally, any of your Red Tools with the Limited property have all of their uses restored.
Craft Bind can be interrupted by attacks in the same way that your normal Bind can.
Each Red Tool is copied once, and each copy can be given to a single ally. The copies are usable until you complete a long rest or until you use Craft Bind again.

You always use your own Proficiency Bonus and character level as it refers to Red Tools; Cogfly and Pollip Pouch function using your abilities. All other effects are calculated based on whoever is currently wielding the tool.

11.name: Architect (WEAVER) Features
11.value: When you use Craft Bind, Choose a number of creatures up to your Silk modifier who are within 10 feet of you, and each of them receives copies of all three of your Red Tools.

3.name: Beast (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Rip and tear your foes to shreds*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**

__Beast's Claws (ABWEAVER)__: You can use Unarmed Strikes as your Needle. Your Unarmed Strike die is now a d6 if it wasn't already, deals Slashing damage, and has the Finesse property. Furthermore, you can use the Graze weapon mastery as part of your Unarmed Strikes. Dealing damage through the Graze property does not restore Silk.
Additionally, Binding now costs your Bonus Action instead of your Action.

6.name: Beast (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: You Unarmed Strike die is now a d8.
After you Bind, you enter a fury. You gain the following effects for your next 3 turns:

entries: You can make an additional attack as part of the Attack action
Your movement speed increases by 10 feet
You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws
Once per turn, you regain Hit Points equal to your Unarmed Strike die when you hit an enemy

10.name: Beast (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your Unarmed Strike die is now a d10.
Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack using your Unarmed Strikes:
You can only gain 1 Silk Spool when using a Needle Art.

10.name: Slashing Flurry
10.value: As an Action, you can leap 10 feet and make 2 attacks with your Needle against enemies up to 10 feet away from you. Add your proficiency bonus to the damage of each attack. While your Fury is active, you can instead make 3 attacks.

14.name: Beast (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: Your Unarmed Strike die is now 2d6. You also have advantage on the first attack you make during your Beast's Fury on each of your turns.

3.name: Beast (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Beast Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Honed Mind (WEAVER)__: You gain a bonus to Initiative rolls equal to your Silk modifier.
__Beast Bind (WEAVER)__: You can spend 9 Silk points to begin a Beast Bind during your turn (no action required). This applies the following effects to your melee Needle attacks:

entries: Your attack rolls are made with advantage.
You can make a single attack as a Bonus Action.

When you deal damage, you can recover 1d6 Hit Points. This recovery increases to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level. For every d6 you roll, add your Constitution modifier to the amount of Hit Points you recover. Similar to damage dice, these recovery dice are doubled when you land a Critical Hit (but your Constitution modifier is not added to the extra dice).

3.value: These effects last for 1 minute or until you take damage.
This feature replaces your Bind feature. Unlike the original feature, the Beast Bind does not trigger enemy attacks and will still function if you are raging.

11.name: Beast (WEAVER) Features
11.value: When you make a d20 roll with advantage during your Beast Bind, roll three d20s instead of two and use the highest result.

3.name: Hunter (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Build focus and cut your foes*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**
__Hunter's Blade (ABWEAVER)__: You gain proficiency in Longswords which count as Finesse weapons for you, and can use the Sap mastery while using your Needle.

6.name: Hunter (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: Each time you hit a hostile creature with your Needle, your Needle's damage increases by +1 to a maximum of +3. The damage bonus resets to 0 if you take damage from any source or take a Short or Long Rest.

10.name: Hunter (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack using a Longsword:
You generate 1 Silk Spool for each attack that lands.

10.name: Double Slash
10.value: As an Action, you can make two attacks against an enemy in your Needle's range. You have advantage on the attacks and you add your proficiency bonus to the damage.

14.name: Hunter (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: The bonus damage from your Hunter's Focus feature now increases by +2 per attack that hits up to a maximum of +6.

3.name: Hunter (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Hunter Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Lurk (WEAVER)__: When you use one or more Red Tools, you can Hide as part of that same action or bonus action.

__Focus (WEAVER)__: Your Focus is represented by a numerical value that starts at zero and increases by one each time you successfully land a Needle attack on a hostile creature. When you take damage or complete a long rest your Focus value resets to zero.
If your Focus value is 4 or greater, you deal an extra 1d4 damage with your Needle attacks. (This also applies to the attack that increases the Focus value to 4.)

11.name: Hunter (WEAVER) Features
11.value: Your Focus improves when you reach 11th level. You can use the largest die size less than or equal to your current Focus value, up to a maximum of 1d12.
For example, if your Focus value is 6 or 7, your Needle attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage, and a value of 12 or more gives an extra 1d12 damage.

3.name: Reaper (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Swing wide and generate Silk*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**

__Reaper's Scythe (ABWEAVER)__: You gain proficiency in Halberds and Greataxes, and you can use your Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage modifiers. You can also use the Cleave mastery when using your Needle. You gain Silk as normal on the Cleave attack.
When you make a weapon your Needle, it gains the Reach property if it did not have it already.

6.name: Reaper (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: After you Bind, all attacks generate 2 Silk Spools instead of 1. This effect lasts for your next 3 turns.

10.name: Reaper (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack using a Halberd or Greataxe:
You can only gain 1 Silk Spool when using a Needle Art. If your Reaper's Harvest ability is active, you gain 2 Silk Spools instead.

10.name: Great Slash
10.value: Make an attack roll against all enemies within 15-foot Cube in your Needle's range. You can add your ability modifier and proficiency bonus to the damage of these attacks.

14.name: Reaper (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: You can now Cleave an additional enemy as a part of the Attack action. Additionally, all Cleave attacks generate Silk as normal.

3.name: Reaper (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Reaper Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Reaper Bind (WEAVER)__: Recovering Hit Points using your Bind allows you to reap additional Silk from enemies.

When you damage a hostile creature with your Needle, you can attempt to gather additional Silk by making an Acrobatics check. If the check's result matches or exceeds the target's AC, then you regain an extra Silk point from that attack, and from every other melee Needle attack you make that damages this creature until the start of your next turn.
If the Acrobatics check does not meet the target's AC, you cannot attempt this check against that creature until the start of your next turn.
Your ability to reap additional Silk begins when your Bind completes and lasts for 1 minute or until you take damage.

11.name: Reaper (WEAVER) Features
11.value: If there are two or more targets within your Needle's reach, you can damage each of them with a single attack. Your attack and damage rolls apply to all targets, and you recover Silk as though you had landed multiple separate attacks.
If your Reaper Bind is active, you can make a single Acrobatics check against all of your targets to potentially reap extra Silk from each of them.

3.name: Shaman (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Display your mastery of Silk Skills*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**

__Shaman's Slice (ABWEAVER)__: You learn the Magic Needle cantrip. You can replace one of your attacks as part of the Attack action with this cantrip. You do not gain Silk Spools from the bonus damage to a second enemy.
Additionally, you can add your Intelligence modifier to the damage of your Silk Skills.

3.name: Magic Needle
3.value:
***Casting Time:** Action*
***Range:** Self*
***Components:** S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)*
***Duration:** Instantaneous*
*You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause magic to arc from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The second creature takes Force damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.*
*This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 Force damage to the target on a hit, and the Force damage to the second creature increases to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 2d8) and 17th level (3d8 and 3d8).*

6.name: Shaman (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: Your Silk Skills deal 1 additional die of damage.

10.name: Shaman (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack:
Dealing damage with this Needle Art only generates 1 Silk Spool.

10.name: Shockwave
10.value: You send out a blast of arcane energy from your Needle. Each enemy within a 15-foot Cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw against your Silk save DC. On a failure, the target takes Thunder damage equal to 3d8 + your Silk Skill modifier or half on a success.

14.name: Shaman (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: Your Silk Skills now deal 2 additional dice of damage.

3.name: Shaman (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Shaman Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Blade Cast (WEAVER)__: Your Needle's reach increases by 10 feet.
__Shaman's Silk (WEAVER)__: You can have three Silk Skills prepared at a time, and your Silk are d10s rather than d8s.

__Shaman Bind (WEAVER)__: If you use Bind while airborne, you immediately plummet to the ground at a speed of 100 feet per round. You take no fall damage, and the Bind begins when you touch the ground.
When you complete a Bind, you can choose one of the following effects:

entries: Choose a number of creatures up to your Silk modifier within 15 feet of you. They regain Hit Points equal to half of your total restored Hit Points.
One creature of your choice that you can touch regains Hit Points equal to the full amount that you recover.

11.name: Shaman (WEAVER) Features
11.value: You have refined your Needle technique so it becomes nearly impossible to avoid. When you use your Needle feature, the attack you missed still deals damage to the target equal to your Dexterity modifier, and you recover a Silk point as normal.
This feature cannot be used if the attack roll's result was a natural 1.

3.name: Wanderer (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Outmaneuver your foes with speedy strikes*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**

__Wanderer's Blitz (ABWEAVER)__: All Light weapons you are proficient with gain the Nick weapon mastery, and you can use the Nick weapon mastery even if you are not dual wielding. Additionally, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the Nick attack and generate Silk as normal.

6.name: Wanderer (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: While you have 5 or more Silk Spools, you can score a Critical Hit on an attack roll of 19 or 20 on a d20. This effect stacks with the Magnetite Dice tool.

10.name: Wanderer (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack using a Light weapon:
You can only gain 1 Silk Spool when using a Needle Art.

10.name: Stabbing Flurry
10.value: As an Action, you can make 3 attacks against an enemy within your Needle's reach. You have advantage on these attacks.

14.name: Wanderer (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: While you have 5 or more Silk Spools, you can score a Critical Hit on an attack roll of 18-20 on a d20. This effect stacks with the Magenetite Dice.

3.name: Wanderer (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Wanderer Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Strike Of Luck (WEAVER)__: When you have 9 or more Silk points, your attacks score a Critical Hit on a d20 roll of 19 or 20.
You can activate your Needle feature when you miss a melee Needle attack or when you score a Critical Hit with one.

__Wanderer's Approach (WEAVER)__: When you Dash and move at least 10 feet toward a hostile creature, you can make one melee Needle attack against them as part of same action (or bonus action) you used to Dash.

11.name: Wanderer (WEAVER) Features
11.value: You can attack three times instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn.
This also applies to Needle, allowing you to parry up to 2 attacks before the start of your next turn.

3.name: Witch (ABWEAVER) Features
3.value: *Siphon life and Silk from your enemies*
You can equip a set number of Tools and Silk Skills for each subclass. Consult the table below to see what you can equip for subsequent levels. **This table includes Vesticrest Slots.**
__Witch's Whip (ABWEAVER)__: You can use the Slow weapon mastery on Whips. Additionally, Whips now deal 1d6 Slashing damage.
Binding now costs your Bonus Action instead of your Action.

6.name: Witch (ABWEAVER) Features
6.value: You learn a special way to Bind. You can modify your Bind to no longer restore Hit Points as normal. Instead, any creature within a 15-foot Emanation must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d10 + your Weaver level in Slashing damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.
If you damage a creature with this feature, you recover Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt to one creature.

10.name: Witch (ABWEAVER) Features
10.value: Your mastery of the Needle allows you to attack decisively. As an Action, you can make a special Needle attack using a Whip:
You can only gain 1 Silk Spool when using a Needle Art.

10.name: Cyclone
10.value: As an Action, you can lash out and attack all enemies in your Needle's reach. Add your proficiency bonus to the damage of each attack.
As a Bonus Action, you can extend the duration of the attack and deal an additional 1d4 damage to each enemy you hit

14.name: Witch (ABWEAVER) Features
14.value: When extending your Cyclone attack with your Bonus Action, the 1d4 of additional damage increases to 2d4.

Additionally, the damage of your Witch's Curse feature increases by 1d10, and you can restore Hit Points in addition to your Bind equal to your Silk modifier when an enemy fails their saving throw. These bonus Hit Points can only be earned once per turn.

3.name: Witch (WEAVER) Features
3.value: The Witch Crest grants the following tool slots as you gain levels in this class:
__Witch's Curse (WEAVER)__: When you choose this subclass, the DM determines whether you are cursed by secretly rolling a d20 (they choose how to interpret the result).
If you are cursed, your Silk Point maximum is reduced to 3, and you cannot equip any Tools. This can be cured with a __Remove Curse__ spell or by receiving an operation from a skilled surgeon.

__Lash (WEAVER)__: When you Dash and move at least 10 feet toward a hostile creature, you can make two melee Needle attacks against them as part of same action (or bonus action) you used to Dash. You do not add your ability modifier to the damage of these attacks, unless that modifier is negative, but you recover Silk for each hit as normal.

__Witch Bind (WEAVER)__: If your Bind completes and no creatures are within 15 feet, you don't regain any Hit Points. Otherwise, sinister tendrils strike all hostile creatures in that range; the Bind die result determines both the HP you recover and the damage dealt. Targets make a Constitution saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the result on a failed save or half as much damage on a success.

11.name: Witch (WEAVER) Features
11.value: When you use Witch Bind, other creatures do not make a saving throw and always take full damage from the feature.
